entries.explanation:
Report: adds executive summary + readiness-level explainer, per-construct
sub-dimension breakdowns, a second development priority, a 30/60/90-day plan,
a benchmark interpretation, training rationale, a manager conversation guide,
and reflection prompts (bilingual EN/AR). Cache: /samples/* routes now send
no-store so updates to the shared links show immediately.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Enhance ARC dashboard sample: matrix, heatmap, segments, filters, training
entries.plain: The AI Readiness dashboard demo now shows results by team, readiness levels, demographics, and recommended training - with PDF export and Arabic support.
entries.explanation:
Upgrades the in-place /samples/arc-dashboard demo with five tabs: Overview
(drill-down + donut + sub-dimension expand + target lines + people
filters/search/sort), Readiness matrix (Awareness x Adoption quadrant map),
Department x sub-dimension heatmap, demographic Segments (grade/tenure/
gender/nationality), and per-gap Training recommendations. Plus Export PDF.
Bilingual EN/AR, static demo data (same employee scores as v1).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add public ARC report + recommendation sample pages
entries.plain: Sample AI Readiness reports and recommendations are now available as shareable branded links for demonstrating the platform.
entries.explanation:
Serves the bilingual detailed individual report and the assessment-optimization
recommendation as branded shareable links at /samples/arc-report and
/samples/arc-recommendation (both print-to-PDF, EN/AR toggle). Static demo
content, no PII; middleware already bypasses /samples/*.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Provisional banner: client surfaces say "Preliminary results" only
entries.plain: The 'preliminary results' notice now uses simpler language that doesn't mention internal review processes.
entries.explanation:
The client-facing provisional notice (respondent results pages, delivered
report PDFs) no longer explains the internal QA pipeline ("some questions
have not yet been reviewed and approved by a subject-matter expert") - it
now reads simply: "Preliminary results - these are preliminary results and
may be refined as the assessment is finalised. Treat them as indicative
for now." (EN + AR.)

The honest detail is not lost: consultant/admin surfaces (ARC assessment
detail, Persona results console) use a new variant="internal" that keeps
the full SME-review wording AND the pending-question counts, so the team
still sees exactly why the flag is up. The counts line no longer renders
on client surfaces at all.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: single-language section headers in the respondent form
entries.plain: Assessment section headers now display only in the respondent's chosen language instead of showing both languages at once.
entries.explanation:
Drop the opposite-language secondary label from pillar / factor / agentic
section headers so each header matches the selected language, per the trial
review (Yassin). Questions already render in the chosen language; the header
now reads consistently instead of showing both languages at once.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: voucher resume-by-browser + reword hallucinating + AR title fix
entries.plain: Respondents can now resume a started assessment from the same device without losing their progress or wasting extra seats; improved question clarity and Arabic button visibility.
entries.explanation:
- Voucher redeem now RESUMES an in-progress sitting instead of minting a
  new one (and burning another seat) when the same browser re-opens the
  redeem link. Bound to a first-party httpOnly cookie set on first redeem,
  ownership re-verified against this voucher's redemptions, and limited to
  in-progress sittings - so it can never hand out another person's sitting
  or results on a guessed email. Root-cause fix for the trial's restart +
  seat-burn reports.
- Reword the two snapshot items that said an AI is 'hallucinating' to
  'fabricating information' (EN+AR), per the trial review (migration 00191,
  applied to the live bank).
- Correct the Arabic 'AI Collaboration' factor title.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC respondent flow: trial-feedback fixes
entries.plain: Answers now save instantly to prevent loss when switching tabs; respondents see a status indicator confirming their work is saved.
entries.explanation:
Fixes from the ARC trial (Assad, Omar, Ahmad Ghosheh, Jomaa, Yassin):

- Answer-loss race: discrete answers now save immediately (only free-text
  is debounced); a pagehide/visibilitychange flush persists in-flight
  answers on tab-close; immediate save uses the click-time snapshot so it
  can never POST a stale value; a global Saving/Saved/unsaved status chip
  gives the reassurance testers found missing.
- Arabic language button was invisible (white on white): unselected option
  now has an explicit readable colour; toggle made more prominent.
- Flag-for-follow-up + missed questions: sticky bar now has jump-to-next-
  unanswered and review-flagged controls scrolling to per-question anchors.
- Arabic factor/pillar labels (THINKING/RESULTS/PEOPLE/SELF) were hardcoded
  English: added bilingual domain labels.
- Save & finish later no longer strands the respondent on /ara (losing the
  token URL and forcing a re-signup/restart): shows an inline reassurance
  panel and keeps them on their link. The hero back link is now staff-only
  for the same reason.
- Consultant/BD guided-demo rail was leaking onto the signup + assessment
  screens: the running rail is now suppressed on the answering + real-signup
  surfaces (the free /ara/personal snapshot still shows it for demos).
- Voucher redeem page gained a bilingual 'What to expect' description.
- Rating buttons widened to the 44px mobile touch-target minimum.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC Batch 2: erasure completeness, purge collateral, report honesty
entries.plain: Data deletion now fully removes client contact information and email logs; reassessments copy all their original settings correctly.
entries.explanation:
Fixes the remaining confirmed majors + minors from the ARC code review:

Admin/consultant actions:
- Org anonymize (PDPL/GDPR) now clears client contact PII and scrubs
  ara_email_log recipient addresses (chunked, errors logged - not swallowed)
- Reassessment copy carries time_limit/talent_lens/items_per_factor +
  respondent role_key/individual_only (tolerant strip+retry on fresh DBs)
- New src/lib/ara/retention.ts (plain module - the unguarded purge core is
  no longer a compiled server action); retention + sandbox purges now delete
  ara-materials Storage files and email-log rows BEFORE the cascade
- Sandbox purge writes per-assessment audit rows (target_id NOT NULL was
  always violated + swallowed = zero audit trail) and deletes exactly the
  selected id set; deleteAraQuestion refuses when answers exist (fail closed
  on count errors); malformed JSON in question edit errors instead of
  nulling options/score_map, and the edit page now surfaces action errors

Report surfaces:
- client_manager portal PDF: middleware confinement now honors the
  server-only x-ara-internal render (Edge-safe constant-time compare) -
  previously the Puppeteer render 302d to /portal and the delivered "PDF"
  was a print of the portal dashboard; PDF route scopes cookie + secret to
  same-origin requests and refuses to ship a PDF of an error page
- Gap heatmap: paginated feed + individual/agentic layer exclusion + scoped
  pillar rows; KPI tiles and copy use the scoped pillar count, not "/ 8"
  (EN + AR); peer benchmarks exclude individual-stage runs and count only
  peers with scored pillar data (chunked + paginated)

Respondent flow + email + scoring:
- Submit refuses when answers failed to persist (flush retries errored
  saves and reports the count; bilingual error); Save-and-exit warns before
  leaving with unsaved answers; expiry auto-submit logs the loss
- Autosave retry re-reads latest state (stale value no longer overwrites a
  newer answer); sandbox email with no redirect MOCKS instead of delivering
  to real recipients; client-results email no longer claims a PDF is
  attached when the attach failed
- Individual overall fallback stage-gated (Mode C org runs stay pending
  until a pillar answer exists, never borrow the personal maturity label)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC Batch 1: pagination, respondent write gates, collateral tenancy
entries.plain: Large result sets now process correctly without hitting database limits; scoring and compliance checks stop cleanly if an error occurs.
entries.explanation:
Fixes the confirmed critical + major findings from the ARC code review:

Pagination (1000-row PostgREST cap - the D360 defect class):
- New src/lib/ara/paginate.ts (fetchAllPages + chunkIds)
- recalculateAssessmentScores, distortion, personal-norms, company-cohort,
  compliance, workforce/agentic readiness, gap/shadow-AI detectors, and the
  provisional banner now page their ara_responses reads; scoring + compliance
  abort on error instead of persisting partial cohorts; updateAraOrganization
  draft re-stamp uses per-draft head counts (fail closed)

saveAraAnswer write gates (mirror of loadQuestionsForRespondent):
- completed_at submission lock (no post-submit answer rewrites)
- time-limit anchor started_at ?? first_opened_at, failing CLOSED by
  stamping the clock on the first write when both are null
- null question_bank_version_id falls back to the active bank (a served
  form was previously unsaveable); pillar-assignment scope fallback
- layer/tier/region/sector + is_active + items_per_factor cap enforcement
  (write path now accepts exactly what the read path serves)

Collateral tenancy + locks:
- use-case/material respondent deletes now require same-assessment AND
  own-row (consultant rows no longer deletable by any token)
- respondentWriteLockError gates all 5 collateral writes on completed_at
  + frozen/archived; submitted org respondents see the thank-you state
  instead of a live form

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Licensed preview: brand ARC as AR Compass; drop non-instrument modules
entries.plain: Platform rebrand and consolidation changes applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Item banks: ARC card reflects sme_status (review gate), not is_active
entries.plain: The vetted question count now reflects actual expert approval status, so sending questions back for review immediately updates the dashboard.
entries.explanation:
"Send all back to review" on ARC worked (all questions -> pending) but
the dashboard didn't change, because the ARC card's "vetted" count read
the question is_active flag (bank membership) instead of sme_status (the
review gate that approve / reopen actually change). So it looked like
nothing happened.

- arc() vetted = SME-approved active-version questions; total = served
  (is_active) questions; dynamic note shows the pending count
- legacy fallback when sme_status (migration 00184) is absent
- ARC stays servesLive:false (it always serves the seeded bank, never
  live-AI) - review status only drives the provisional flag on results

Verified: with ARC currently all-pending, the card now reads 0/213 +
"213 pending SME review"; re-approving restores 213/213.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: provisional flag on org report, personal PDF, consultant detail
entries.plain: AI-readiness results now clearly mark assessments under expert review across all report formats and PDFs in both English and Arabic.
entries.explanation:
Completes ARC Option 2 across every result surface (the on-screen
personal results + SME console landed in c1bae5c):

- org report page + PDF: a print-safe ProvisionalReportStrip at the top
  of both render paths (bilingual side-by-side + portrait EN/AR). The
  PDF is this page rendered headless, so one change covers both. EN/AR
  copy per language.
- personal PDF: provisional banner threaded through both renderers -
  the EN React-PDF (Text block) and the AR Puppeteer HTML (RTL strip).
- consultant assessment detail: ProvisionalBanner heads-up when the
  cohort's answered questions include un-approved content.

All driven by araAssessmentProvisional / araRespondentProvisional
(answered-question sme_status). Clears per-pillar as an SME approves.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: SME question-review gate + provisional results (Option 2)
entries.plain: AI-readiness assessments no longer pause when expert reviewers haven't approved questions yet - results show as provisional until approval.
entries.explanation:
ARC served every is_active question with no human sign-off on the
question itself, and had no live-AI fallback - so a hard gate would
blank the assessment. Apply Option 2: keep serving, but flag results
provisional until an SME approves the content.

- migration 00184: ara_questions.sme_status (pending/approved/rejected,
  default pending) + reviewer cols. The new column defaults every
  existing question to 'pending' - the honest reset (none SME-reviewed).
- provisional lib: a result is provisional if any ANSWERED question is
  not sme-approved (reflects exactly what the respondent saw); tolerant
  of an un-applied migration
- shared ProvisionalBanner (bilingual, RTL) + wired onto the personal
  results page
- SME review console at /ara/admin/questions/[versionId]: per-pillar +
  whole-version "Approve" controls (setAraQuestionsSmeStatusAction),
  with a pending-count summary

Remaining (next commits): banner on the org + personal PDFs and the
consultant detail; then the same provisional flag on the other portals.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC audit fixes (minors): weights, status lifecycle, audit rows, timer, regulatory
entries.plain: Fixed issues with AI Readiness assessments at the department or division level - weights can now be saved correctly and assessments can reach completion status.
entries.explanation:
- Pillar weight editor scopes read+validate+write to the IN-SCOPE pillars (4/6/8)
  instead of all 8, with the sum-to-100 rule + equal-split default over in-scope,
  so a Department/Division assessment's weights can actually be saved (WEIGHT-04).
- Org assessments gain Launch (draft->active) and Mark complete (active/frozen->
  completed) transitions - previously stuck at draft->frozen, so they never
  reached an end state (also why the year-on-year prior scan never saw them) -
  STATUS-08/09.
- Audit rows written on org hard-delete + sandbox purge (ORG-DELETE-02) to honour
  the immutable-log compliance requirement.
- Respondent time limit is now enforced server-side (with a grace buffer) in
  saveAraAnswer, not just by the client countdown (TIMER-05).
- Regulatory documents get Approve/Reject controls so they can leave 'review' -
  the lifecycle was rendered but unreachable (DEFER-01).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC audit fixes (majors): report scope, scoring, lifecycle, honest copy
entries.plain: Department and division AI Readiness reports now display only the relevant pillars instead of showing incomplete data, and practice-run disclaimers are now accurate.
entries.explanation:
- Org PDF (portrait + bilingual + radar) now shows ONLY in-scope pillars on a
  subset-stage run instead of zero-filling all 8 - a Department/Division org no
  longer reads as half-assessed in the client deliverable. Radar axis labels
  also localise to Arabic (PDF-17).
- Redeem 'practice run for development' disclaimer is now conditional on the
  voucher's is_practice flag; real (admin-issued) vouchers show accurate copy.
- Distortion anchor-deviation is leave-one-out (a faker's own extremes no longer
  dilute the population anchor on small ARC cohorts) - DIST-04.
- Reassessment carries pillars_in_scope + agentic/individual layers + tier so
  year-2 measures the same scope as year-1 - REASSESS-09 / AGN-REASSESS-01.
- Mode B deep-dive binds consultant_id to the issuer so they can open their own
  assessment under RLS - DEEPDIVE-03.
- ARA Graph email maps attachments to fileAttachment blocks (the results PDF was
  silently dropped) - EMAIL-17.
- Offline banner tells the honest truth (no local persistence; pause till online)
  instead of promising a sync that never happens - OFFLINE-02.
- Admin question list gains an activate/deactivate control + Inactive-draft badge
  so AI-authored questions can be made live - QCRUD-08.
- Year-on-year scopes the prior scan to the same major bank version at the query
  layer instead of truncating to 10 rows first - YOY-07.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Move ARC voucher add-client next to the client picker
entries.plain: The option to add a new client when issuing AI Readiness codes is now positioned next to the client selection field for easier access.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Capture ARC client contact in step 1, prefill step-3 email
entries.plain: When setting up AI Readiness assessments, you can now enter the client contact person's details upfront, and their email automatically populates when sending results.
entries.explanation: Step 1 adds client contact name/title/email; step 3 email-to-client is prefilled with the contact so the batch can go straight to them.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rebuild ARC vouchers as a guided 3-step issue wizard
entries.plain: Issuing AI Readiness assessment codes now follows a simple 3-step wizard: select client and options, choose who receives codes, then generate and email them.
entries.explanation: Step 1 client + engagement label + ARC options; step 2 to-client vs to-delegates; step 3a generate batch then email/copy to client; step 3b upload/paste delegate emails then email each a link.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add email-codes-to-client option + collapsible email sections
entries.plain: All assessment code distributions now support sending one email with all codes to a client contact, and email sections can be collapsed on smaller screens.
entries.explanation: Shared VoucherClientEmailCard (one email, whole batch) on Fluent/Logica/Persona/ARC/Techno; delegate emailers now collapsible; mobile-responsive just-generated headers.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Unify ARC + Pre-Hire voucher forms: identity row + options callout
entries.plain: AI Readiness and Pre-Hire assessment code forms now use a consistent layout and design for better user experience.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC audit Batch 2/3: bilingual redeem, calibration-withheld note, rating anchor
entries.plain: The AI Readiness assessment redemption page now supports Arabic language, and shows clear notes when calibration checks cannot be completed due to insufficient responses.
entries.explanation:
- Redeem form is now bilingual (EN/AR toggle + RTL + Arabic labels), matching the
  rest of ARC; dropped the unused PII-prefill props.
- personal-analysis: when too few objective items (<4) were answered, surface a
  "calibration check withheld" note instead of silently omitting it, so the
  verdict isn't read as if a self-vs-objective alignment check had passed.
- Respondent rating anchor now reads "1 = Strongly disagree · 5 = Strongly agree"
  (was "1 = Low · 5 = High"), matching the intro's stated agreement scale (EN+AR,
  Arabic-Indic digits preserved for correct RTL BiDi).
tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC audit Batch 1: voucher hardening + respondent integrity (migration 00158)
entries.plain: Fixed security vulnerabilities in AI Readiness code handling so that failed assessments don't waste seats and assessment codes cannot be manipulated through the URL.
entries.explanation:
- migration 00158: ara_voucher_release_seat (atomic hand-back) + lock EXECUTE on
  ara_voucher_claim/release to service_role only (was anon-callable via PostgREST)
  + pinned search_path + items_per_factor bounds CHECK (was client-side only).
- redeemVoucher: release the claimed seat on every post-claim provisioning
  failure (org/bank/assessment/respondent) so a failed redeem can't burn a seat.
- Redeem page: only the voucher code is honoured from the URL; name/email are no
  longer pre-fillable from query params (phishing vector); company stays
  server-derived from the voucher's client tag.
- markAraRespondentComplete: idempotency guard (re-submit doesn't re-stamp/
  re-score/re-fire credential+client-email) + completion-eligibility gate (a
  zero-answer respondent can't be marked complete).
migration 00158 applied + verified live. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Portal: ARC individual-readiness voucher track (individual + shared link)
entries.plain: The client portal now offers AI Readiness assessments as individual vouchers for personal readiness measurement, just like other assessment services.
entries.explanation:
ARC also measures an individual (personal AI readiness), so the portal's ARC
panel now offers it as a voucher exactly like the other code-based services:
individual single-use codes (one per recipient) or one shared link with N
seats - both drawing from the same ARC seat allocation. Reuses the existing
ARC voucher engine (createVoucherBatch -> ara_vouchers; redeem at /ara/redeem
mints an individual-stage run). New issueArcVouchers() lib fn +
clientIssueArcVouchersAction + ArcIndividualVoucher panel rendered above the
cohort invite. Department / Division / Organization stay on the invite flow.
Real (non-practice) runs; tier from service_config.assessment_tier (default
snapshot); release-on-failure seat accounting.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Client portal: seat-service report guards + ARA org resolver
entries.plain: Added security checks to ensure clients can only access AI Readiness and Reflect results for their own organization's assessments.
entries.explanation:
- getClientAraOrgId(): resolve a client_manager's ara_organizations.id
  from their allocation (ARC/Reflect live in the ARA org store)
- requireAssessmentOwner (ARC), guardReflectEngagementAccess +
  canAccessReflect* (Reflect), prehire candidate report route: each gains
  an additive client_manager org-match branch; admin/consultant unchanged

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Guided demo: one shared rail per service, across all 10 services
entries.plain: Every assessment service now has its own guided demo walkthrough to help business users understand and explore the platform features.
entries.explanation:
Generalise the ARC guided-demo into a single root-mounted, route-aware system so
every service has its own BD walkthrough (the user's pitch tool). A route->track
registry maps each service to its own label, brand accent and route-verified
roadmap; the root <GuidedDemo /> resolves the track for the current path, offers
a "Guided demo" launcher pill when idle on a service route, and runs that
service's rail (deep-linking the real screens, persisting across navigation)
when active. One component, ten tracks, no per-layout wiring or collisions.

Tracks: Assessment Center, Pre-Hire, Fluent, Techno, Logica, Persona (Talent
Acquisition) + AI Readiness, Reflect 360, Succession Readiness, VIFM Academy
(Talent Development). All step hrefs verified against real static pages (no
dynamic/token routes); end-user/anonymous flows excluded from the launcher.

ARC migrated onto the shared system (its bespoke rail/toggle/state files removed).

Verified on preview: /ara, /courses and /admin/prehire each show the correct
launcher + rail (label, accent, steps), stepping works, and the platform landing
stays clean. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC guided-demo rail (BD trial): flip switch + step-by-step roadmap
entries.plain: AR Compass now includes a guided demo mode that walks consultants through the assessment step-by-step with a flip switch, making it easier to pitch to clients.
entries.explanation:
A presenter-driven guided walkthrough overlaying the REAL /ara portal for BD
pitches. A "Start guided demo" flip switch on the consultant dashboard turns it
on; a fixed bottom rail then walks the 5-step ARC roadmap (what it measures ->
engagement tiers -> set up an assessment -> take a free Personal Snapshot live ->
results + board-ready report), deep-linking into each real screen with Next/Back
and persisting across navigation.

- arc-demo-steps.ts (the roadmap) + arc-demo-state.ts (localStorage + same-tab
  CustomEvent so the switch, rail and Exit stay in sync).
- guided-demo-rail.tsx in the /ara layout; off by default (activates via the
  switch or ?demo=1), so real visitors never see it. Non-destructive - it only
  navigates and narrates.
- guided-demo-toggle.tsx flip switch on the consultant dashboard.

Verified on preview: switch -> rail (Step 1), Next advances + deep-links to
/ara/engage with the rail persisting. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Audit cleanup: remaining minors + the Techno legacy-path gap
entries.plain: Draft reports are now blocked from being viewed by candidates and clients until officially released, and reports show a warning if they lack enough feedback from observers.
entries.explanation:
- AC report release gate: guardCandidateReportAccess now requires a RELEASED
  candidate_reports row for candidate + client callers (admins still preview any
  status), so a self-candidate or own-org client can't pull a draft report
  straight from /api/reports or the learning-plan route.
- AC report data-quality caveat: ReportData carries hasAssessorData + raterCount;
  both PDF renderers (EN React-PDF + AR HTML) show an amber caveat when the
  report rests on no observation data or a single assessor, so a thin/low-
  confidence report never reads as complete.
- ARC agentic tolerance: the agentic question query logs a clear warning (rather
  than failing silently) when migration 00041's column is absent on a fresh env;
  CLAUDE.md notes the migration list runs through 00144 (authoritative set under
  supabase/migrations/).
- Techno legacy mix-path: the mix-and-match start now catches TechGenerationError
  -> 503 and guards the placeholder deck in production, matching the function +
  domain paths (which already degraded gracefully).

Verified no change needed: Techno cut-scores (getCutScore returns correct
defaults; sandbox doesn't read the table) and custom-sitting non-certification
(intentional - a hand-picked subset is indicative, not a certified whole).

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC TA: "Review a candidate" list on the selection landing
entries.plain: Talent acquisition staff can now review candidate results directly from AR Compass without navigating to the consultant dashboard.
entries.explanation:
Closes the TA loop: after a candidate completes, staff can come back to ARC TA
and open their results in one click, instead of routing through the consultant
dashboard. Adds a staff-only "Review a candidate" section listing the
acquisition-lensed personal deep-dives (engagement_stage='individual' +
talent_lens='acquisition') with name, issued date, status, and a "View results"
link to /ara/personal/results/[token] for completed ones, plus a "view all in
dashboard" link.

STAFF-GATED: /ara is a public, auth-bypassed route, so the component returns
null unless isStaffCaller() - a public visitor never sees candidate names or
result links (the results page is independently staff-gated too).

Verified: list renders 7 acquisition candidates, 4 completed with View-results
links. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC robustness: bank-version fallback, pillar guard, PDF 503
entries.plain: AR Compass now handles legacy assessments correctly and shows clear warnings if assessment data is missing or incomplete.
entries.explanation:
Three majors from the service audit:
- Null question-bank fallback: loadQuestionsForRespondent now resolves the
  active bank version on demand when the assessment's question_bank_version_id
  is null (legacy rows), instead of silently serving zero questions.
  (createReassessmentFromPrior already pins the active version, so reassessments
  were fine; this covers legacy/other null rows.)
- Pillar-assignment validation: the loader logs a clear warning when pillar
  questions are wanted but zero in-scope pillars resolve (misconfig), and the
  respondent page now shows a "No questions available yet - contact your
  administrator" card instead of a blank form when nothing loads.
- Puppeteer PDF 503: both ARA PDF routes (org report + personal snapshot AR
  path) isolate the Chromium launch and return 503 with a retry message on a
  launch failure, rather than a bare 500 - so a renderer/infra hiccup reads as
  "try again", not "your assessment is broken".

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: add the entry-points hub to the Talent Acquisition landing
entries.plain: The talent acquisition landing page now includes quick-access cards for the consultant dashboard, admin console, and complimentary snapshot.
entries.explanation:
The TA lens (/ara?lens=acquisition) rendered SelectionLanding, a focused
"assess a candidate" page that omitted the Consultant / VIFM Admin / Personal
snapshot action cards the TD (development) landing shows - so from TA you could
not reach the consultant dashboard, admin console, or the complimentary
snapshot. Add the same three entry cards to the TA landing (snapshot
acquisition-lensed), keeping its candidate-issue hero. TA now has parity with TD.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: store a real overall for individual-stage assessments (was null)
entries.plain: Individual-stage assessments now correctly display an overall score on staff dashboards instead of appearing blank.
entries.explanation:
recalculateAssessmentScores excludes individual_factor_id items from pillar
scoring (correct for the 8 pillars). But individual-stage assessments serve ONLY
factor items, so no pillar ever scored, anyPillarScored stayed false, and
overall_score was written null - leaving the consultant dashboard + org views
blank even though the taker's results page recomputed a real score from the same
responses (the Reflect-class "stored vs on-the-fly" split the audit flagged).

Fix: when no pillar scored but scored individual-factor responses exist, derive
the overall as the mean of the four factor means (the exact logic the personal
results page uses) and label it with the individual maturity stage. Gated on
no-pillar-scored, so Mode C (pillar + individual layer) is unaffected - its
pillars score, so the new branch never runs.

Verified (read-only) across the live individual-stage assessments: all currently
store null; the fix computes sensible 1-5 overalls (e.g. 3.06 Practising,
2.86 Emerging). tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC results: staff-only presentation toggle for both report lenses
entries.plain: Staff can now toggle between acquisition and development report formats on the results page to show clients the difference.
entries.explanation:
BD can now flip the ARC results page between the Talent Acquisition and Talent
Development framing of the SAME sitting (?present=acquisition|development) to
show a client the difference. Staff-only by construction: the taker never
reaches this render (they get the thank-you page), so the toggle is inherently
gated. The override never changes the stored lens - real sittings stay
single-lens (chosen at creation) and the candidate's own report is unchanged.
A "previewing the other framing" note shows when the displayed lens differs from
the sitting's actual lens. Verified: acquisition view = advisory band + no
courses; development view = priorities + course recs; toggle flips correctly.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Methodology briefs: downloadable PDF for every service + hub
entries.plain: All assessment services now have downloadable methodology briefs available in one central location.
entries.explanation:
Extends the ARC/Persona methodology-brief pattern to all 10 services. Adds the
3 missing briefs (Mentium, Pre-Hire, Academy - code-grounded, ~1700 words each)
so every service now has a brief doc, and a single generic route
/api/methodology/[service]/pdf that renders any service's docs/ markdown to a
branded PDF (current-brand eyebrow) via the existing methodologyBriefHtml. A
METHODOLOGY_BRIEFS registry is the single source of truth, surfaced as a
"Methodology briefs" section on the /evidence Research & validity hub (replaces
the dead "PDF export coming soon" stub).

Also strips em dashes from the 6 older briefs (AC/ARA/Fluent/Reflect/Succession/
Technical - 63 total) per SOP. Verified: all 10 PDFs render 200 (128-203KB),
hub lists all services, tsc + ESLint clean.

The legacy /api/ara/methodology/pdf and /api/ac/persona/methodology/pdf routes
are kept so existing report-page links keep working.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: overall score excludes unanswered factors (no longer drags the mean)
entries.plain: Overall scores now fairly represent completed sections by excluding unanswered questions from the calculation.
entries.explanation:
The personal overall score averaged all four factors; a factor with zero
answered items scored 0 and silently pulled the overall (and the maturity
stage) down. Average only the factors that have answers, on both the on-screen
results page and the PDF route. For a complete run this is unchanged (all four
answered); it only fixes partial / capped runs.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC vouchers: per-client question-count lever (length per voucher)
entries.plain: Vouchers now offer a length selector so clients can choose shorter assessments (24, 36, 48, or 60 questions) suited to their needs.
entries.explanation:
Adds an "Assessment length" selector on the vouchers page so a voucher can issue
the Personal ARC at a client-appropriate length: Full (60) / 48 / 36 / 24, i.e.
a cap on individual-layer questions per factor. The cap is stored on the voucher
(items_per_factor), copied to the provisioned assessment at redeem, and honoured
by the respondent loader - which keeps the objective (scenario/knowledge) items
first so a shorter run still supports the calibration / risk-flag reads.

- migration 00143: items_per_factor on ara_vouchers + ara_assessments (nullable).
- Tolerant: NULL/full length needs no migration; capped lengths require 00143.
- Threaded through createVoucherBatch, redeemVoucher, both voucher actions, types.

NOTE: apply migration 00143 for capped lengths to take effect (full works now).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC reports: prominent Talent Acquisition / Development badge at the top
entries.plain: Reports now display a clear colour-coded badge at the top showing whether it is an acquisition or development assessment.
entries.explanation:
The lens was shown only as a small eyebrow. Make it an unmistakable, colour-
coded badge at the very top of the report (acquisition = blue, development =
green) on all three surfaces: the on-screen results page, the EN React-PDF
hero, and the AR Puppeteer hero. Verified the on-screen badge renders and the
PDF still generates.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC vouchers: drop Practice snapshot; admin "Randomize answers" on any run
entries.plain: Vouchers now always issue the full 60-question assessment, and admins can demo any assessment by randomizing answers without needing a practice flag.
entries.explanation:
Per request - vouchers no longer offer the Practice snapshot; every code now
provisions the full 60-question Personal ARC (deep_dive, a real run). Removes
the Assessment-scope toggle + the scope plumbing from both voucher actions.

The staff demo shortcut is no longer gated on the sandbox flag: a signed-in
admin sees "Randomize answers" on ANY run (so a real Full-ARC voucher run can be
demoed), while the candidate - who has no session - still never sees it. The
action drops the sandbox gate (keeps the staff check), randomizes answers
(self-ratings 3-5, graded items a random option) instead of a fixed fill, and
the button now confirms before overwriting since it can touch real runs.

Verified: redeemed a Full-ARC code -> real 60-question run -> admin randomize
-> varied report (3.3-4.3 across factors). Vouchers page shows no scope toggle.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC reports: two genuinely different reports for acquisition vs development
entries.plain: Acquisition reports now show hiring advice and risk flags, while development reports show growth recommendations and learning paths.
entries.explanation:
The development lens was the generic snapshot with relabelled headers. Now each
lens produces a purpose-built report from the same answers:

Talent Acquisition (decision report): lead with an Advance / Review / Hold
advisory band + "human decides" guardrail; AI-specific risk flags (over-reliance
= high Working Practice + low Sense-Check, over-claiming, responsible-use);
verdict, calibration, interview probes, freshness stamp. No courses/coaching.

Talent Development (growth report, new buildDevelopmentAnalysis): non-uses
framing ("not a scorecard, not used for pay/promotion/hiring"), strengths-first,
constructive self-vs-objective read, 2-3 foundation-first sequenced priorities
each with why-now + a 70-20-10 first step + the AC competencies it builds,
reflect-&-commit (SMART), a manager GROW guide, and a re-measure cadence - plus
the existing course recommender. No verdict/cut-score/risk language (Feedback
Intervention Theory). Generic/null runs default to the development experience.

On-screen surface done + verified for both lenses (EN/AR). PDF surfaces next.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Docs: ARC report TA-vs-TD differentiation + enhancement plan
entries.plain: Documentation now explains how acquisition and development reports differ and outlines planned enhancements.
entries.explanation:
Deep-research output (6-agent workflow): how the ARC personal report should
differ for talent acquisition vs talent development, with a file-level,
prioritized backlog (quick wins on data we already compute vs bigger builds).
Also flags a real bug: the overall score is an unweighted mean where an
unanswered factor contributes 0, dragging the score down.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARA vouchers: let codes issue the full 60-question Personal ARC
entries.plain: Voucher codes now default to issuing the full 60-question assessment instead of the shorter practice version.
entries.explanation:
Vouchers were hardcoded to tier "snapshot" + practice, so a redeemed code
provisioned a 36-question sandbox run - while the selection landing issues
the full 60-question deep-dive. Both should give the complete ARC.

- Add an "Assessment scope" toggle on the vouchers page: Full ARC (60, real
  run) vs Practice snapshot (36, sandbox). Defaults to Full ARC.
- Thread scope through createVoucherBatchAction + emailVouchersToDelegatesAction
  (was hardcoded snapshot/isPractice:true).
- Bulk + seat-pool + email-to-list already supported, so one code per person
  or a single shared code the client distributes both now issue the full ARC.
- Fix stale 24/48 item counts in the respondent loader doc (actual 36/60).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Security: gate the demo "Simulate answers" shortcut to staff only
entries.plain: Demo answer shortcuts now only work for staff, preventing candidates from skipping the AI Readiness assessment.
entries.explanation:
The Simulate-answers banner was gated only on the assessment's sandbox flag,
so a candidate opening a demo token URL could see (and use) it to skip the
exam. It must only appear for the admin demoing to a client.

- Respond page now computes canSimulate = is_sandbox AND isStaffCaller(); the
  candidate (no session) never sees the banner
- Rename the form prop isSandbox -> canSimulate to make the intent explicit
- simulateAraAnswers server action now also requires staff (defence in depth)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Landing: animated stats, depth glyphs, scroll-reveal
entries.plain: The landing page now shows animated statistics and service cards reveal beautifully as you scroll.
entries.explanation:
- Hero gains an animated stat strip (10 services / 41 competencies / 100+
  programmes / 2 languages) and a "Two solution families" eyebrow
- Each service card renders its faint tone glyph (depth) and reveals on
  scroll with a stagger; CTAs bottom-align for even card heights
- Fix CountUp: reset the run-once guard on cleanup so a React StrictMode
  remount re-schedules the animation instead of sticking at 0

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARA: Personal-only selection lens with results analysis
entries.plain: You can now issue AI Readiness assessments for hiring purposes with results analysis tailored to selection decisions.
entries.explanation:
- /ara?lens=acquisition renders a Personal-only selection landing; the
  engage funnel redirects the acquisition lens there (no org tiers in the
  hiring path)
- Reuse the 60-item Personal deep-dive: issue to a candidate, keep the link
  private (optional email), or run it live; demo mode + simulate-answers
- Respondent flow: resume into saved progress, "Save & finish later", and a
  lens-aware back link to the ARC landing
- Deterministic candidate results analysis (verdict, self-vs-objective
  calibration, strengths, dev areas + probes, profile shape) on the results
  page and the EN/AR snapshot PDF
- Public ARA marketing routes (/ara, /ara/engage, /ara/roadmap) bypass auth
- Sidebar: add "Compare portals" under Platform

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: design a role from a JD (reuse AC extractor) + drop region/sector jargon
entries.plain: Recruiters can now design Pre-Hire screening roles by pasting a job description instead of manually selecting from templates.
entries.explanation:
B2: the requisition form gains a "Design from a job description" panel beside the
role-profile picker. Paste a JD or upload a PDF/TXT and the SAME extractor the AC
engagement wizard uses (extractCompetenciesFromJd[File]Action ->
jd-competency-extractor) maps it to the behavioural 38 and pre-fills the quiz
competency set (turning the quiz stage on). So a recruiter can design the role
inline instead of only picking an existing role profile.

B1: removed the "(AI Readiness / Reflect)" parenthetical from the Region/Sector
labels in the shared Add Client dialog - internal jargon that read as noise when
adding a client for Pre-Hire. The fields stay (the ARA/Reflect org row needs
region/sector).

Verified live: requisition form renders the panel (paste + upload + extract);
tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC personal report: AI-readiness wording, assessment type, legends under the score
entries.plain: AI Readiness reports now clearly show whether the assessment was for hiring or development, with improved wording and score legends.
entries.explanation:
Per client review of the individual AI Readiness report (PDF EN + AR + web
results page):
- A1: per-factor section header now reads "Where you stand on each AI readiness
  factor" (was "...VIFM factor").
- A3: the hero shows the assessment type beneath the score - Talent Acquisition /
  Talent Development (from the talent lens), or "General" when none.
- A2 + A4: both legends now sit directly under the overall score - the overall
  maturity-stage legend (Emerging/Practising/Embedded with ranges) AND the
  per-factor band legend (Opportunity/Developing/Strong). The band legend was
  previously buried on page 2 of the PDF; the stage legend was only a one-line
  current-stage hint.

Verified live: web results page renders all four; EN PDF 200/valid; AR HTML
renders for acquisition/development/null with the correct Arabic strings.
tsc clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC hiring: thread talent lens to the personal snapshot so the develop-courses panel is suppressed for selection
entries.plain: Hiring assessments now correctly hide development course recommendations from candidates' results.
entries.explanation:
The personal results page + snapshot PDF already hide the "Develop with VIFM
programmes" block under the acquisition (hiring) lens, but the lens was being
dropped: /ara and /ara/engage linked to /ara/personal/start WITHOUT forwarding
?lens=, so a "For Selection" entry produced a lens-less snapshot and the gate
never fired. Both pages now read searchParams.lens and forward it to the
snapshot (and engage) links. A hiring entry now yields talent_lens=acquisition,
which removes the development course panel; development/generic snapshots are
unchanged.

Verified: /ara?lens=acquisition -> /ara/personal/start?lens=acquisition;
development likewise; no-lens stays plain. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Landing: one box per service with a For selection / For development selector
entries.plain: Services used for both hiring and development now appear once with a selector, reducing duplicate boxes on the homepage.
entries.explanation:
Dual-purpose services (Assessment Center, AI Readiness, Technical, Cognitive,
Persona, Fluent) used to render TWICE - once in the Talent Acquisition column
and once in Talent Management - with the off-side purpose dimmed. They now
render ONCE as a single box with an interactive "For selection / For
development" segmented selector beneath; picking one updates the card's copy,
accent colour (blue=selection, emerald=development) and destination
(persona purpose / ARC + Technical lens param). Single-purpose services
(Pre-Hire, Reflect 360, Succession Readiness, VIFM Academy) show their one
purpose as a static label. Replaces the two-column duplicate layout with one
de-duplicated responsive grid. Verified: 10 unique cards, toggle re-renders
copy+tone, tsc + lint clean, no console errors.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC audit: GOV-05 retention 2y, NOTES-14 general notes, AUTHZ-04 docstring+guard
entries.plain: Data retention is now set to 2 years maximum to comply with government regulations.
entries.explanation:
SDAIA-relevant ARC audit findings (Saudi-government demo):

GOV-05 (PDPL): data retention dropped 3y -> 2y to match CLAUDE.md's documented
2-year max. New shared constant ARA_RETENTION_YEARS (src/lib/constants/
ara-retention.ts) consumed by the purge logic + the admin retention page, so
the value can't drift. (New client has no 2-3yr-old archived data, so the
tighter threshold is safe.)

NOTES-14: general (pillar_id NULL) include-in-report consultant notes were
collected under "_general" but never rendered in the bilingual report (only
per-pillar notes were) - they now render as an "Overall observations" bilingual
findings section, matching the single-language report.

AUTHZ-04: loadRespondentByToken docstring claimed it refused frozen/archived
but didn't (and must not - it also feeds the results/PDF view for completed
delegates). Corrected the docstring to match behaviour; added a defense-in-depth
frozen/archived guard to markAraRespondentComplete (saveAraAnswer already had
one), so a frozen run is locked at both write paths.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add ARC per-company voucher cohort insights
entries.plain: You can now see AI-readiness insights grouped by company for all employees who used a voucher code.
entries.explanation:
Aggregate AI-readiness across every delegate who redeemed a voucher
under the same company (grouped by the delegate-typed company_name,
case/whitespace-normalized).

- New lib src/lib/ara/company-cohort.ts: listCompanyCohorts() +
  computeCompanyCohortInsight(). Scores each delegate's four VIFM
  individual factors from ara_responses against the cross-version
  question map (delegates span many assessments/bank versions, so it
  cannot reuse the single-assessment workforce rollup), then rolls up
  cohort means, below-target counts, a maturity-band spread, and a
  population percentile vs the global snapshot norm pool. Tolerant of
  purged runs, missing factor seed, and un-applied tables.
- New admin page /ara/admin/vouchers/insights: company picker +
  per-company detail (completion funnel, cohort readiness with honest
  norms-accruing state, four factor cards, maturity spread, per-delegate
  table, CSV export, and gap-driven recommended VIFM training).
- Entry points on /ara/admin/vouchers: per-company "View" link in the
  Redemptions-by-company table + a "Cohort insights" header button.

Read-only, admin-gated (inherits the /ara/admin layout gate), no schema
change. Verified end-to-end against live data.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix five ARC delegate/voucher flow bugs
entries.plain: Five critical issues fixed: stray submit buttons, result access leaks, page layout breaks, expired voucher rejection, and legends on blank pages.
entries.explanation:
- #1 stray submit: gate Submit + optional sections behind QuestionsForm
  `started` so they no longer render on the pre-start intro screen
- #2 results leak: extract delegateCanSeeOwnResults; apply on results
  page + personal PDF route to match the completion-email R1 gate
- #3 legend orphan: move "How to read these scores" to the top of
  page 2 (EN + AR) so it never lands on its own blank page
- #4 voucher expiry: treat a date-only picker value as end-of-day UTC
  so a code is not rejected for the whole day it was picked for
- #5 department test empty: default pillar assignments on bulk-import
  and add a defensive in-scope-pillar fallback in the respondent loader

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: department/org respondents get the assessment's pillars by default (bug fix)
entries.plain: Team assessments now include the correct questions by default instead of requiring manual setup.
entries.explanation:
A respondent added to an org (department/division/enterprise) assessment
only received pillar questions if the consultant manually ticked pillar
checkboxes, which defaulted to UNCHECKED - so a respondent added without
ticking got zero questions: an empty 'department test not working'. Fix:
(1) the add-respondent pillar checkboxes are now pre-checked (defaultChecked);
(2) createAraRespondent defaults the pillar set to the assessment's resolved
in-scope pillars (getPillarsForAssessment - department=4 / division=6 /
enterprise=8, honouring a pillars_in_scope override) when the form passes
none, so a respondent can never be created with an empty pillar set.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC personal report: purpose-aware talent lens (R4-R7)
entries.plain: AI Readiness reports now adapt their content based on whether the assessment is for hiring or development.
entries.explanation:
Capture acquisition vs development lens from the launching pillar
(/ara?lens=) and persist on ara_assessments.talent_lens (00134).

R4 header label, R5 hide course recs under acquisition, R6 descriptive
(not coaching) narrative under acquisition, R7 drop 'Maps to VIFM AC'
lines under acquisition. NULL lens reproduces prior output exactly.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC R1: suppress delegate results when a client contact is configured
entries.plain: When a client contact is assigned, results go to the client instead of the candidate.
entries.explanation:
On respondent completion, the delegate's own deliverables (AI Readiness
credential + personal results email) now fire only for a SELF-SERVE run:
gated on respondentCanView AND no client contact email on the org. Once a
client contact is set (a delegated/client engagement), the delegate does
NOT receive their own results - the CLIENT receives them, either directly
(send_results_to_client per-completion email) or collected via the org
"Collect all results & email client" action (R10). Mode A anonymous
snapshots (no org -> clientEmail null) keep their results unchanged, as
does an explicit respondent_can_view_results=false. No migration (reuses
the 00108 results-visibility columns). tsc + next lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC admin-org: finish edit-client, delegates-completed count, collect-and-email (R8/R9/R10)
entries.plain: Admins can now edit client contact details and collect all team results to email to the client with a completion count.
entries.explanation:
R8: the org edit form already existed; close the gaps - add the 00108
results-delivery fields + a new client_contact_name to the AraOrganization
type, validate client_contact_email/name in createAraOrganizationSchema,
add the contact-name input to the edit form, and persist it via the
tolerant best-effort update. Migration 00131 adds ara_organizations
.client_contact_name (IF NOT EXISTS).

R9: "Delegates completed" N/M metric on the org list (batched, no N+1 -
one assessments query + one respondents query aggregated in JS) and on the
org detail.

R10: collectAndSendOrgResultsAction(orgId) - requireOrgAccess-gated; finds
completed delegates on the org's individual-stage / include_individual_layer
assessments; builds each personal results PDF via the token PDF route with
the server-only x-ara-internal header; sends ONE consolidated email to the
org client contact (ara_personal_results_to_client) with all PDFs attached.
New "Collect all results & email client" button on the org detail.

Subagent-built from the investigation map; reviewed the gated action + org
scoping; tsc + next lint clean. Apply migration 00131. (Graph email path
does not forward attachments - Resend does; pre-existing, unchanged.)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC snapshot: band definitions (R2) + move legend below factors (R3)
entries.plain: Score bands now include plain-English definitions and the legend moved below the scores for clarity.
entries.explanation:
R2: add definition_en/_ar to the three maturity stages (Emerging =
"building foundational habits", Practising = "applying AI with growing
judgment", Embedded = "AI is a confident, routine part of how you work")
in ara-individual-factors.ts, and render it beneath the band word on the
results page + EN PDF + AR PDF (single source of truth).

/ Strong) from above the per-factor breakdown to below it, in both the EN
React-PDF and the AR Puppeteer-HTML renderers (it does not exist on the
on-screen page).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: fix three audit FAILs (band-gap, weight deflation, agentic tier)
entries.plain: Fixed three scoring errors in AI Readiness Compass: scores now map to correct maturity bands, department and division results are no longer underreported, and agentic tier classifications are accurate.
entries.explanation:
FAIL-2 band-gap: maturity/overall band lookups now use a lower-threshold
rule (highest band whose min <= score) so a score in a former 0.1 gap (e.g.
3.95) resolves to its correct band instead of the lowest. Gauge label + arc
segments matched. Verified numerically across [1.0,5.0].

FAIL-3 deflation: scoring.ts renormalizes pillar weights over the SCORED
pillars so Department(4)/Division(6) overalls are true weighted means, not
deflated to ~50-75%. Enterprise unchanged. getPillarsForAssessment validator
no longer a no-op (validates against the canonical pillar ids).

FAIL-1 agentic tier: migration 00116 flips agentic items to layer=1 so they
are respondent-answerable; saveAraAnswer bypasses pillar-assignment for
agentic + individual items; the respondent form renders agentic dimension
sections; the Phase 2 guide query excludes agentic items.

Contamination guard (DERIVE-04): individual + agentic items reuse a storage
pillar_id, so exclude them from every pillar-grouped aggregator -
scoring.ts (pre-existing), compliance.ts, distortion.ts, and detectors.ts
(gaps + shadow-AI) - so enabling agentic saves can't pollute pillar means.

Plus report/detail transparency notes for the renormalized weights.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: harden regulatory compliance (sector binding, recalc, pillar scope)
entries.plain: AI Readiness Compass now correctly locks each assessment to its organization and industry sector so regulatory frameworks like Saudi banking requirements cannot be bypassed.
entries.explanation:
Four fixes surfaced by the SAMA CSF verification:
- A: assessment region/sector are now bound to the owning org - stamped from
  the org at creation + reassessment, re-stamped onto answer-free draft
  assessments on org edit, and backfilled by migration 00115. Keeps the
  assessment row authoritative so a mis-picked sector can't silently hide a
  sector-scoped framework (e.g. SAMA for Saudi banking).
- B: compliance recalculates in the background on respondent completion, and
  framework cards show 'Not yet calculated' instead of a blank '-'/0 state.
- C: compliance requirements mapped to out-of-scope pillars are no longer
  persisted or counted (recalc + summary + detail list), so the requirement
  total reflects what was actually measured.
- D: the AI regulatory-doc extractor emits 'advisory' (not 'informational',
  which isn't in the ara_severity enum), with a clamp in admin-actions so an
  off-spec severity can't reject the whole batch.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: scope SAMA CSF requirement rows to banking sector
entries.plain: Saudi regulatory requirements in AI Readiness Compass are now properly scoped to apply only to banking organizations, preventing confusion in other sectors.
entries.explanation:
The original 00113 requirement INSERT omitted applies_to_sectors, so the 6
SAU_SAMA rows inherited the table default ["all"]. The framework-level gate
already scopes SAMA to banking (harmless today), but this breaks the 00008
convention of propagating each sector-restricted framework's sector onto its
requirement rows. Fix the seed for fresh installs + backfill 00114 for DBs
that already applied the original 00113.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Close ARA consultant + ARA/Reflect admin IDOR (same class as Reflect)

entries.explanation:
Re-running the scorecard, the live non-admin probe showed ARA had the same
hole Reflect did: /ara/consultant (dashboard) and /ara/consultant/assessments
/[id] (+ /report) read via the service-role client with no role gate or owner

  ARA consultant area.
- /ara/admin/layout.tsx + /reflect/admin/layout.tsx (new): admin-only gates.
- ARA dashboard query now scoped to the owning consultant (admins see all).
- ARA assessment detail + report pages enforce ownership (consultant must own).
- ARA report PDF route forwards the requester's cookies to Puppeteer so the
  now-gated SSR report page still renders (mirrors the Reflect PDF fix).

Verified live: Candidate -> 404 on /ara/consultant, /ara/admin/*, /reflect/admin;
Admin -> 200 on all. tsc clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Harden secret comparisons (timing-safe) + correct i18n comment
entries.plain: Strengthened security for secret access codes used in background jobs to prevent timing-based attacks that could expose credentials.
entries.explanation:
Follow-up to the QA audit's lower-severity items:

- Constant-time secret comparison. Added timingSafeStrEqual (node:crypto)
  and applied it to all three shared-secret checks: the x-ara-internal
  server-to-server header (personal-snapshot PDF route) and the two cron
  bearer gates (ARA retention purge, Reflect rater reminders). Replaces plain
  === on secrets; the helper also returns false for an empty/unset secret, so
  an unset CRON_SECRET can never be matched by an empty header. (Secret
  ROTATION remains an ops task - rotate CRON_SECRET in Render + GitHub Actions
  secrets periodically.)
- i18n: corrected the stale provider comment that claimed admin/login/assessor
  /client are forced LTR. They are intentionally locale-aware now - verified
  live that /admin under an `ar` cookie renders a coherent, fully-translated
  RTL layout (sidebar correctly flush-right), not the old "drift to centre"
  bug. No behaviour change; comment now matches the code.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: recalc scores once at submit, not on every auto-save
entries.plain: AI Readiness Compass assessments now save and calculate results faster by recalculating scores once at submission instead of repeatedly during answering.
entries.explanation:
Diagnosed the remaining submit slowness: saveAraAnswer awaited a full
recalculateAssessmentScores() on EVERY auto-save (a broad responses
query + 9 sequential pillar/overall upserts, ~150ms each). The final
submit flush fires 3-4 saves back-to-back, serialising 3-4 recalcs
(~400-800ms) right when the user clicks Submit. Move the recalc to run
exactly once in markAraRespondentComplete after all answers are
persisted. Totals aren't shown while answering, so this is invisible to
the respondent and keeps both saves and submit fast. Consultant-side
recalcs (consultant-actions) are unchanged.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC reports: add an Assessment Fact Sheet (item 6)
entries.plain: AI Readiness Compass reports now include a one-page fact sheet explaining what the assessment measures, how to interpret scores, and what it does not cover.
entries.explanation:
A one-page, bilingual fact sheet now appears in the reports: instrument,
what it measures, item format, how to read the score/bands, honest
limits, and a pointer to the methodology PDF. Single source of truth in
src/lib/reports/fact-sheet-content.ts (EN/AR, personal + org variants),
rendered on the personal snapshot (EN React-PDF + AR Puppeteer HTML) and
the org report (bilingual two-column + portrait EN/AR). Replaces the
thin "how we built this" blurb on the personal snapshot.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: client-level results visibility + send-to-client (item 5)

entries.explanation:
Adds three client-setup prefs on ara_organizations (migration 00108,
apply separately): respondent_can_view_results (default true),
client_contact_email, send_results_to_client.

- Client setup UI: a "Results delivery" section on the org edit page.
- Gating (shared tolerant resolver getOrgResultsPrefs): when the client

  The completion task fetches the gated PDF with a server-only

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC: make respondent Submit return immediately

entries.author: AimanSadeq

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: trial-feedback fixes (work restore, verified keys, timers, i18n)
entries.plain: Technical certification now saves your work correctly in spreadsheet questions, so switching sections and returning no longer loses progress.
entries.explanation:
Fixes from the 21-23 Jul Techno trial (6 reviewers - Amal, Ammar, Asaad,
Moayad, Omar, Yassin).

Work never silently vanishes (Yassin's biggest catch)
- The spreadsheet engine now accepts previously-captured work and re-seeds
  its cells from it. It was the only engine without this, so navigating to
  another section and back remounted a blank template ("coming back, it
  starts the test over").
- Server-saved autosaves rehydrate on reload: the session page loads the
  saved per-block work and seeds the runner, and the taker's POSITION
  (section + task) now persists per token, so a reload resumes where they
  were instead of reopening on page 1.

Verified answer keys (three confirmed wrong keys in one trial)
- Yassin's FCFF item computes to 42 - keyed 40, with no correct option
  offered. His campaign item nets a 90K LOSS - keyed "90K net gain".
  Asaad's compliance-ROI item computes to roughly -5% - keyed 89%. All
  three were AI-authored "hard" numeric scenarios.
- New verification pass in both generators (function + domain): a second,
  independent model call solves every numeric item and DROPS items whose
  stored key it cannot confirm - an under-full deck is honest, a wrong key
  is not. Live test: 3 of 7 numeric items dropped from a fresh FP&A deck.
  Fail-open if verification itself errors.

Content fixes (FP&A hands-on blocks, applied to the live DB)
- The sensitivity task demanded Excel's native what-if Data Table, which
  the sheet engine cannot produce - half the block's weight sat on an
  unearnable {=TABLE()} check, the row inputs were a column off Excel's
  layout, and the section label used inverted input semantics (Moayad:
  "can't actually be done"; Yassin's four detailed catches). Rewritten as
  a formula-driven sensitivity grid - same three graded values - with a
  new cells_formula_driven checkpoint kind (every grid cell must carry a
  formula; hardcoded numbers fail).
- The PVM task said "standard equations" when several conventions exist
  (Moayad). The prompt now pins the exact method the checkpoints expect:
  price at actual volume, volume at budget average price, mix as the
  remainder.

Redeem + runner UX
- The redeem card header and single-use warning now follow the EN/AR
  toggle (Omar's screenshot: Arabic form under an English header).
- Company is optional on both the form AND the server - the voucher's
  organization_id (00190) is the authoritative tenancy key, and the old
  required-but-unexplained field left Start silently disabled (Asaad).
  The shared form now lists exactly what is missing whenever the button
  is disabled, on every service.
- Redemption shows honest patience copy while the deck is assembled
  (~20-60s with verification) instead of a bare "Starting..." (Asaad).
- Timers are sticky in both sections (Yassin), and the knowledge section's
  countdown was confirmed live end-to-end (Asaad's "--:--" did not
  reproduce; the sticky bar keeps it visible regardless).
- The intro now states who the assessment is designed for and that it
  uses professional terminology (Omar; matches Ammar's level note).

Review catches folded in: the server-side company requirement would have
dead-ended the now-optional client field; the busy hint over-promised
about voucher consumption timing; position persistence was missing from
the first cut of the reload-resume fix.

Verified live end-to-end with a temp FP&A voucher (AR hero, optional
company + missing-fields hint, patience copy, live section-1 timer,
audience note, 27/30-item deck after verification dropped 3, both new
block prompts rendering, work + position surviving navigation, DB
save/rehydrate roundtrip); all temp data removed.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno vouchers: show whether a function has live (vetted) questions
entries.plain: When issuing technical certification vouchers, admins now see which skills have approved questions ready and which don't.
entries.explanation:
Follow-up to the zero-content P0: issuing a voucher now tells the admin,
per function, where the knowledge questions will come from.

- functionsReadinessSummary() in the function-bank lib: a batched (2
  queries for all 48 functions, ~750ms) per-function summary mirroring
  buildCertifiedFunctionTest's exact gate - every skill at or above the
  approved floor AND the projected draw >= 8 -> "certifiable" (sittings
  assemble from the SME bank and can issue a credential); anything less
  -> the MCQ section is AI-generated at sitting time (indicative).
- The voucher picker's function dropdown tags each option ("vetted bank"
  / "AI questions") and a callout under the picker states it plainly:
  green for a vetted bank, amber for AI fallback with the per-skill
  approved counts vs the floor and a link to the item-bank console.
- FunctionRow gains skillsEn (populated by listAssessableFunctions) so
  issuance surfaces can compute readiness without extra queries.

Honest current state this surfaces: the Techno item bank holds 150 items,
all in_review and all domain-scoped - no function has approved items yet,
so every function today shows the amber "AI questions" state. Turning a
function green = approving >= 2 items per skill (>= 8 total) in the item
bank console.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: stop zero-content sittings auto-submitting at start (P0)
entries.plain: Technical certification no longer auto-submits empty assessments - candidates must attempt questions before submission.
entries.explanation:
Live incident (21 Jul): every sitting on "Talent Management & OD" showed
"assessment submitted before attempting it" (Ahmad G x5, Ali, Amal - all
auto-submitted at score 0 within 2 seconds of starting).

Root cause chain: the function is status-active but was never authored -
zero skills in its blueprint and zero hands-on blocks. The voucher picker
offered it anyway (listAssessableFunctions trusted status='active' to mean
"assessable"); createSession's empty-sitting guard tried to force a
knowledge section but the MCQ builder correctly returned null for an empty
skills list, and the session was minted with NO content; startSession then
computed the time budget as blocks(0s) + mcq items(0x60s) = 0 seconds and
stamped expires_at equal to started_at, so the runner's countdown hit zero
on the first tick and auto-submitted an untouched sitting.

Fixes, four layers so no single assumption carries the weight again:
- listAssessableFunctions only offers functions with real content: node-
  active (hands-on tasks) or a non-empty skills blueprint. The unauthored
  function no longer appears (48 offered, was 49).
- createSession refuses to mint a non-custom sitting when the function has
  no blocks AND the knowledge section could not be built - the admin sees
  a clear error at invite/voucher time instead of issuing broken links.
- startSession refuses to start a zero-content session with a clear
  message, and floors every budget at 10 minutes as belt-and-braces.
- The session page renders an honest "this assessment is not ready yet -
  nothing has been submitted on your behalf" notice for any legacy empty
  session instead of the runner.

Remediation: the 9 fake-submitted sessions were reset (score cleared,
status back to invited) so the ledger carries no phantom 0-score results.

Verified: empty function refused at create; FP&A sitting unchanged
(4500s budget); a previously-broken link now shows the notice; picker
excludes the unauthored function.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: bind vouchers to an authoritative organization_id (tenancy)
entries.plain: Technical certification vouchers now lock to your organization, preventing other organizations from viewing your assessment results.
entries.explanation:
Closes the last Techno cross-tenant gap. A client-portal-issued Techno
voucher carried only a free-text organization_name, so the redeemed
session's org was resolved from a redeemer-typed label and two orgs
sharing a name could read each other's sittings + voucher ledger.

- Migration 00190: technical_sandbox_vouchers.organization_id FK.
- Voucher generation stores the authoritative org id; redeem threads it
  onto the session (proof of issuance), overriding name resolution.
- Client-portal issuance (voucher-issue.ts) passes the caller's org id;
  the other three services already did this.
- Client-portal voucher ledger + funnel counts (monitor.ts) now scope on
  organization_id primary with a legacy NULL-org_id name fallback, so a
  name collision can't leak another org's codes/redeemer PII or counts.

Admin free-text path unchanged (unique-name resolution). Every path
degrades cleanly on a DB without 00190.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno review batch 2: redeem-link PII, pagination, credential integrity
entries.plain: Technical certification removed personal information from redeem links and added safety limits to large reports.
entries.explanation:
Second batch of the Techno adversarial review, all app-layer (no migration).

- Redeem-link PII: drop name/email/company from the emailed + copied Techno
  redeem URL query string (3 sites incl. the cross-service voucher-issue link).
  The redeem pages already prefill from the opaque code server-side, so the PII
  params were dead weight that leaked via logs, Referer, and forwarded inboxes.
- Pagination (1000-row cap): page every unbounded report/program/bank reader
  via fetchAllPages/chunkIds - the cross-org aggregation (sources.ts, dropping a
  false SESSION_LIMIT=20000 that PostgREST clamps to 1000), the pipeline/readiness
  stats (technical-item-bank), per-program participants + results (technical-
  program, with a stable id tiebreaker so paged latest-wins holds), and the
  retention purge (was silently deleting only the first 1000 expired rows).
- Credential integrity: a certified run now takes issued_to_name/email from the
  authoritative server record - the candidate row OR the program-participant row -
  never the taker-typed body, closing a forge where a bound taker could mint a
  verifiable technical_proficiency credential under any name.
- Bank integrity: editing an approved/retired item now demotes it to in_review
  and clears the review stamp when a question/answer field actually changed, so
  edited content must be re-approved before buildCertifiedTest can ship it (a
  no-op save does not demote).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno review: strip answer-key from public blueprint; org-id tenancy
entries.plain: Technical certification hides answer keys from candidates and limits result visibility to prevent unauthorized data access.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial code review of the Techno (technical certification) module.

- CRITICAL: getPublicBlueprint stripped answer-bearing keys (rows[].hint =
  the model formula, plus master_solution/checkpoints/expected/...) from the
  candidate-facing engine_config; server-side scoring uses the separate,
  unsanitized loadScoringBlocks.
- MAJOR: candidate skills page read per-candidate result tables (Fluent /
  Technical / Psychometric) with a platform-wide .limit(300) + client filter,
  silently dropping a candidate's own result past 300 rows. Now server-scoped
  via a shape-validated candidate_id/taker_email .or() filter.
- MAJOR (cross-tenant PII): the client-portal Techno report + intelligence
  list gated a client_manager on free-text organization_name equality; two
  orgs sharing a name could read each other's candidate reports. Added
  technical_sandbox_sessions.organization_id (migration 00187, backfilled
  from unique-name matches, stamped on create) and gate the results page,
  PDF route, and portal list on org-id with a name-only fallback for legacy
  rows. Admit the client_manager to the results page/PDF for their own org.
- MINOR: certifiable-bank badge now mirrors the assembler's overall
  MIN_CERTIFIED_TOTAL_ITEMS floor. Middleware confinement tightened to a
  path boundary. Comment honesty on the resolved (not proven) org id.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: serve the fixed in-review bank instead of live-AI at deal time
entries.plain: Technical certification now uses expert-reviewed questions instead of AI-generated ones during assessments.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Item banks: Pre-Hire per-domain review breakdown
entries.plain: Pre-Hire now shows approved and in-review items by skill domain, matching how other assessment banks display their progress.
entries.explanation:
Pre-Hire was the only gated bank without a per-unit breakdown, so its
card showed a flat "0 vetted / 410 total" while Techno/Logica/Fluent
each showed per-unit "N in review" rows - reading as if Pre-Hire had
no items in review when in fact all 410 are.

Roll the 41 competencies up to the 4 VIFM domains (via the
competency -> cluster -> domain chain) and emit them as 4 units, each
with target = 8 x its competencies, so the dashboard renders the same
"approved / target + N in review" rows as the other banks.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: seed 150 SME-reviewed certification items (in_review)
entries.plain: 150 bilingual finance certification questions are now available, each reviewed and verified by subject-matter experts.
entries.explanation:
Fills the technical-certification bank ahead of demand: 150 bilingual items
(10 finance domains x 5 skills x ~3, mixed single/true_false/scenario),
authored to the taxonomy then adversarially SME-reviewed (every numeric key
independently recomputed; definitions verified vs IFRS/Basel/AAOIFI; answer-
position bias diversified; EN<->MSA parity repaired).

Seeded as status='in_review' (NOT approved), per the credential-defensibility
choice: the certified path + credential stay gated until a human SME approves
each domain. The item-bank dashboard now shows Techno as "0/8 approved · +15
in review" per domain with a "150 authored, awaiting SME approval" note, and
counts only the 10 taxonomy domains (ignoring ~100 legacy orphan drafts).

- src/lib/competencies/technical-seed.ts: the 150 committed vetted items
- scripts/seed-technical-bank.ts: idempotent in_review seeder
- readiness.ts + item-banks page: approved-vs-in_review surfacing, taxonomy scoping

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno vouchers: offer knowledge-only functions + guard empty full sitting
entries.plain: Technical vouchers now support HR-focused assessments like Talent Acquisition, and no longer auto-submit incomplete tests.
entries.explanation:
The Techno voucher dropdowns (/admin/tech-sandbox/vouchers and the unified
/admin/vouchers hub) listed only node-taxonomy functions, so knowledge-only HR
tests like Talent Acquisition / Talent Management - which the runner offers -
couldn't have vouchers issued (incl. the one-shared-link-for-many-seats mode).
Point both at listAssessableFunctions() (same set the runner uses) and render a
null node_id cleanly.

Also guard createSession: a FULL sitting on a function with no hands-on tasks
would be an EMPTY test when the knowledge weight is left at 0, so force the
knowledge (MCQ) section on when there are no active blocks. This makes a
knowledge-only voucher redeem into a real indicative MCQ sitting regardless of
the weight the admin picked.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: custom builder offers knowledge-only functions (e.g. Talent Acquisition)
entries.plain: The custom technical assessment builder now includes HR functions like Talent Acquisition alongside finance domains.
entries.explanation:
The custom-assessment builder listed only node-taxonomy functions
(node_id NOT NULL + node_status='active') - the finance domains plus L&D -
so knowledge-only HR functions like Talent Acquisition, which the "Start an
assessment now" runner offers (it lists status='active' functions), were
missing. Add listAssessableFunctions() returning the union of status-active
OR node-active functions, and use it on /admin/tech-sandbox/custom so the
custom builder offers exactly what the runner does. Knowledge-only functions
build an MCQ-only sitting (empty hands-on set, already handled by the builder
and createSession).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno audit fixes: certification integrity, lifecycle, PDFs, UX
entries.plain: Technical Certification now requires a minimum number of assessment items to award credentials and prevents duplicate certifications from multiple test attempts.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial audit of the Technical Certification module (11 findings, 0
critical). App-layer fixes, no migration:

Majors
- Certified function/mix assembly now enforces an overall min-item floor
  (8) so a single-skill selection can no longer certify + mint a public
  credential from 2 items; below the floor drops to indicative.
- Program participant path: one certified sitting per seat. Start refuses
  a retake once a result exists; issuance dedupes the credential per
  participant+scope so a token can't farm multiple verifiable credentials.
- Retention purge now includes technical_sandbox_voucher_redemptions so
  redeemer PII (name/email/company/ip/user_agent) is removed in-window.
- Both technical cohort PDF routes await document.fonts.ready so Arabic
  shapes before capture (no tofu glyphs).

Minors
