- Participant access token rejected once the program is completed/archived.
- Function cohort query filters on the program's own function_key (a mix or
  other-function run no longer surfaces as this function's score).
- Result screen labels "Certified" + green footer only when passedCut; a
  non-passing certified sitting is no longer labelled certified.
- Instructions screen discloses the time limit before Start.
- Server-side time-limit backstop: deadline stamped on the session at start;
  /score rejects a grossly late submission (client countdown unchanged).
- En-dash replaced with a hyphen in the taker-facing band-range string.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Wrap Techno voucher issuance in the 3-step wizard
entries.plain: Technical Certification voucher issuance now uses a guided step-by-step process to set up and distribute tests.
entries.explanation: Keeps the function picker, custom test-builder, CSV export and function column; adds Setup/Delivery/Issue steps + send-to-delegates (upload/paste + email each).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Unify Techno voucher form: identity fields + Techno options callout
entries.plain: Technical Certification voucher forms now have a consistent design with clear labeling.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Voucher consolidation: bilingual redeem for Pre-Hire + Techno (Phase 2 done)
entries.plain: Voucher redemption now works the same way across Pre-Hire and Technical Certification assessments in both English and Arabic.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno: copy redeem link (not code) + save reusable custom assessments
entries.plain: Users can now copy a ready-to-share redemption link instead of a code, and save custom test designs for reuse.
entries.explanation:
- Copy link, not code: the voucher result panels and the custom-builder
  issued rows now copy the redeem LINK (code pre-filled) instead of the
  bare code; the dropped "Copy code"/"Copy codes" buttons are gone and the
  builder's link copy gained the secure-context execCommand fallback.
- Save custom assessments for reuse: a built custom (pick-and-choose)
  design can be named and saved, then loaded/updated/deleted from a
  "Saved assessments" picker - in BOTH the custom builder and the vouchers
  "Custom (shorter trial)" scope. Loading rehydrates skills/tasks/weight
  (Set-safe) and waits for the builder data before applying the selection.
- New table technical_custom_assessments (migration 00166, admin-only RLS
  mirroring the vouchers table) + a server-only lib + admin-guarded
  save/list/delete actions; all reads/writes tolerate an un-applied 00166.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno vouchers: copyable redeem link + custom-built test scope
entries.plain: Technical Certification now offers copyable redemption links and the ability to create custom shorter tests from a function's skills.
entries.explanation:
- Shared "many seats" and single-code results now surface a copyable
  redeem LINK (code pre-filled) so a candidate starts without typing the
  code; add a per-row "Copy link" action in the Existing vouchers table.
- Add a "Custom (shorter trial)" test scope: pick a subset of the
  function's skills and hands-on tasks inline, carried to the redeemed
  sitting via customConfig (indicative, no credential).
- Robust clipboard copy with an execCommand fallback so the buttons work
  over plain HTTP / LAN, not just secure contexts.
- Add getCustomBuilderDataAction to load skills/tasks for the picker.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno audit: credential UNIQUE backstop (00164) + sandbox UX polish
entries.plain: Technical Certification database now prevents accidental duplicate credential issuance and improved sandbox interface clarity.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno audit: harden technical sandbox voucher RPCs (migration 00160)
entries.plain: Technical Certification sandbox voucher system now has hardened security controls to prevent unauthorized access.
entries.explanation:
The claim was already atomic and a release RPC already existed (00078); 00160
adds the SECURITY DEFINER hardening the other instruments got - pinned
search_path + EXECUTE locked to service_role on both technical_sandbox_voucher_
claim/release (were callable by anon via PostgREST). Applied + verified live.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno audit: close credential-replay race + cross-candidate substitution
entries.plain: Fixed critical security issues where credentials could be issued multiple times or assigned to the wrong candidate.
entries.explanation:
The two security-critical fixes on the only credential-issuing instrument:
- loadSession now claims the single-use session ATOMICALLY (UPDATE consumed_at
  null->now ... WHERE consumed_at IS NULL AND not-expired, RETURNING) instead of
  a SELECT-then-UPDATE. Two concurrent /score calls can no longer both pass the
  unconsumed check and both issue a credential (replay / double-issuance closed);
  TTL is enforced in the same atomic step.
- A SESSION run now binds the result + credential to the session's own
  candidate_id/engagement_id (set at start), not the request body - a leaked
  session id can no longer mint a credential under another identity. The
  untrusted items path (indicative-only, no credential) still uses the body.
tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Mobile + copy polish: ARC GCC wording, Techno mobile layout, no h-swipe
entries.plain: Updated messaging for GCC regions, improved mobile layout, and fixed page scrolling issues on phones.
entries.explanation:
- ARC landing tile: "calibrated for Saudi Arabia, UAE, and the wider GCC" (EN + AR).
- Techno framework overview: skill-block rows stack on mobile (source text dropped
  the shrink-0 right column that bled off-screen); side-by-side on sm+.
- Global: html/body overflow-x: clip so a stray wide element can't make the whole
  page pan sideways on phones (clip keeps sticky + inner scroll working).
- Techno overview: relabel the sandbox-editor quick action "Review & edit sandbox
  tasks" so it's distinct from the "Preview the sandbox" launch button.

Verified at 390px: zero horizontal overflow; the previously-bleeding rows now sit
inside the viewport. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rename the Technical Assessment portal to "Techno" (user-facing)
entries.plain: The Technical Assessment portal is now called 'Techno' throughout the platform for consistency with other assessment names.
entries.explanation:
Brand rename like Cognitive->Reason: every user-facing display name of the
Technical Assessment portal is now "Techno" (Arabic "تكنو") - sidebar nav,
admin hub + landing service cards (EN+AR), portal-comparison, page titles +
heroes, tech-sandbox/runner/redeem/vouchers/results/answers/custom/client-report
back-links + headings, voucher hub label, delegate emails, cohort + sandbox
report titles, settings timer label, i18n values (techAssessment/techCertification).

Deliberately kept (50 renamed / 105 kept, found by a discovery workflow): the
/tech-assessment + /tech-sandbox routes, tech_assessment_*/technical_* tables,
all TS identifiers/types, code comments, and the generic descriptor "technical
proficiency / skills / domains / certification" (what it measures). Verified:
tsc + JSON clean; sidebar + hub render "Techno"; no "Technical Assessment" left
in the UI.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: structured scoring editor for sandbox tasks
entries.plain: Admins can now use a structured form to define correct answers and scoring rules for hands-on tasks, instead of writing raw code.
entries.explanation:
- Replace the raw master_solution / checkpoints JSON textareas with a typed
  editor: engine-aware master answer (cell map / field map / SQL query) and a
  per-kind checkpoint list (cell_value / is_array_formula / logic_value /
  sql_result_match) with target/field/expected/tolerance/weight fields
- Strict server-side checkpoint schema (zod discriminated union) + unique-id
  check so a malformed checkpoint can't reach the scorer
- Non-standard shapes (e.g. python) fall back to raw JSON; label_ar preserved

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: sandbox-task content editor on the review page
entries.plain: Admins can now edit task content (instructions, time limits, correct answers, scoring) directly on the review page without leaving it.
entries.explanation:
- "Edit content" toggle per task expands an inline editor for the prompt,
  instructions, description, name (EN/AR), framework ref, time limit, and
  the master answer / expected output + scoring checkpoints + engine config
  (JSON), alongside the existing approve/reject status controls
- New admin-gated updateBlockContentAction validates + parses the JSON
  fields before writing; updateBlockContent persists via service role
- listBlocksForReview now returns the editable content per block

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical Assessment: section nav on landing, numbered actions
entries.plain: The Technical Assessment menu on the admin dashboard is now cleaner, with key links moved to a top navigation bar.
entries.explanation:
- Move the Overview / Voucher codes / Model answers / Retention links from
  the sidebar's Technical Assessment group onto a top section bar on the
  /admin/tech-sandbox landing; the sidebar now carries a single Technical
  Assessment link per pillar
- Number the quick-action cards 1-4
- Remove the "Back to admin" link (the multi-portal admin home is gone)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical custom builder: assign via the standard voucher system (carry the design)
entries.plain: Custom technical assessments now use the same voucher-code system as other assessments, making assignment and sharing easier.
entries.explanation:
Replaces the custom builder's bespoke "Assign the assessment" delegate roster
(which issued one direct session link each) with the same voucher system the rest
of the platform uses (ARC / Persona / Fluent / Cognitive). Each delegate now gets
a voucher code + one-click redeem link; an empty roster yields one shareable
anonymous code.

The custom design (selected skills + hands-on blocks + title) is carried on the
voucher via a new custom_config jsonb column (migration 00141) and applied at
redemption, so a redeemed code provisions the SAME custom sitting - not the
function default. generateVoucherBatch + generateVouchersAction thread
customConfig; redeemVoucher reads it (progressive, tolerant of pending 00141 /
00136 / 00085) and passes isCustom + skills + blocks + title to createSession.

Migration 00141 must be applied for the design to persist; until then the path
degrades to the function default (no crash). The old direct-session action is
left unused but in place.

tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical landing: promote the four actions into a titled "Quick actions" card grid
entries.plain: The four main actions on the Technical Assessment landing page are now displayed as easy-to-spot cards instead of hidden text links.
entries.explanation:
The inline text links (Build a custom assessment / View completed results /
Review sandbox tasks / View model answers) were easy to miss. They are now a
titled "Quick actions" section of four icon + title + one-line cards, matching
the page's card hierarchy. Also dropped two em dashes from comments.

Verified live. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical client report: PDF export (P4) - finishes the aggregation feature
entries.plain: Admins can now download technical assessment results as PDF, JSON, or CSV reports for clients and stakeholders.
entries.explanation:
- src/lib/reports/tech-client-report.tsx: React-PDF document for the
  ClientReportPayload (company banner, company overall funnel + skill-profile
  table + insight columns, then per-project sections, band legend). English,
  Helvetica - mirrors the per-session tech-sandbox-report styling.
- Route moved to route.tsx and gains format=pdf (renderToBuffer) alongside the
  existing json (default) + csv. Admin-gated, force-dynamic.
- Admin page now offers PDF / JSON / CSV download buttons.

Verified live (authed): PDF 200 application/pdf ~14KB valid %PDF-; JSON 200
(vifm, 3 projects, 6 insights); CSV 200. tsc + lint clean. This closes the
Technical client-report aggregation feature (P1-P4 all shipped).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical client report: Company -> Project aggregation + insights + payload
entries.plain: Technical results from multiple assessment types can now be combined into one company-level report showing overall skill profiles and gaps.
entries.explanation:
A modular mechanism that aggregates individual technical results across portals
into a hierarchical client report.

- src/lib/reports/tech-aggregation/: types, sources (portal adapters -
  Sandbox primary via technical_sandbox_sessions, MCQ via tech_assessment_results,
  normalised into one RawTechResult), metrics (pure participation / per-domain
  avg-high-low profiles / gap-vs-baseline), insights (pure deterministic
  strengths / systemic vulnerabilities / training recs), aggregate (orchestrator
  -> ClientReportPayload, wires recommendCoursesForTechnical for course-backed recs).
- Company key = normalized organization_name; project key = voucher batch (else
  per-function "direct"); domain = function (sandbox) / domain_key (MCQ).
  Baseline default 70% (Decision 3). Tolerant of either portal being absent.
- Admin page /admin/tech-sandbox/client-report (picker + company/project detail:
  funnel, skill-profile table with gap badges, grouped insight cards) + JSON/CSV
  export at /api/tech-sandbox/client-report.

Verified live: VIFM -> 4 invited/3 completed (75%), 3 domains/3 projects,
gaps detected, and the engine produced "Targeted Accounts Payable (AP)
training" (the spec's AP<70% example). tsc + lint clean. PDF export deferred.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: SD-7: technical report - per-band capability meanings + FP&A pillar definitions
entries.plain: Technical assessment reports now clearly explain what each proficiency band means and include descriptions for all skill categories.
entries.explanation:
Ask (c): the proficiency-bands legend now states what each band MEANS, not
just the numeric threshold. proficiencyTierMeaning(tier, locale) is the single
source of truth, rendered on the tech-sandbox PDF legend and the on-screen
admin results page.

Ask (a): migration 00139 authors the three FP&A (node 1.7) pillar definitions
(they were inserted before the description columns existed in 00118), so the
FP&A report explains each category. L&D 2.6 already had definitions (00118);
the seven inactive 00086 finance functions stay NULL (not in the demo).

Asks (b) candidate narrative + the bands legend were already shipped (TECH-6).
Ask (d) in-assessment hints deferred (the report already carries rich
explanatory text; hints are a guided-mode feature, not demo-critical).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical lens: catch PGRST204 + carry lens through voucher path
entries.plain: Fixed a critical issue where technical assessments could fail if assigned via voucher codes with certain talent groups.
entries.explanation:
Review fixes for TECH-5:

1. createSession's insert peel ladder relied on isMissingSchemaError,
which only matched 42P01/42703 - but a missing column on a PostgREST
INSERT returns PGRST204. A pending 00135 would hard-500 every technical
sitting. isMissingSchemaError now also matches PGRST204 (consistent with
the codebase-wide strip-and-retry sites).

2. The voucher/bulk-delegate path provisions the session at redemption,
so it dropped the talent lens - acquisition voucher cohorts fell back to
development framing. The lens now rides the voucher row (00136) and is
copied onto the session on redeem; threaded through both issuance UIs.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: design-first custom builder + dev-lens course block (TECH-1, TECH-5)
entries.plain: The custom assessment builder now works in two steps: first design the assessment, then assign it to candidates with individual links.
entries.explanation:
TECH-1: the custom builder is now a two-step flow - design the
assessment (name/title + knowledge skills + hands-on tasks) first,
then confirm and assign the client + multiple delegates, one private
link each. New createCustomSandboxSessionsAction issues one session
per delegate from a shared design.

TECH-5: the technical report carries a talent lens (00135) captured
from the launching pillar. Under development (and the NULL default,
which has always been a development read) the report adds a 'Recommended
VIFM Academy programmes' block driven by the function's domain and the
candidate's weakest assessed area; under acquisition the block is
suppressed. recommendCoursesForTechnical ranks vertical-matched courses
by level-appropriateness. Rendered on the on-screen report + the PDF.

Also fixes two pre-existing em dashes in the technical report PDF.
Migration 00135 adds technical_sandbox_sessions.assessment_title +
talent_lens (tolerant, newest-first peel preserves is_custom).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical report: per-block development narrative + tips (TECH-6)
entries.plain: Technical assessment reports now include personalized development tips for each task where a candidate struggled.
entries.explanation:
Each per-subcategory block card showed only MISS/PASS checkpoint lines and
no prose. Add a 2-3 sentence development note per block that has >=1 missed
checkpoint: explain the missed competency (from the block description +
framework ref + the exact missed checkpoint labels) then 1-2 concrete
development tips. Blocks with no misses (strengths) get no note.

- New src/lib/ai/tech-block-notes.ts: one batched AI call (getAIClient) keyed
  by block id, prompt-injection-guarded (missed labels treated as DATA ONLY),
  EN+AR, with a deterministic per-block fallback when no key / on failure.
- ReportBlock gains developmentNoteEn/Ar; getSessionReport builds contexts for
  missed blocks, reads cache, generates the uncached, best-effort persists.
- Migration 00133: technical_sandbox_sessions.block_development_notes jsonb
  cache (keyed by skill_block_id) so screen + PDF stay identical and AI isn't
  re-run each view; tolerant of it being unapplied (generate in-memory).
- Rendered under each block's checkpoints on the on-screen results page + the
  PDF (EN; tech PDF is EN-only).

Subagent-built; reviewed the generator + fallback; tsc + next lint clean.
Verified live: AI path grounded in real framework refs, fallback path, and
00133-absent tolerance. Apply migration 00133.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical report + voucher fixes (TECH-2/3/4)
entries.plain: Technical reports now show unique development advice per skill area and display the proficiency band meanings prominently at the top.
entries.explanation:
TECH-2: the per-section "Development focus" no longer repeats. techDevFocus
now takes a DevFocusContext (category name + score% + band + weakest
sub-area + the actual missed checkpoint labels) and produces a distinct,
data-grounded line per section - the lead (name + score + band) alone makes
two basic sections read differently; advanced sections still carry none.

TECH-3: surface the proficiency-band legend (Basic < 60, Intermediate
60-84, Advanced >= 85) at the TOP of the report (PDF + on-screen), not just
the footer; fixed an en-dash in the footer copy.

TECH-4: named delegates moved from Option 2 to Option 1. Option 2 (client
self-distributes) is now count-only: anonymous single-use codes OR one
shared seat-pool code (no delegate box). Option 1 (direct issue) gains the
"Issue to named delegates" paste/CSV -> one code+link each via the existing
generateVouchersAction({delegates}). Verified live.

Subagent-built; reviewed TECH-2 logic; tsc + next lint clean. (Tech PDF is
EN-only per React-PDF; AR dev-focus strings produced but not rendered there,
matching existing behaviour.)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add exposure control to certified MCQ function bank
entries.plain: Admins can now control how many questions from a certified question bank appear on each candidate's test, reducing repetition across candidates.
entries.explanation:
The certified assembler already draws a random subset per skill per
sitting (shuffle + slice), but the approved pool equalled the draw
(~4 each), so every candidate saw the identical form. Make the
per-sitting draw configurable and surface pool-vs-draw guidance so
SMEs build a surplus pool that yields varying forms.

- Migration 00122: technical_function_cut_scores.draw_per_skill
  (nullable; falls back to DEFAULT_DRAW_PER_SKILL=4)
- getFunctionCutScore: tolerant wide/narrow select (loads pass/floor
  even when 00122 is unapplied); FunctionCutScore gains drawPerSkill
- buildCertifiedFunctionTest draws Math.max(floor, cut.drawPerSkill)
- setFunctionCutScoreAction persists draw_per_skill, tolerant of 00122 absent
- cert-workbench: per-sitting-draw input, target-pool-per-skill input
  feeding Draft-all, exposure legend, per-skill thin/good badges
- EN + AR i18n keys

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add custom pick-and-choose technical assessment builder
entries.plain: Admins can now build custom technical assessments by cherry-picking specific skills and tasks from a full function.
entries.explanation:
Admins can assemble a narrower technical sitting from one function -
a subset of its knowledge (MCQ) skills and/or hands-on tasks - at
/admin/tech-sandbox/custom. Custom sittings are indicative (no
credential) by design, enforced server-side in submitSession.

Also gate the certified combined credential on SME-approved sandbox
tasks (review_status='approved'), not just approved MCQ items.

- Migration 00121: is_custom + selected_skills + selected_block_ids
- buildMcqTestForFunction narrows MCQ to chosen skills (intersection;
  empty intersection means no knowledge section, never the full set)
- loadBlocks honors an explicit block selection, incl. empty [] as a
  knowledge-only sitting (NULL stays "all" for legacy/full sittings)
- createSession fails loud if 00121 is absent for a custom sitting so
  the is_custom no-credential flag can never be silently dropped
- runner handles knowledge-only sittings (no hands-on tasks)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: sandbox task SME-approval workflow + review console
entries.plain: Technical sandbox tasks now go through a formal review and approval process, like other test items, so L&D can control which tasks are live.
entries.explanation:
Performance sandbox tasks now have the same draft -> in_review -> approved ->
rejected/retired lifecycle as the MCQ items (migration 00120 adds review_status
+ reviewer columns to technical_skill_blocks, orthogonal to the active/inactive
runtime status; backfills seeded blocks to approved). New admin-gated review
console at /admin/tech-sandbox/sandbox-blocks (per-function, grouped by pillar,
per-pillar approved count + per-block approve/reject/retire with reviewer
stamp), linked from the Technical Assessment command page. Service:
listBlocksForReview + setBlockReviewStatus (tolerant of 00120 not applied).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: close results-access review items (dead code + hardening)
entries.plain: Removed unused code paths that could have emailed candidates their technical assessment scores - candidates should not see these results.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial review confirmed the candidate cannot reach results via any path and
the admin view is correctly gated (no IDOR, no regression). Cleared the two
low-severity items it flagged:
- TS-1: delete the orphaned emailSessionResults wrapper (results-email.tsx) that
  would have emailed the candidate their scored PDF if re-wired; the generic
  emailResults() in email.ts is kept for a future client-recipient send. Removed
  the now-dead buildInitialResult helper from the candidate page (no longer
  imports getSessionReport). Updated the stale PENDING-ACTIONS note.
- TS-2: the report PDF route hard-fails a synthetic dev-admin in production, so a
  misconfigured auth-off prod deploy can't serve the scored PDF on the candidate
  token (local dev auth-off still works).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: admin/client on-screen results view (development report)
entries.plain: Managers and VIFM admins can now view detailed technical assessment results on-screen, including development guidance and detailed breakdowns by skill area.
entries.explanation:
The explanations now render on-screen for the reviewer (manager / VIFM admin),
not the candidate: a new admin-gated results surface under
/admin/tech-sandbox/results - a completed-sittings list + a per-sitting
development report (purpose note, narrative, overall band, knowledge-by-
subcategory, per-category definitions + development focus + bands, per-
subcategory definitions + bands + checkpoints) + the admin-gated PDF download.
listSubmittedSessions() backs the list; both pages requireRole(admin) (and sit
under the admin-gated layout). Linked from the Technical Assessment command page.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: hide results from the candidate (client/admin-only)
entries.plain: Candidates no longer see their technical assessment scores after completing the test - results are for managers and L&D leaders only.
entries.explanation:
The technical assessment is a development instrument whose report is read by the
client / VIFM admin, NOT the candidate. So the candidate no longer sees results:
- runner shows a completion confirmation on submit (no scores), never the Results panel
- page.tsx never seeds the candidate runner with results on reload
- the submit response carries only { submitted } - no score, no combined, no keyed test
- the candidate results email is removed
- the report PDF route now requires admin (it sits under the /api/tech-sandbox/*
  middleware auth-bypass, so the candidate's token could otherwise fetch it)
Scoring still runs server-side; delivery moves to the client/admin (admin results
view + admin-gated PDF). Auto-email to a client recipient is a follow-on.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: frame the manager report as a development report
entries.plain: The technical assessment report now emphasizes development and learning priorities rather than selection, with guidance tailored to each skill level.
entries.explanation:
The report is read by a third party (manager / L&D lead), not the candidate,
and is for development - not selection. So: a development-purpose statement in
the header, a development-framed narrative (relative strength + where to
prioritise development), and a per-category 'Development focus' line (band-aware
guidance for basic/intermediate categories; advanced = a strength, no focus).
Definitions + per-subcategory results + narrative remain.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: explanatory manager report + deeper per-subcategory coverage
entries.plain: The manager-facing technical report now explains what each section tested and shows results broken down by individual skill areas for better clarity.
entries.explanation:
Manager-facing technical report now EXPLAINS what each category + subcategory
tested and reads more completely:
- per-category (pillar) + per-subcategory (skill block) plain-English
  definitions in the PDF (migration 00118 adds pillar description columns +
  authors the 3 L&D category definitions; block descriptions already existed
  but were dropped - now threaded through getSessionReport)
- a 'Knowledge by subcategory' section: the MCQ knowledge section is
  recomputed per subcategory from the stored keyed test, so every knowledge
  subcategory gets a band (not just the hands-on tasks)
- a plain-language candidate 'Performance summary' narrative
- items-per-subcategory raised 4 -> 5 for a more reliable per-subcategory read
loadBlocks tolerates the 00118 columns being unapplied (renders names-only).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix AI model id: claude-sonnet-4-20250514 -> claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
entries.plain: Fixed AI model configuration so all AI-powered features (assessments, report writing, course suggestions) now work properly instead of falling back to static content.
entries.explanation:
Every AI feature (Fluent/Cognitive generation, Technical assessment, quiz gen,
CBI, report writing, course/JD extraction) silently fell back to static decks.
Root cause, found by probing the live API: the key is valid + active, but the
configured model "claude-sonnet-4-20250514" returns 404 not_found_error for this
account, so getAIClient()'s calls threw and hit the catch -> fallback. The
account's available Sonnet is 4.5; verified live that claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
succeeds and the old ids 404. After the change Fluent generation flips from an
instant 2.5s static deck to a real multi-second AI generation.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical sandbox: green answer cells, auto-fit columns, scoring explainer
entries.plain: Technical sandbox now highlights answer cells in green so candidates know where to enter responses, auto-fits column widths, and explains scoring clearly on results.
entries.explanation:
- Spreadsheet engine: editable answer cells (incl. empty ones) now render
  with a light-green fill + dark-green text so the user sees exactly where
  input is required; columns auto-fit to content (column A / labels gets
  the most room, clamped); the helper line shows the green legend.
- Result page: a new ScoreMethodology panel adds (a) a plain-language
  narrative on the user's answers (overall tier + strongest/weakest
  pillar), (b) proficiency-level definitions, and (c) the exact scoring
  algorithm so admins know how the single "assessment complete" total is
  derived (weighted checkpoint pass-rate -> block % -> mean = overall ->
  tier thresholds), including the knowledge/hands-on blend when present.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: register program clients first-class via the registry
entries.plain: Technical programs now register clients in the main platform system so client data is consistent across VIFM services.
entries.explanation:
Creating a technical program now registers its organization through the
shared registry (dual-write to organizations + ara_organizations, deduped
by name) instead of storing only a free-text name - so the client is a
real, cross-service platform client. The create form gains a client
picker (datalist of existing platform clients). Migration 00103 adds
technical_programs.organization_id; the FK link is best-effort and no-ops
cleanly until it is applied (client registration works regardless).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent speaking: make Stop recording respond instantly
entries.plain: English placement speaking tests now respond immediately when you click Stop, instead of appearing frozen.
entries.explanation:
Stop deferred leaving record mode to finalizeSpeaking, which only runs once
BOTH the recorder and the browser speech recogniser settle. On browsers where
Web Speech never fires its stop event, the recogniser never settled, so the UI
stayed stuck on the red "Stop" button - it looked like Stop did nothing. Now
Stop leaves record mode immediately (showing a transcribing spinner) and a
2.5s fallback force-settles the recogniser so transcription always finalizes.
Fixed in both the standalone runner and the Pre-Hire speaking stage.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: label and name every form field in the runner
entries.plain: English placement form fields now have proper labels, so autofill and screen readers work correctly for all candidates.
entries.explanation:
Trial finding: six form fields carried no id/name, hurting autofill and
screen readers.

- Taker name + email: id, name, and the correct autocomplete tokens, so a
  browser/password manager can fill them.
- The three answer textareas (writing, speaking transcript editor,
  speaking type-instead): id, name, and an aria-label, since none of them
  had an accessible name at all.
- Answer options: each radio gets a unique id and its label an htmlFor,
  and the option list becomes a radiogroup named by its question text -
  a screen reader now announces "question ... 1 of 4" instead of four
  unrelated radios. The name deliberately points at a NEW id on the
  question paragraph: fluent-q-<item> was already taken by the
  jump-to-unanswered scroll anchor, and reusing it made the group
  announce the whole card.
- Shared voucher redeem form (every service, not just Fluent): name +
  autocomplete on the name/email/company fields, and the email error is
  now linked by aria-describedby so it is announced on failure. The code
  field keeps autocomplete="off" - a voucher code should not be filled
  from an address book.

Also stop trusting the AI's returned item id in fluent-english.ts. The id
is the radio-group name, so a model that reused one id across a reading
and a listening item would merge two questions into a single group, where
answering one silently cleared the other. Ids are now derived.

Verified in the browser: 20 named radiogroups, 80 uniquely-identified
radios, zero duplicate ids in the document, scroll anchors intact.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: take-page welcome follows the selected test language
entries.plain: The welcome message on the Fluent test page now displays in the language the candidate selects, instead of staying in one fixed language.
entries.explanation:
Trial feedback asked for the welcome above the test card to be in one
language "and it should change based on the language the user selects".
The first half shipped (the header stopped being half EN half AR); this
is the second half.

The test-language selector lives inside the runner card while the header
is rendered by the server page above it, so the header had no way to
follow the choice. A small FluentLanguageProvider context now holds that
state: the take page wraps both the header and the runner in it, and the
header re-renders in Arabic - flipping to RTL - the moment the taker
switches.

The runner falls back to its own local state when no provider is present,
so the standalone /ac/fluent surface is untouched. Verified both ways in
the browser, including the no-provider path.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: show voucher status on a spent redeem link
entries.plain: When a candidate opens an already-used Fluent voucher link, they now see immediately why it cannot be used instead of discovering it only after filling out the entire form.
entries.explanation:
A trial reviewer found that re-opening an already-redeemed voucher link
served a clean, working form - the only sign the code was spent came
after filling the whole thing in and submitting.

The redeem page already loaded the voucher to show the client name; it
now also resolves whether the code can still be claimed and, when it
can't, replaces the form with a status card naming the reason:
deactivated, expired, or no places left. The three conditions mirror
eng_fluent_voucher_claim exactly, so a still-claimable code - including
a partly-used multi-seat cohort code - is never falsely blocked.

Multi-seat codes get their own wording ("All 25 places on this code have
been taken") rather than claiming the code is single-use. The lookup
also normalises case, so a lowercased code in a URL now resolves.

The whole read stays inside the existing tolerant try/catch: any query
failure degrades to today's behaviour and the atomic RPC remains the
real gate at submit time.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: trial-feedback hardening (anti-cheat, timing, redemption)
entries.plain: Fluent now prevents cheating by blocking copy, paste, and right-click during the test, and alerts candidates and staff when these attempts occur.
entries.explanation:
Fixes from the Fluent trial (Ali, Ahmad G, Jomaa, Yassin, Omar, Assad):

Anti-cheat / integrity
- Full copy-paste clamp: copy/cut/right-click blocked over the test area,
  question/passage/option/prompt text is unselectable, and paste is blocked
  in the writing + speaking answer boxes (attempt still logged). Candidates
  can still copy/cut their own answer text.
- Candidate-facing proctor warning on tab-switch and paste attempts (was
  silent). Staff result shows a 'Review recommended' flag when integrity is
  elevated (advisory; credential still issues).
- Listening player rebuilt: enforces the 2-play replay cap on the Azure path
  too, shows duration/progress, and removes the native download control.

Timing / consistency
- Default test time 15 -> 25 min (too short; a taker was auto-submitted before
  speaking). Speaking duration standardized to 45s everywhere; writing word
  counts unified so the prompt band, the 'min N' counter and the derived
  guidance agree - across the in-code rotation, the AI path, the fallback AND
  the live seed bank (fluent-prompt-seed.ts + migration 00192 for live rows).
- Listening TTS route sets Content-Length so duration loads (no dead 0:00).

Redemption / result promise
- Server-side email validation before a seat is claimed (+ client gate on the
  shared redeem form). Pre-test copy now conditional on whether the taker sees
  their result (voucher delegates get 'shared with your organisation', not a
  promised CEFR level), driven by the same isStaff signal as the result screen.
- Take-page hero is English-only (was half EN / half AR). 'Start over' hidden
  on the one-shot voucher flow. Guided-demo rail suppressed on /ac/fluent/take
  + /redeem.

UX
- Speaking transcript is editable before submit (recognition can mishear).
- Submit gated on a modest 'real attempt' floor (not the full min, which could
  trap a near-complete answer); the min stays visible as the target.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent Batch 2: calibration/cert access control + 1000-row pagination
entries.plain: Fluent access is now properly restricted so only authorized staff can view calibration data, and lists can display up to 1000 rows without cutting off results.
entries.explanation:
Access control:
- transcribe DoW: per-IP rate limit (trusted cf-connecting-ip hop, not
  spoofable leftmost XFF) + mandatory valid unexpired session
- calibration console restricted to admin/consultant (was leaking
  cross-org verbatims + taker names to per-engagement assessors)
- Fluent certificate: client_manager may download their own org's cert
  (org-scoped), with a migration-tolerant organization_id select

Pagination (1000-row PostgREST cap):
- cohort + voucher lists + retention id-gather now fetchAllPages
- calibration QWK anchored on ALL human ratings (paginated on the PK for
  deterministic paging) via an aiCefrByKey map, not just the newest 50

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: refuse fabricated CEFR credentials + atomic one-seat-one-result
entries.plain: Fluent no longer issues fake English certificates when the AI scoring system fails or is unavailable, preventing invalid credentials from reaching candidates.
entries.explanation:
CRITICAL: the standalone /api/ac/fluent score route never checked the
scoring_failed flag (added for the Pre-Hire path in July), so on a
transient Anthropic error - or in production without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -
scoreFluentWriting/Speaking returned a placeholder B1/all-3s that was
persisted as a real placement AND minted a publicly-verifiable fluent_cefr
credential attesting a band no examiner produced.
- Fail closed in production without a key (BEFORE loadSession's single-use
  consume, so the sitting survives for a retry once the key is restored).
- 503 on a genuine scoring failure BEFORE persist/credential, releasing the
  session (consumed_at -> null) so the retry can re-score the same sitting.
- Belt-and-suspenders: only issue the credential when a key is present, so a
  non-prod deploy sharing the verify DB can't mint a placeholder credential.

HIGH: the retake single-completion guard was a read-then-write TOCTOU - two
concurrent sittings on one voucher seat both persisted + credentialed.
linkRedemption now claims the seat atomically (WHERE result_id IS NULL) and
reports the outcome; a losing concurrent sitting deletes its orphan result
and 409s before any score-run/credential is written. One seat = one result.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica/Fluent/Pre-Hire: serve fixed in-review bank instead of live-AI at deal time
entries.plain: Logica, Fluent, and Pre-Hire assessments now use a fixed set of pre-reviewed questions instead of generating new ones on the fly during test delivery.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix build: client component pulled server-only code (fluent-admin)
entries.plain: A technical build error preventing the Fluent admin console from loading properly has been corrected.
entries.explanation:
The fluent-bank console (a "use client" component) value-imported
PROMPT_MIN from fluent-admin.ts, which imports the server-only supabase
client (next/headers). That pulled server code into the client bundle
and failed `next build` ("component that needs next/headers ... not
supported in the pages/ directory"), cascading to ReferenceErrors for
FLUENT_PROMPT_MIN + loadPersonaBankStatus in readiness.ts. tsc does not
catch this - only next build does.

- new fluent-constants.ts: client-safe PROMPT_MIN + the shared Fluent
  types (no server imports)
- fluent-admin.ts re-exports them (server consumers unchanged)
- console.tsx + readiness.ts import from fluent-constants
- console.tsx now has zero reference to the server-only fluent-admin

Verified: /admin/item-banks + /admin/fluent-bank + /admin/persona-bank
render 200; readiness cards produce data; tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: writing + speaking prompt bank behind the SME gate
entries.plain: Fluent writing and speaking prompts are now stored in a reviewed bank and managed by subject-matter experts, matching how reading and listening questions are handled.
entries.explanation:
The receptive bank (reading/listening MCQs) already had an SME review
gate; the productive skills' prompts lived only in code, invisible on
the readiness dashboard. Bring them into the same gate.

- migration 00183: widen the eng_fluent_items skill CHECK to admit
  'writing' + 'speaking' (drop the auto-named inline check by
  definition, re-add the widened one)
- 16 vetted bilingual prompts (8 writing + 8 speaking, CEFR A2-C1)
  seeded in_review via scripts/seed-fluent-prompts.ts
- assembler draws a live prompt per productive skill (least-served
  first); falls back to the in-code vetted rotation when none live
- /admin/fluent-bank console: a Productive section (writing/speaking)
  with promote/reject + promote-all, alongside the receptive ramp
- readiness: Fluent now shows all four skills as units (writing +
  speaking target = a 3-prompt rotation); serving stays gated by the
  receptive ramp (the real scramble risk)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: vetted CEFR receptive bank + SME review gate
entries.plain: Fluent now uses a curated bank of 120 verified reading and listening questions instead of generating them live, ensuring consistency and quality.
entries.explanation:
Add a served item bank for Fluent's receptive skills, closing the
last live-AI-at-deal-time surface among the assessment banks.

- migration 00181: widen eng_fluent_items status CHECK to add
  in_review/rejected/retired + source/reviewed_by/reviewed_at/
  rejected_reason + skill-status index + admin-all RLS
- 120 vetted reading+listening items (CEFR-ramped, EN/AR) seeded
  as in_review via scripts/seed-fluent-bank.ts (content-hash idempotent)
- fluent-assemble: draw a CEFR ramp from status='live' items paired
  with vetted writing/speaking prompts; null-safe fallback to live-AI
- runner start action prefers the bank, falls back to generateFluentTest
- /admin/fluent-bank SME console: per-skill CEFR cells, promote to live
- item-banks readiness reflects Fluent vetted-vs-live (curated only)
- Fluent Bank sidebar link

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent speaking: always record audio + server fallback so Web Speech misses never dead-end
entries.plain: Fluent speaking now always records your voice, so if the browser's speech recognizer misses your words, the platform can transcribe the recording instead of asking you to repeat.
entries.explanation:
The speaking step used the browser Web Speech API as the sole transcriber on
Chrome/Edge/Safari and recorded NO audio - so when Web Speech returned empty
(a blocked/slow call to the browser's recogniser, a transient miss), the
candidate hit "We didn't catch any speech. Please record again." with nothing
to fall back on. Reported as failing "most of the time".

Now the mic is ALWAYS recorded via MediaRecorder in parallel with Web Speech.
On stop, once both settle: if the live transcript is solid we use it (fast, no
server); otherwise we transcribe the actual recording server-side (OpenAI
Whisper on Render). Only if BOTH fail does it fall back to typing, and a
persistent "type instead" escape stays available so the candidate is never
stuck. Applied to both the Pre-Hire English stage and the standalone Fluent
runner (same bug). Server fallback requires OPENAI_API_KEY on Render.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent audit fixes: cohort + calibration IDOR (critical) + retake, retention, reports
entries.plain: English placement now prevents unauthorized access to test-taker names, emails, and scores - staff can only see their own organization's data.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial audit of the English-placement module (11 findings). All app-layer,
no migration.

Critical / security
- Cohort page had no staff gate and no org scoping - a service-role query
  returned every org's taker names, emails, and CEFR scores to any signed-in
  user. Now gated to staff; a client_manager is scoped to their own org
  (mirrors the report/certificate routes).
- Calibration page (QA console) likewise exposed cross-org names + verbatim
  writing responses + speaking transcripts - now staff-gated.
- submitHumanRating server action had no role check - now requireRole(staff),
  so a non-staff caller can't corrupt the calibration data.

Major
- Voucher link allowed unlimited retakes (a new result + CEFR credential each
  time). The take page and the score route now refuse once the redemption has
  a result - one seat, one placement.
- Retention purge now anonymises voucher-redeemer PII and sweeps expired
  sessions (keyed test + start IP), so no PII outlives the 2-year rule.
- Arabic taker name no longer prints as tofu: the report falls back to the
  email; the certificate routes to the Arabic (Puppeteer) renderer when the
  name is Arabic even on an EN request.

Minor
- Reliability band no longer counts writing when it wasn't administered
  (partial/Pre-Hire runs).
- Certificate relabels "Verification ID" -> "Result reference" (the printed id
  is the result row, not the publicly-verifiable credential code).
- Drop the IELTS/TOEFL equivalence claim from the hero (EN + AR).
- Bilingual framing on the token-delegate landing hero.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent review fixes: IELTS copy, word-target labels, coaching feedback
entries.plain: Fluent English test labels and coaching feedback have been refined for clarity.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Integrity pass: option shuffling, AI-likeness signal, org proctoring policy
entries.plain: Fluent now shuffles answer options and checks for AI use, with clearer organisational proctor policies.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Report footers: reserve page space so notes never overlap content
entries.plain: Report footers now have proper spacing so notes no longer overlap the content above them.
entries.explanation: The Leadership Report's fixed footer is a ~3-line paragraph occupying ~66pt above the page edge, but the page only reserved 48pt - content rendered THROUGH the note (seen on section 3 pills). paddingBottom raised to 80. Swept every React-PDF report for the same defect: Fluent's single-line footer wraps to 2 lines at its width, sitting exactly at its 48pt reserve - raised to 58. All other reports have single-row footers with adequate clearance. Verified by rasterising the rendered PDF: footer now sits alone below the content.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent redeem: English-only (no EN/AR toggle); add bilingual flag to shared form
entries.plain: Fluent redemption page is now English-only, simplifying the user experience.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent speaking: never force typing on a working mic; keep listening
entries.plain: Fluent speaking test now stays listening through pauses instead of dropping candidates into typing mode unexpectedly.
entries.explanation:
Hardens the browser STT so the candidate is never dropped into the type
fallback while the mic works:
- Only an explicit "not-allowed" (permission denied) ends recognition. The
  previously-fatal "service-not-allowed" / "audio-capture" codes (which can
  fire transiently in the gap while a session restarts) are now recoverable -
  we just restart and keep listening.
- Restart through every silence/pause; only sustained pure silence or a dead-
  service loop (>=12 empty sessions) ends it, and then it delivers whatever was
  captured and stays in record mode (a gentle "tap Record again" note), never
  type-mode.
- Add a manual "Type instead" link in record mode so typing is always a choice,
  never forced.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: keep mic listening through pauses; explain integrity score
entries.plain: Fluent speaking keeps the microphone active through thinking pauses, and integrity scores are now explained on results and reports.
entries.explanation:
- Speaking: browser STT now auto-restarts through silences until the
  candidate presses Stop, accumulating the transcript across restarts -
  a thinking pause no longer cuts them off or forces type-mode. Only a
  genuinely blocked mic / dead service ends it; transient hiccups show a
  gentle retry note and stay in record mode. Clearer EN/AR hints.
- Integrity signal: add a "How to read this signal" interpretation on the
  result view and the PDF report (lower is better; not a grade out of 100;
  bands Clean 0-14 / Minor 15-44 / Elevated 45-100; which band applies).
- Fix a pre-existing report crash (NaN% bar width) when a criterion is
  un-scored, which 500'd the whole PDF.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix Fluent integrity-signal crash on legacy rows
entries.plain: A crash affecting older Fluent test records on the cohort page and PDF reports has been fixed.
entries.explanation:
The cohort page and Full Report PDF trusted the persisted
integrity_flags.signal, but rows written before the signal gained a
reasons[] array stored an older shape. Reading sig.reasons.join /
.map on those rows threw, 500ing /ac/fluent/cohort and any affected
candidate's report PDF. Normalize at read time: use the stored signal
only when reasons[] is well-formed, else recompute from raw flags.
Found via end-to-end service testing.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent audit: enforce secure session grading + harden voucher (00165)
entries.plain: Fluent security has been strengthened to ensure test integrity and prevent voucher misuse.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire AI interview: ride out transient API overloads + scripted fallback
entries.plain: Pre-Hire AI interviews now handle temporary API slowdowns gracefully, so candidates can complete interviews even during busy periods.
entries.explanation:
The AI interview depends on the Anthropic API. Logs showed it returning HTTP
529 "overloaded_error" (a transient capacity throttle, x-should-retry:true)
during a candidate's session, which the code caught and turned into a looping
"Sorry - a brief hiccup" message - the interview could not progress.

Two fixes:
- client.ts: bump SDK maxRetries 2 -> 4 so transient 429/529 overload blips are
  absorbed before any feature falls back. Helps every AI path (CBI, Fluent, quiz).
- cbi-interviewer.ts: extract the deterministic interview into a PROGRESSIVE
  scriptedTurn() (Situation -> Task -> Action -> Result, keyed on answer count)
  and route BOTH the no-key branch and the API-error catch through it. A
  sustained outage now degrades to a real scripted STAR interview that advances
  and completes (transcript captured for scoring) instead of a stuck loop.
  Scoring already degrades gracefully to "human assessor should review".

Verified the dependency live: scripts/test-cbi-reliability.ts fired the exact
CBI call 20x (10 at maxRetries=2, 10 at 8) - 20/20 succeeded, confirming the
model/key are healthy and the earlier failure was a transient overload window.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: default proctoring-link host to the public domain in production
entries.plain: Fluent proctoring links in PDF reports now point to the correct public website so they work reliably.
entries.explanation:
Harden the prior fix: if NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL are unset,
fall back to https://caliber.viftraining.com in production (not the internal
request origin) so the proctoring link baked into the report PDF is always
reachable. Local dev still uses the request origin.

Confirmed via Chrome on the live site: the proctoring-report endpoint itself
returns the PDF correctly for an authed admin - the failure was only the host
in the embedded link.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: hide full report from the taker; fix proctoring-link origin
entries.plain: Test-takers no longer see the detailed placement report after finishing Fluent; only staff can access it, and the download link has been removed.
entries.explanation:
(2) The runner's completion screen offered the taker a "Download full report"
link to the detailed placement report. That report is a STAFF deliverable
(the route is already requireRole-gated, XP-13), so the link is removed - the
taker keeps only their own certificate. Drops the now-unused Award icon.

(3) The proctoring-report link embedded in the placement report was built from
new URL(req.url).origin. On Render behind Cloudflare that is the internal host,
so the link in the downloaded PDF was unreachable. It now uses the configured
public base (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL) and only falls back to
the request origin in local dev. The proctoring report stays admin-gated by
design (it carries face snapshots).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent placement report: camera-proctoring attestation + link
entries.plain: When an English test was camera-monitored, the placement report now shows that fact and provides staff with a link to the full proctoring record.
entries.explanation:
When a sitting was camera-proctored, the placement report now shows a "Camera
proctoring" line ("camera-proctored with consent; a Proctoring & Integrity Report
is available to authorised staff") and a link to that report. Detected via
result.voucher_redemption_id -> redemption -> proctor_session (ref_id = the
redemption token, snapshot_count > 0). Best-effort + tolerant: non-proctored
results render unchanged (verified: report still 200/PDF, same size).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent voucher: server-enforced "Require camera proctoring" toggle
entries.plain: Administrators can now require camera proctoring for specific vouchers, ensuring test-takers are monitored when the voucher is set up that way.
entries.explanation:
Proctoring never activated via the voucher flow (the ?proctor=1 param wasn't on
the redeem link and wasn't carried into the test) - so a candidate redeeming a
voucher was never proctored, which is why the consent box never appeared.

Now it's a per-voucher flag (migration 00149: eng_fluent_vouchers.proctor_enabled,
off by default): a "Require camera proctoring" checkbox on the generate form +
a "Proctored" badge in the voucher table. The take page reads the redeemed
voucher's proctor_enabled and turns ProctorCapture on server-side (no strippable
URL param); the admin-run ?proctor=1 path still works.

Verified end-to-end on the preview: generate proctored voucher -> proctor_enabled
true -> redeem -> the test page shows the "Camera proctoring" consent box.
tsc + ESLint clean; 00149 applied; test data cleaned up.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent vouchers: give admins the complete redemption link, not just the code
entries.plain: Voucher admins can now copy the full redemption link to send to candidates, instead of just the code, making it easier for clients to distribute tests.
entries.explanation:
The voucher admin only surfaced the bare code. Now it builds the full link
(<origin>/ac/fluent/redeem?code=<CODE>) so an admin can send it to a client who
forwards it to the candidate: per-row "Link" button, "Copy all links" for a
batch, and the link shown for each just-generated code. The redeem page resolves
the voucher's client from the code and shows "English placement for <Client>"
(code pre-filled), so the link visibly recognizes the client; the result is
tagged to that client as before. Verified end-to-end on the preview.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Camera proctoring Phase 1: consent + snapshots + admin report
entries.plain: Camera proctoring is now available across Fluent and Pre-Hire assessments, capturing snapshots and creating a staff-only audit trail that is kept for 90 days.
entries.explanation:
Per-administration (OFF by default), 90-day retention. Generic across contexts
(fluent/prehire) via (context, ref_id).

- Migration 00147: proctor_sessions + proctor_snapshots (cascade) + private
  'proctor' Storage bucket + admin-only RLS.
- src/lib/proctor/access.ts: createSession / recordSnapshot / endSession /
  getSessionWithSnapshots (signed URLs) / purgeExpiredProctorData. Service-role,
  tolerant of un-applied migration.
- /api/proctor/{start,snapshot,end} (anonymous taker; middleware-bypassed) +
  /api/proctor/retention/cron (Bearer CRON_SECRET, mirrors ARA retention).
- ProctorCapture component: blocking consent gate -> getUserMedia -> downscaled
  JPEG snapshot every 15s -> upload; "Proctoring active" badge; sendBeacon end.
  Never blocks/fakes the test (no session => stores nothing).
- Wired into the Fluent runner (bare + voucher take pages) behind ?proctor=1.
- Admin: /admin/proctor (sessions list) + /admin/proctor/[id] (report: metadata,
  consent record, snapshot grid via signed URLs); linked from the Fluent cohort.
- .github/workflows/proctor-retention-purge.yml (daily 03:30 UTC, reuses CRON_SECRET).

tsc + ESLint clean; 00147 applied; start/snapshot/report/list/cron-gate verified
on the preview. Live webcam capture (getUserMedia) needs on-device verification.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: course recommendations on the report (VIFM + pluggable partner source)
entries.plain: The Fluent placement report now recommends English development courses from VIFM and partner training providers matched to the test-taker's level.
entries.explanation:
Add an English-development recommendations section to the Fluent placement
report, fed by two sources via a new recommender (src/lib/recommender/english.ts):
- VIFM: real vifm_courses catalogue matched to communication-oriented
  competencies (keyword on the 41 names; no fabricated courses). Surfaced only
  when the candidate is below working proficiency (< C1).
- Partner: new partner_courses table (migration 00146) for SE Training Academy
  (and future partners), matched by CEFR band + the candidate's weakest skill.
  Stays empty/invisible until courses are added; recommender is tolerant of the
  table not existing.

Admin manager at /admin/fluent/partner-courses (add/show-hide/delete, CEFR-band
+ skill-focus tagging), linked from the Fluent cohort page. Report route computes
recs best-effort (never blocks the PDF). tsc + ESLint clean; 00146 applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent methodology brief: cover the productive skills (writing/speaking)
entries.plain: The Fluent methodology guide now explains how speaking and writing skills are measured and scored, closing gaps in the previous documentation.
entries.explanation:
The brief described only reading/listening and wrongly stated productive skills
weren't covered. Add the four-skill construct, a productive-skill scoring section
(7 writing criteria, 4 speaking criteria + Azure pronunciation blend 0.7/0.3,
self-consistency ensemble, prompt-injection sanitisation), human QWK calibration
(>=.70 target) under reliability, an administration-integrity section, productive
+ automated-scoring references, and honest productive-scoring limitations. v1.0 -> v1.1.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add VIFM Fluent client-pitch deck (PPTX + PDF)
entries.plain: A new 10-slide presentation deck is available to pitch the Fluent English placement solution to clients, covering methodology and deliverables.
entries.explanation:
10-slide, VIFM-branded client pitch for the Fluent English-placement solution -
what is measured (4 CEFR-aligned skills), the CEFR standard, methodology,
scoring rubric, calibration/integrity rigor, and deliverables. Editable
PowerPoint source + a shareable PDF render.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent report: integrity signal + receptive narratives + criterion defs
entries.plain: The Fluent placement report now includes an integrity advisory signal, skill definitions, and detailed writing feedback that were previously missing.
entries.explanation:
Three gaps the report had relative to the on-screen result:
- Integrity signal was shown post-test but absent from the report. The report
  route selected only `result`; it now also reads `integrity_flags`, derives the
  advisory signal (stored `signal`, else recomputed; null on a 00042-only DB),
  and renders an "Integrity signal (advisory)" section (tier + 0-100 + reasons +
  the never-affects-the-level caveat). Tone-coded clean/minor/elevated.
- Reading + Listening showed only a score. Each now has a narrative of the
  sub-skills it measures (gist / detail / inference / vocabulary-in-context /
  discourse-and-flow) and what the band reflects.
- Writing + Speaking showed criterion labels with no definitions. Each section
  now defines every criterion (7 writing, 4 speaking, + pronunciation when
  present). The redundant generic "What we measure" block is trimmed to the
  scale + indicative-placement note.

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent TTS: require the redemption token (or staff) to serve audio
entries.plain: Test audio in Fluent now requires proof of a valid voucher redemption, preventing unauthorized access to listening materials even if a session ID is leaked.
entries.explanation:
Closes the one defense-in-depth note from the voucher-sandbox audit. The
listening-audio endpoint identified the session by its (unguessable) id alone.
Now: a voucher taker must also pass their redemption token (validated against
eng_fluent_voucher_redemptions), and the admin-run /ac/fluent flow (no token)
must be staff-authenticated - so a leaked or guessed session id is useless
without the caller's own credential. The runner already had the redemption
token; it now forwards it on the TTS URL. No schema change. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Mobile: wrap the Fluent hero nav so it doesn't overflow on phones
entries.plain: The Fluent navigation buttons on mobile devices now wrap properly instead of overflowing off the screen on smaller phones.
entries.explanation:
The five hero pills (All Services / Cohort / Vouchers / Retention /
Calibration) sat in a non-wrapping flex row and overflowed at 375px. Add
flex-wrap so they stack onto the next line.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent FLU-1: flag a mid-test IP change in the integrity signal
entries.plain: If a test-taker's internet connection changes during the Fluent test, the system now flags this as a minor integrity concern in the advisory signal.
entries.explanation:
Captures the request IP at test START (stored on eng_fluent_sessions.start_ip,
migration 00142) and compares it at scoring; if both are known and differ, an
authoritative server-side ipChanged flag is merged into the (PDPL-safe) integrity
flags and the advisory signal gains +30 points (clears the "minor" bar on its
own, reads as elevated alongside other activity) plus the reason "IP address
changed during the test". Advisory only - never auto-fails (a legitimate network
switch also changes IP). Surfaces in the admin integrity view + the comprehensive
report. Best-effort + tolerant: a pending 00142 just means no IP detection.

NEEDS migration 00142 applied:
  ALTER TABLE eng_fluent_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS start_ip text;

tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: comprehensive report PDF (4 skills + definitions + writing issues)
entries.plain: Test-takers now receive a comprehensive multi-page report showing all four skills, scoring details, writing issues with examples, and pronunciation feedback.
entries.explanation:
"Download report" was only a 1-page certificate. New comprehensive report:
- Per-skill breakdown: reading + listening (correct/total + CEFR), writing (all
  7 criteria as 1-5 bars + feedback), speaking (criteria + pronunciation +
  transcript + feedback), overall CEFR + confidence range.
- "What we measure" definitions block.
- FLU-4: the writing scorer now emits SPECIFIC issues (grammar / spelling /
  punctuation / vocabulary / etiquette / structure) each with the offending
  quote + a correction; rendered as a "Specific issues" section. Stored in the
  existing result jsonb, so it rides along - older results just show no issues.

New staff-gated route /api/ac/fluent/[resultId]/report (React-PDF). The runner's
staff download + the cohort row now offer "Full report" (the certificate stays
as a secondary CEFR cert). Verified live: report 200/valid PDF. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: XP-13 (Fluent): hide results from the taker; staff-only certificate
entries.plain: Fluent results are now hidden from test-takers and certificates become staff-only, preventing candidates from accessing reports they should not see.
entries.explanation:
Part 1 of the cross-portal "taker never sees results; admin downloads/sends"
change. Fluent specifically also closes a real leak: the certificate route was
public in middleware, so anyone with a result UUID could pull the PDF.

- Score route returns an isStaff flag (admin/consultant/assessor via
  getCurrentCaller) and only returns result_id to staff; stops emailing the
  taker their certificate.
- Runner shows the full result + download ONLY to staff; a delegate/anonymous
  taker now sees a "submitted, results shared with the organisation" thank-you.
- Certificate removed from the public middleware list AND self-gated with
  requireRole(admin/consultant/assessor) (defence-in-depth) - admin still
  downloads/sends from /ac/fluent/cohort.
- New shared isStaffCaller() helper in ara/auth-guards.

tsc + lint clean. Other portals (Cognitive, Persona, ARC personal) next; Technical already conforms.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent integrity: mirror widened capture to the Pre-Hire stage (CAL-FLU-601)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire assessments that include Fluent now capture the same detailed integrity signals (time away, paste attempts, events) as standalone Fluent tests.
entries.explanation:
The Pre-Hire Fluent stage had the same count-only proctor. Mirror the AC
capture: time-away DURATION (window blur/focus + visibilitychange, debounced,
deduped), paste CHAR-LENGTH (never content), events log. The submit route
computes the advisory integrity signal and persists it into the stage flags
jsonb for the recruiter/fairness view (never auto-fails). Completes CAL-FLU-601
across both Fluent surfaces.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent integrity: widen capture + advisory signal (CAL-FLU-601, AC surface)
entries.plain: Fluent now detects when test-takers look away or paste content, scoring integrity on a 0-100 scale to help identify cheating.
entries.explanation:
New pure src/lib/scoring/integrity.ts (computeIntegritySignal -> 0-100 +
clean/minor/elevated tier + reasons; back-compat with old {blurCount,
pasteCount} rows; PDPL-safe). The /ac/fluent runner now captures time-away
DURATION (window blur/focus + visibilitychange, 1.5s-debounced, dedup so a
tab switch isn't double-counted - catches 2nd-monitor/devtools that
document.hidden missed) and paste CHAR-LENGTH (never the pasted text) on the
writing + speaking-fallback boxes, with a time-stamped events log. The score
route computes the signal, folds it into the integrity_flags jsonb (no
migration), and returns it on the result. Surfaced as an advisory,
never-auto-fail panel on the candidate results screen and as a tiered signal
on the admin cohort. Proctor copy updated (EN/AR) to match what's captured.
Pre-Hire Fluent stage mirror follows next.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: pre-expiry timer warnings + transcript flush + no-limit fix (CAL-FLU-605)
entries.plain: Fluent now warns test-takers 2 minutes and 1 minute before time runs out, and captures spoken answers before auto-submitting.
entries.explanation:
The countdown auto-submits on expiry but gave no warning and could drop an
in-flight recording. Now: an amber banner + aria-live announcement at ~2 min
and <1 min before expiry; on auto-submit any in-flight recording is stopped
first (browser STT streams interim text into the transcript, so the spoken
answer is captured and the mic released) rather than submitting mid-record.
Also fixes the latent coercion that forced a deliberate no-limit (timerMinutes
0) back to 15 - an explicit 0 now means no countdown/auto-submit; undefined
still defaults to 15. Bilingual EN/AR.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: clear unanswered-questions prompt instead of a silent block (CAL-FLU-604)
entries.plain: Fluent now shows a clear message listing unanswered questions instead of silently blocking submission, with a jump-to-first button.
entries.explanation:
Submit was disabled with no feedback when items were incomplete, trapping
the taker. Now the button validates on click: if anything is incomplete it
reveals a clear summary (N unanswered + writing-too-short + speaking-needed),
rings + labels each unanswered reading/listening item, rings the writing/
speaking section, and offers a 'go to first unanswered' jump. The timer
auto-submit path still calls submit() directly (force-submits on expiry,
unchanged). Bilingual EN/AR. Also clears one pre-existing em dash.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire email: route through Resend so reports actually deliver (CAL-PRE-507)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire assessment reports now actually send to clients via email instead of being marked sent without delivering.
entries.explanation:
sendEmail/isEmailConfigured were Microsoft Graph-only, but production
sends via Resend - so deliverReport console-mock-'sent', emailed stayed
false, report_sent_at never stamped, and the UI showed 'not configured'
while nothing reached the client. Make sendEmail Resend-first (mirroring
src/lib/ara/email.ts) with attachment passthrough, and isEmailConfigured
= resendConfigured() || Graph. Also fixes Pre-Hire invitations + AC
Fluent result emails, which shared the same Graph-only path. Blast radius:
all AC templates now send via Resend in prod (intended - Resend is the
live verified sender); smoke-test one AC send after deploy. Also clears
4 pre-existing em dashes in the Pre-Hire email templates (SOP).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Landing/catalogue: CAL-101 level filter row, CAL-102/103 Fluent badges
entries.plain: Course catalogue now has a dedicated filter row for course level, and Fluent appears in Talent Management with clear badges for hiring and development.
entries.explanation:
CAL-101: course-level filters moved to their own labelled row in the /courses
catalogue (Vertical row + 'Course Level' row, divider between), new i18n key
filterLevelLabel (en/ar); filtering logic unchanged, mobile stacks.
CAL-102: 'For Selection' badge added to the AI English Placement (Fluent) card on
Talent Acquisition.
CAL-103: Fluent added to Talent Management as the development-mode counterpart of
the same engine, with a 'For Development' badge (Languages SVG icon, /ac/fluent).
Both reuse the existing dual-purpose card + badge system.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: expand no-AI fallback deck to 10R/10L + strip stray control bytes
entries.plain: Fluent's backup test (when AI is unavailable) now includes the full 10 reading and 10 listening items to match the main assessment.
entries.explanation:
- The static fallback test (served only when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent) was
  3 reading / 2 listening, not matching the AI path's 10/10 shape. Expanded
  both to 10 items each with an A1->C2 CEFR difficulty ramp, so a no-key
  deployment still delivers the full-length placement.
- Removed three raw control bytes (a literal NUL + 0x1f + 0x7f) that had crept
  into the sanitizeResponse() regex character class; restored the intended
  escaped form /[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/g. The NUL had been making git/ripgrep treat
  the file as binary.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: 10R/10L, richer writing rubric, mandatory speaking, definitions
entries.plain: Fluent now tests 10 reading and 10 listening items with mandatory speaking, and grades writing on 7 criteria including tone and spelling.
entries.explanation:
- Test now generates 10 reading + 10 listening items (full A1-C2 ramp),
  1 writing + 1 speaking task; larger token budget + an >=8 reading
  fallback threshold.
- Writing rubric expanded from 4 to 7 criteria: adds Register
  (business-like tone), Etiquette (courtesy/politeness/cultural fit) and
  Mechanics (spelling/punctuation) alongside task/coherence/lexical/
  grammar. Threaded through the scorer prompt + parsing + ensemble +
  fallbacks + persisted criteria (jsonb, no migration) + the result bars
  (EN/AR labels).
- Speaking is now MANDATORY: submit is blocked until a spoken (or typed-
  fallback) response of >=3 words exists; the "optional" badge becomes a
  "required" badge.
- New bilingual "What we measure" definitions panel on the result
  (4 skills + every writing/speaking sub-criterion); the download button
  is relabelled "Download report".

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: retention/cleanup admin (to ARC bar)
entries.plain: Fluent admins can now view and delete old results beyond the 2-year compliance window through a new retention management page.
entries.explanation:
Closes Fluent's lifecycle gap vs the ARC bar: a /ac/fluent/retention admin
page (linked from the runner nav) showing total vs past-window result
counts and a typed-confirmation purge of results older than the 2-year
compliance window (plus their calibration score-runs). No migration.
Reassessment is N/A for a placement test (re-test = a new voucher/run).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fluent: full standalone voucher model
entries.plain: Fluent now supports voucher-based access like other assessments, letting clients generate and distribute test codes to candidates.
entries.explanation:
Bring Fluent to the standalone template (client registration -> vouchers
-> org-scoped results):
- eng_fluent_vouchers + redemptions + claim RPC (migration 00104); results
  gain organization_id + voucher_redemption_id
- admin console /ac/fluent/vouchers: generate seat-pool batches tagged to a
  client (registered first-class via the shared registry), copy, disable
- public redeem /ac/fluent/redeem -> token-gated runner /ac/fluent/take/[token]
  (middleware-bypassed, no account); completion stamps the result with the
  client org
- cohort report gains a Client column + ?org filter chips (org-scoped results)
All paths tolerant: inert until 00104 is applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix a mis-keyed Logica item, and the dead counter that hid it
entries.plain: A math question in Logica (about water flow rate) that was marked wrong when answered correctly has been fixed.
entries.explanation:
The numerical item 'a tap pours 9 litres every 6 minutes, how many in
10 minutes' was keyed to 13.5 litres. The rate is 1.5 litres a minute,
so the answer is 15. The rationale contained the same false arithmetic
in the sentence that computed it: '1.5 x 10 = 13.5'.

Three people sat it, on 15 July. All three chose 15 litres, and all
three were marked wrong. They were trial reviewers, not clients, so no
client result is affected. Fixed in cognitive-seed.ts and in the live
bank row; the historical responses are left as they were recorded.

I checked the arithmetic of all 30 numerical seed items while I was
there. The other 29 are correctly keyed.

While building a check that would catch the next one, times_correct
turned out to be dead: nothing ever wrote it, so all 120 served items
read zero correct and my first version of the flag lit up the entire
bank. Two fixes. The cognitive score route now maintains times_correct
the way Technical always has. And the flag is computed from
psy_item_responses, which is the record that actually exists: an item
several people ANSWERED and nobody got right is more likely mis-keyed
than that hard, because even a brutal 4-option item collects lucky
guesses. Skips are excluded - counting blanks made a correctly-keyed
multiples-of-6 item look broken because one person ran out of time.

Across the live bank the rule now flags exactly one item: the tap item,
whose three answers are still logged under the old key.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: trial-feedback fixes (timer, autosave, delegate scope, i18n)
entries.plain: Logica now displays the countdown timer throughout the test, groups questions by section, and prevents accidental submission with a confirmation step.
entries.explanation:
Fixes from the 15 Jul Logica trial (7 reviewers - Ali, Ammar, Asaad, Jomaa,
Omar, Yassin, Ahmad Ghosheh):

Runner UX
- Sticky countdown + progress bar while answering. Three of seven flagged
  that on a timed 36-question page the timer only existed at the very bottom;
  Ghosheh reported it as "no timer displayed" outright.
- Questions grouped under per-subtest section headers with per-section
  progress, continuous numbering (Ali).
- Two-step submit: the sitting is single-use, so one stray click no longer
  ends it (Asaad). Timeout auto-submit deliberately bypasses confirmation.
- Take-page welcome follows the in-card EN/AR toggle via a shared language
  context (Omar - same fix pattern as Fluent); name/email labels and
  placeholders translated; the "already completed" card is bilingual (Asaad).

Autosave + resume (Asaad: "one accidental refresh wipes all 36 answers")
- The key-stripped test, answers and deadline snapshot to the device on every
  change; a reload within the 3h session TTL resumes mid-test with the timer
  continuing from the ORIGINAL deadline. No integrity change: the blob holds
  no answer key, grading stays server-side, the session stays single-use.
- Review-hardened twice: (1) resume is keyed per token / per candidate, and
  on the staff surface it is OFFERED via a banner rather than silently
