  applied - a shared proctor machine would otherwise resume candidate A's
  sitting for candidate B and misattribute the result; (2) a terminal 409/410
  on submit clears the blob and returns to the intro instead of restoring the
  same doomed session on every reload.

Voucher delegates
- The free subtest picker is gone for token sittings: a delegate who picked
  "numerical only" burned their single sitting on a quarter of the battery
  and was then locked out of the rest (Omar). Delegates run the voucher's
  issued scope, or the full battery.
- The time limit scales with scope - max(10, base x n/4), computed once
  server-side, stamped into the session deadline, returned to the client, and
  mirrored on the intro (Omar: "the 40 minutes do not change").
- Server-side email validation before the seat claim in the cognitive AND
  persona redeem actions (Asaad - same gap he flagged on Fluent, whose action
  got the fix first).

Verified live end-to-end with temp vouchers: no picker for delegates, 4
section headers, sticky bar, autosave -> reload -> resumed with the answer
checked and 39:23 on the clock, disarm + confirm submit, blob cleared,
bilingual completed card, 1-subtest voucher advertises and gets 10 minutes,
Arabic toggle flips header + labels + intro. All temp data removed.

The three flagged questions were checked against the bank and all three are
keyed correctly (marbles = 54; the syllogism's "some locked things are not
books on the top shelf" is the valid conclusion; the chess ranking = Nadia) -
reviewer misreads, not content bugs.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: capture the taker's identity on the result itself
entries.plain: Logica results now capture the candidate's email and name so results remain identifiable even after data purge routines run.
entries.explanation:
35 of 39 stored cognitive results had no email. The runner has never had an
email field: it hardcoded takerEmail:null on start and omitted it entirely
from the score payload, and unlike Fluent its take page never passed the
redeemer's email through from the voucher redemption. Identity survived only
as a join onto cognitive_voucher_redemptions - and the retention purge
overwrites those columns with "[purged]", so that join has a shelf life.

- The take page now passes the redeemer's name AND email as prefills.
- The runner gains an Email (optional) field and sends both on start + score.
- The score route fills any identity the payload left blank from the
  redemption, which is the authoritative record of who this is. A taker who
  clears the optional fields no longer produces an unattributable result.

Guard the retention sentinel on every path it can now reach. A redemption is
anonymised on redeemed_at alone, not on whether it was ever completed, so an
old un-completed token stays live with "[purged]" in its name and email.
Without this the delegate would be greeted "Welcome, [purged]", have it
prefilled into their fields, and have it stored as their identity - worse
than null, because it reads as real on a report. New shared helper in
src/lib/privacy/purged.ts; the three retention writers still hardcode the
string and should adopt it.

Also backfilled the 20 existing voucher-linked results from their redemptions
(email only - no name was overwritten, purged rows skipped). Every real
cognitive sitting is now attributable without a join; the 9 remaining
identity-less rows are anonymous staff test runs from June, not client data.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: paginate cohort/norms/retention/bank/vouchers (1000-row cap)
entries.plain: Logica can now handle cohorts with more than 1000 test results without silently dropping data, ensuring accurate benchmarking and percentile scores.
entries.explanation:
A single PostgREST select silently truncates at 1000 rows, corrupting
every cohort-scaled read:
- computePilotNorms: the Tier-2 norm mean/SD was computed from an arbitrary
  1000-row slice once >1000 sittings existed - so the "norm-referenced"
  percentiles clients see were built on a truncated, biased sample. Now
  paginated; a read error ABORTS (never persists partial norms).
- cohort page: "Tests taken", Average g, band distribution + subtest
  averages were capped at 500. Now computed over the full cohort (the
  per-row table is capped at 300 with a "showing N of M" note).
- retention purge: the expired-id gather capped at 1000, so a backlog
  > 1000 left PII past the 2-year window. Now gathered paginated +
  deleted in chunks.
- loadPsyBank Cronbach alpha: the response read's .limit(20000) was
  clamped to 1000. Now paginated.
- voucher list: older codes past the newest 1000 were invisible +
  unmanageable. Now paginated.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: close voucher retake + score-persist + norm integrity gaps
entries.plain: Logica candidates can no longer retake a test using the same voucher or exploit the scoring system to overwrite previous results.
entries.explanation:
- Retake (HIGH): session single-use was fixed in June but nothing gated
  re-use at the REDEMPTION level - a delegate could 'Start over', retake
  with practice advantage, and overwrite the org-visible result. Now
  gated at three layers: the take page shows an 'already completed' state,
  the start action refuses a new session once result_id is set, and the
  score action early-rejects a completed redemption + claims it atomically
  (WHERE result_id IS NULL), deleting a losing concurrent sitting's orphan.
- Score persist (MED): the psy_results insert error was ignored - on
  failure the session was consumed but the taker was told 'results shared'.
  Now un-consumes the session and returns a retryable 503.
- g-norm (MED): computePilotNorms pooled partial-subtest sittings' overall
  into 'g'; now only full-battery sittings contribute to the g norm.
- Item drafter (MED): reject duplicate-option MCQs before they enter the bank.
- Reopen-bank (LOW): 'logica' reopen now covers the whole approved COGNITIVE
  pool (scoped to the cognitive instrument's scales, so it can't un-approve
  personality items sharing psy_items).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Retire Big-Five personality psychometrics (cognitive-only)
entries.plain: Personality assessments have been removed from Logica; Persona is now the only behavioural tool on the platform.
entries.explanation:
Remove the OCEAN/Mini-IPIP/IPIP-50 personality instrument entirely; the
behavioural self-report instrument is Persona. Narrow the psy "kind" to
cognitive across the framework, scoring, bank loader/assembler, generator,
drafter, norms, runner, and report. Drop the IPIP-50 seed + personality tab
from the SME console, the personality "predicts" folding in the unified
profile, the personality evidence-catalogue entry, and delete ipip50.ts.
Add migration 00186 to purge orphaned personality instrument/scale/item/
result/norm rows. Logica (cognitive) is untouched.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Provisional flag on Logica / Fluent / Pre-Hire (Techno honest by design)
entries.plain: Results from Logica, Fluent, and Pre-Hire now show a 'provisional' notice while their AI-written questions are awaiting human expert approval.
entries.explanation:
Finish Option 2 on the four live-AI banks. A shared per-bank predicate
(serves-live.ts) mirrors the readiness servesLive logic: while a bank
still mints items live-AI at sitting time (its vetted pool isn't
SME-promoted), its results are provisional. Clears per-bank as you
approve/promote.

- Logica: provisional banner on the psychometric report PDF
- Fluent: a "items pending SME review" clause appended to the
  certificate's existing indicative disclaimer
- Pre-Hire: a bilingual provisional strip on the screening report
  (full + summary), driven from the PDF builder
- Techno: no change needed - its result already labels every domain
  "Certified" (approved bank) vs "Indicative" (live-AI) per domain, a
  stronger built-in version of the flag; it never presents live-AI
  content as vetted

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: gate the cognitive bank behind real SME review
entries.plain: Logica questions now require human expert review before use, matching the same quality gate as Techno and Pre-Hire assessments.
entries.explanation:
The cognitive seed inserted items as 'approved', so the automated
seed self-approved the whole bank and the readiness dashboard showed
Logica "serving the SME-reviewed fixed form" - jumping the very
human-review gate it was meant to have. Logica is AI-authored +
agent-reviewed, not human-SME-reviewed or norm-calibrated: its honest
posture is indicative, behind a review gate, exactly like Techno /
Pre-Hire / Fluent.

- seed-cognitive-bank.ts now lands items in_review (not approved); an
  automated seed must never self-approve
- readiness: Logica surfaces the in_review backlog + an honest
  "awaiting SME approval, mints live-AI until then" note; serves the
  bank only once a human approves every subtest to the floor
- reverted the 120 live seed_v1 items approved -> in_review on prod

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rebrand the Psychometrics bank console to Logica
entries.plain: The Psychometrics console has been renamed to Logica to reflect that it now manages only cognitive tests.
entries.explanation:
The psych bank console manages only the Logica (cognitive) instrument now -
Big Five/OCEAN personality is retired - so the "Psychometrics" branding is
redundant. Rebrand the console header + nav label + the start-service label to
Logica (EN + AR), and strip the stale "Big-Five personality" wording from the
service description. Internal plumbing (psy_* tables, the /admin/psychometrics
route, /lib/psychometrics, /api/ac/psychometrics) and the scientific term
"psychometric" (AI prompts, proposal "Psychometric foundations", citations) are
deliberately left as-is.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Item banks: mark Big Five/OCEAN retired (not a live-AI risk)
entries.plain: The retired personality assessment is now clearly marked as inactive on the readiness dashboard and excluded from service metrics.
entries.explanation:
The personality/Big-Five psy instrument has no live caller - both callers of
generatePsyTest (the cognitive route + the bespoke bundle sitting) serve
kind="cognitive", and the standalone /ac/psychometrics runner is retired
(Persona is the behavioural self-report now). So it can't "scramble at deal
time" - it is never served.

Readiness dashboard now shows it as "Retired - not served" (muted), and the
metrics (banks-serving-live, at-target units, review-gate) count only active
banks - so a retired instrument no longer inflates the risk numbers. The
personality scoring/report code stays for the Foundations layer.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: serve a reviewed fixed-form cognitive bank (structural fix)
entries.plain: Logica now uses a fixed set of human-reviewed questions instead of generating new ones per test, eliminating inconsistent results and off-topic content.
entries.explanation:
Replaces Logica's live-AI-per-sitting generation with a fixed, SME-reviewed
item bank served against a per-subtest x per-facet blueprint. Closes the three
defects a tester found: construct drift between sittings, finance/banking
contamination of a reasoning construct, and deductive items served under
"Verbal" (plus a 3-item Arabic fallback deck).

Engine + schema (migration 00179 - additive):
- framework.ts: COGNITIVE_BLUEPRINT (4 subtests x 3 facets), Verbal<->Deductive
  definitions deconflicted, "number series" moved out of numerical
- bank.ts assembleFromBank: blueprint-aware - draws a fixed 1 easy/1 medium/1
  hard per facet (9/subtest), fails safe to null if any cell can't fill, and in
  Arabic requires a complete MSA translation (no silent English fallback)
- generate.ts: neutral (domain-free) prompts; requireBank throws
  BankUnavailableError -> route 503 (never a live/short deck for a real sitting);
  static dev deck re-tagged construct-clean; served_source threaded
- route.ts: requireBank for candidate/voucher sittings, times_administered bump
  (revives the exposure rotation), served_source persisted, timer widened for 36
- migration 00179: psy_items.facet/rationale/ar_reviewed + reviewer identity +
  'rejected' status + served_source + psy_increment_administered()

Content + review:
- cognitive-seed.ts: 120 vetted bilingual items (10/facet, 3E/4M/3H), authored
  to blueprint then adversarially construct-reviewed; scripts/seed-cognitive-bank.ts
- actions.ts: two-person review (approver != drafter), facet requirement, edit-
  resets-to-review, Arabic-review flag, cognitive seed action
- bank-console.tsx: per-facet readiness, reject + Arabic-review controls, seed banner

Readiness dashboard: Logica now reads "Fixed vetted content" (was live-AI);
fixed a psy_scales column bug (scale_key -> key) that read the bank as empty.

Verified end-to-end on the live bank: EN/AR full battery serve 36 bank items
(9/subtest, every facet = 3), identical composition across sittings, scoped
verbal = 9 balanced items, no Arabic fallback.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Item banks: cross-bank readiness dashboard
entries.plain: A new dashboard shows the readiness of every test bank, flagging which ones still generate live AI questions at test time.
entries.explanation:
New /admin/item-banks — a pipeline view of every service's test bank so a
real deal is never met with live-AI "problem questions". For each bank it
shows vetted items per unit (domain / subtest / pillar) vs a blueprint
target (green/amber/red), and flags which banks still generate items live
at sitting time (the scramble risk).

- src/lib/bank-readiness/readiness.ts: per-bank loaders (Techno by domain,
  Logica + Psychometrics by scale via psy_items, Fluent by skill, ARC on
  the active bank version by pillar, AC indicators, Persona code items,
  Pre-Hire = none, Reflect templates); all tolerant of empty/missing tables
- Page: metrics (banks-serving-live, domains-at-target, vetted total, banks
  with an SME gate) + a scramble banner + per-bank cards with unit fill bars
- "Item Banks" nav link under Platform

Live data confirms the audit: 5 banks serve live-AI (Logica/Psychometrics/
Fluent/Pre-Hire/Techno-empty); ARC is fully seeded; Fluent has 384 items
but none promoted to 'live'.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Proposals: make Terms, Definitions & Acceptance fully editable
entries.plain: Proposal sections for Terms, Definitions, and Acceptance can now be fully edited before sending to candidates.
entries.explanation:
Those three sections used to show a blank "intro above generated
content" box, which read as missing text. They are now fully editable:
the section editor pre-fills each with its actual wording and an edit
replaces it.

- Terms clauses, the Definitions glossary and the Acceptance steps are
  wrapped in secBody so an override replaces them (Terms/Acceptance have
  no table; Definitions opts out of the table-prepend rule via
  FORCE_REPLACE and the glossary is extracted to "- Term - Meaning"
  bullets)
- The Acceptance signature grid + contact line stay generated (outside
  the editable wrap), so an edit can't remove the signing block
- The purely-computed sections (Commercial pricing, Psychometric
  evidence, Implementation timeline, Evidence samples) keep the
  intro-note behaviour
- htmlToEditText renders table rows as bullets; EN + AR both updated

Verified: the three sections pre-fill with editable text and stay
replace-kind; Commercial stays intro-note; with no override the
clauses/glossary/signature grid render intact; an override replaces the
body while the signature grid survives; EN/AR PDF + Word all export 200.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Proposals: editable per-section text overrides (EN + AR)
entries.plain: All 19 proposal sections can now be rewritten per-deal in English and Arabic, with blank sections keeping standard text and filled sections replacing it.
entries.explanation:
Every one of the 19 proposal sections can now be rewritten per-proposal
before export. Blank = keep the standard boilerplate; filled = replace
the section body (or, for table-bearing sections - Commercial,
Definitions, Acceptance, Psychometric, Evidence - prepend the text above
the generated tables so pricing/signature content survives).

- Render: secBody/secIntro helpers in proposal-html.ts (EN) +
  proposal-html-ar.ts (AR), each reading its own language key. Headings,
  numbering, TOC and cross-refs stay generated. markdown-lite: blank line
  = paragraph, "- " = bullet.
- Storage: licence_data.sectionOverrides { "<title>": { en, ar } } - no
  migration (rides the existing jsonb bag).
- Builder: a collapsible "Proposal text (optional overrides)" panel with
  an EN + AR textarea per section; only non-empty entries are saved.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Proposals Phase 2: section selection + tiers, live psychometrics, ROI, evidence appendix
entries.plain: Proposals now let you pick which sections to include, with some mandatory, and automatically renumber all references and clauses when sections change.
entries.explanation:
- Per-deal section selection with MANDATORY/RECOMMENDED/OPTIONAL tiers
  (PROPOSAL_SECTION_DEFS in constants). Builder gains a "Sections to include"
  card; mandatory sections are locked on and are the only cross-referenced ones,
  so a reference can never point at an excluded section. proposal-html numbering,
  TOC and the T&C clause counter all derive dynamically from the included set -
  removing a section renumbers cleanly (verified: T&C at 14 -> clause prefix 14.).
- Psychometric Foundations now shows a live "Current platform evidence" block
  from real engine reads (evidence-summary.ts composes gatherEvidenceMetrics +
  loadPsyBank): Logica Cronbach's alpha + item count, Fluent calibration/human
  ratings, Technical approved/cut-scores, ARC verified questions, Reflect
  framework counts. Fully null-tolerant - the PDF never 500s if tables are empty.
- Executive summary gains an optional indicative-return (ROI) paragraph driven
  by avg salary + hires/year (stored in licence_data.roi), with an explicit
  "illustrative, not a guarantee" caveat.
- New "Evidence & sample reports" appendix (optional) surfaces the same live
  metrics as a table + methodology-brief note.
- section_selection + licence_data now persist through the column-peel write path;
  both PDF routes + the email action fetch evidence and pass it through.

Phase 2 of the TI-merge follow-ups. tsc + lint clean; PDF render verified.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica audit fixes: cohort IDOR (critical) + reports, timer, retention, i18n
entries.plain: Cognitive tests now prevent unauthorized access to test-taker names, emails, and scores - staff can only see their own organization's data.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial audit of the Cognitive/Psychometrics module (8 findings). All
app-layer, no migration.

Critical
- Cognitive cohort page had no staff gate and no org scoping - a service-role
  query returned every org's taker names, emails, and scores to any signed-in
  user. Now gated to staff; a client_manager is scoped to their own org
  (mirrors the report route + the Persona cohort fix).

Minor
- Retention purge now anonymises voucher-redemption PII and sweeps expired
  psy_sessions (keyed test + taker email), so no PII outlives the 2-year rule.
- Report no longer prints a "General mental ability (g)" composite for a scoped
  sitting: single-subtest suppresses it, a partial battery is relabelled
  "Reasoning average (partial battery)".
- Arabic taker names no longer render as tofu on the (Helvetica) report and
  bundle cover - they fall back to the email, then a generic label.
- Server-side time-limit backstop: the cognitive route stamps a deadline at
  start and rejects a grossly-late score (client auto-submit unchanged).
- Bilingual pre-test notice (item count, time limit, single-use, answers final,
  refresh loses progress) before the taker commits.
- Remaining English-only runner controls (subtitle, Begin, answered-count,
  Submit) now localise in Arabic mode.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bundle combined report: one PDF for the whole sitting
entries.plain: Assessment results can now be downloaded as one combined PDF containing all test reports together instead of separate files.
entries.explanation: New /api/admin/bundle/[candidateId]/report merges an executive cover (bundle + candidate + org, per-service 'Sitting at a glance' summary, contents with computed page numbers) with the FULL standalone reports - Persona profile, Persona Leadership Report, Logica result - via pdf-lib, so the combined document can never drift from the individual ones. The Logica report data mapping is extracted to a shared builder (psy-report-data.ts) reused by both routes. Route is deliberately OUTSIDE the middleware-bypassed /api/bundle/ prefix: admin/staff always, client_manager only for their own org. Portal bundle roster gains a 'Combined report (PDF)' link per completed candidate; individual per-service reports remain available. Verified against the live Talent Director retest sitting (18-page merged PDF, cover summary + page numbers correct).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Remove leftover throwaway test script
entries.plain: Removed a temporary test file that was accidentally left in the system.
entries.explanation: scripts/_t8.mjs was a one-off local repro for the Logica score flow, accidentally committed. No secrets (reads .env.local at runtime).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: scoped tests get real length + honest scope copy
entries.plain: Cognitive tests now adjust the number of questions based on how many subtests you select, so taking one subtest gives you more questions to answer fairly.
entries.explanation: Items-per-subtest now scales to the selection (1 subtest -> 10 items, 2 -> 6 each, 3 -> 5 each, 4 -> 4 each) instead of a flat 4/subtest that made a single-subtest sitting just 4 questions; the AI floor rises accordingly. The runner's header + intro card now name only the scoped subtests ('Inductive reasoning - an indicative...') instead of always listing all four. Verified: inductive-only start returns 10 inductive items; take page shows scoped copy only.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica take page: title + subtitle readable on the dark hero
entries.plain: The Cognitive test start page title and instructions are now clearly visible against the dark banner for better readability.
entries.explanation: The take page overlaps the runner's header onto its dark hero banner, so the navy 'Logica' title was invisible and the subtitle straddled the band edge. New onDark mode renders the title white + subtitle white/80, and the hero is deepened (pb-36 / -mt-32) so the full header sits on the dark band with the white intro card popping below. Verified in-browser on a live take link.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: voucher takers no longer see 'Could not score' on successful submit
entries.plain: Fixed an issue where voucher users saw an error message even when their test was completed and scored successfully.
entries.explanation: XP-13 made the score route return result=null to non-staff takers (no score data over the wire), and the thank-you screen was written accordingly - but the submit guard still required d.result, so every voucher delegate's SUCCESSFUL submit was mislabelled 'Could not score.' and their retry hit the single-use guard ('already been submitted'). Scores were persisting the whole time. Success is now res.ok alone; canView requires staff + a result body. Verified as a real anonymous taker in-browser: inductive-scoped voucher -> begin -> answer 16 -> submit -> thank-you screen, no error, no score leak, result row persisted.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica: subtest-scoped vouchers (e.g. Inductive Reasoning only)
entries.plain: You can now issue vouchers for specific cognitive subtests only, so candidates complete just the reasoning type they need to demonstrate.
entries.explanation: Migration 00170 adds cognitive_vouchers.subtests text[] (NULL = full battery, CHECK-constrained to the four keys). Issue flow: subtest-scope chips on the voucher issuer (with ?subtests= prefill) + an 'Issue a voucher for this selection' link on the runner picker, right where only 'Begin assessment' was offered. Delegate flow: the take page locks the picker to the voucher's set, and the start API re-resolves the scope server-side from the redemption token so a tampered client can never widen it. Verified E2E on the live DB: an inductive-only voucher + a start request asking for all four returned an inductive-only test. All paths tolerant of 00170 not being applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add Licensed Portal Preview: branded simulated tenant for pitches
entries.plain: A new preview mode lets you simulate how the platform looks for a prospective customer with their branding and selected features.
entries.explanation: Admin sidebar -> 'Licensed Preview' launcher: enter a prospect's org/sector/region/accent and open a full, navigable 'Caliber for {Org}' tenant - a Command Center plus a branded dashboard per licensed capability (AC, Techno, Logica, Persona, Fluent, AI Readiness, Reflect 360, Psychometrics, Pre-Hire, Academy, Credentials, Succession). Deterministic sample data from the org name; no DB writes, no real records. Admin-gated.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Voucher consolidation: shared core + redeem form + risk fixes
entries.plain: Fixed voucher security issues including ensuring all tests release seats properly and preventing personal data from appearing in shareable links.
entries.explanation:
Phase 0 (risk fixes):
- 00167: add eng_fluent_voucher_release_seat (Fluent was the only instrument
  with no seat-release - a failed redeem permanently burned a seat).
- Role Readiness redeem no longer trusts name/email from URL params (phishing
  vector); prefills from the voucher row server-side instead, dropping PII from
  the issued link (matches ARC/Fluent/Techno).

Phase 1 (shared core): src/lib/vouchers/ - codegen, types, descriptor registry
(all 7 engines), and core.redeemViaDescriptor (the single claim -> provision ->
compensate path). Cognitive/Logica redeem now delegates to it.

Phase 2 (shared UI): src/components/shared/voucher-redeem-form.tsx - one
bilingual EN/AR (RTL) redeem form. Fluent + Logica cut over to it (both gain the
language toggle they lacked).

Phase 4: Fluent redeem also delegates to the shared core.

Build + tsc verified green. Remaining services (Persona/Techno/Pre-Hire/RR/ARC)
are mechanical repeats of the same pattern - see docs/voucher-consolidation-plan.md.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica audit Batch 2: redeem PII-prefill + RTL, mid-test progress guard
entries.plain: Added safeguards to prevent phishing through voucher links, require right-to-left text for codes, and warn candidates if they try to leave a test mid-way.
entries.explanation:
- Redeem page: only the voucher code is honoured from the URL (name/email/company
  PII-prefill removed - phishing vector); code + email inputs pinned dir=ltr.
- Runner: beforeunload guard while a test is open, so a refresh/close/navigation
  warns before losing in-progress answers (answers live in state until submit).
tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Logica audit Batch 1: session integrity, result-leakage, vouchers, generator
entries.plain: Strengthened security to prevent test scores being submitted twice, enforce session time limits, and hide detailed score data from unauthorized access.
entries.explanation:
- Cognitive score route: enforce session TTL server-side (expired -> 410);
  atomically claim the single-use session (consumed false->true) BEFORE scoring so
  a double/concurrent submit can't score twice; and a non-staff response now
  carries result=null (the detailed scales/bands no longer ship over the wire -
  UI-hiding alone left them inspectable). Client thank-you no longer depends on
  the result body.
- migration 00159: cognitive_voucher_release_seat + lock EXECUTE on the voucher
  RPCs to service_role + pinned search_path. redeemVoucher releases the claimed
  seat on redemption-insert failure.
- Cognitive item generator: reject AI items with DUPLICATE options (a graded MCQ
  must have distinct choices - caught live where the correct answer was repeated).
- Cohort report bands via the canonical cognitiveBand (was a divergent local
  bandFromPct with different thresholds).
migration 00159 applied + verified live. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Demo data: extend the one-click seed/purge to all 10 services
entries.plain: Demo data now populates all seven assessment services, so guided walkthroughs show realistic completed screens for every product.
entries.explanation:
Phase 1 covered AC / Pre-Hire / Fluent only. Refactor the seeder to a per-service
module registry (src/lib/demo/services/*) and add the remaining seven so the
guided demos walk populated screens for every service:

- Persona: 3 completed self-assessment sittings (standalone path; results+cohort)
- Logica: 3 cognitive psy_results (above/avg/below) for the cohort report
- Techno: 3 sandbox sittings (advanced/intermediate/basic) for the results list
- VIFM Academy: enrollments (1 completed + lesson checks, 1 in progress)
- AR Compass: 1 enterprise assessment + 5 respondents + 120 responses, scored
  to pillar + overall via the real recalculate path
- Reflect 360: engagement + 2 participants + 9 raters + 140 responses (1 scored)
- Succession Readiness: combined engagement + 3 candidates vs a target role

Registry order = dependencies before dependents (Academy reads AC candidates,
Readiness reads Persona/Reflect); purge iterates in reverse. Each module is
idempotent, best-effort, tolerant of an un-applied migration, and scoped to the
demo org / sentinel so the purge removes it.

Verified end-to-end on the live DB: Load -> all 10 populate (zero errors, ~23s)
-> Remove -> all removed incl. both org stores, status clean. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rename product brand Logical -> Logica (correction)
entries.plain: Corrected the cognitive assessment's official brand name from Logical to Logica across all customer-facing materials.
entries.explanation:
Follow-up to the prior Mentium->Logical rename: the brand is "Logica", not
"Logical". Scoped to the 24 brand files only (capital-L replace), so the ordinary
word "logical"/"Psychological" elsewhere (fluent definitions, psychometrics
proposal, seed tags) is untouched. Arabic transliteration لوجيكال -> لوجيكا. Slug
logical->logica + methodology doc renamed (Logica-Methodology-Brief.md) -> brief
serves at /api/methodology/logica/pdf. Display-only; no data/route migration.
tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rename product brand Mentium -> Logical (display only)
entries.plain: Updated the cognitive assessment's brand name from Mentium to Logical in all customer-facing pages, emails, and reports.
entries.explanation:
Customer-facing brand rename across 24 files: "Mentium(R)" -> "Logical(R)" in the
landing tile, admin nav/dashboard, cognitive runner + cohort/voucher/retention
pages, portal-comparison sheet, evidence catalogue, emails, psychometric report,
and timer settings. Arabic transliteration "مينتيوم" -> "لوجيكال" in the 5
bilingual strings (placeholder, pending human review).

Methodology brief renamed (docs/Mentium-Methodology-Brief.md ->
Logical-Methodology-Brief.md) + registry entry (slug mentium->logical, service,
eyebrow, file, PDF filename) -> brief now serves at /api/methodology/logical/pdf.

Internal identifiers unchanged (routes /ac/cognitive, lib/cognitive,
lib/psychometrics, DB) - display-only rename, no data/route migration. tsc +
ESLint clean; zero Mentium/مينتيوم occurrences remain.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rename the cognitive assessment from "Reason" to "Mentium"
entries.plain: Renamed the cognitive assessment from Reason to Mentium across all user-visible screens, emails, and reports.
entries.explanation:
Brand rename: every user-facing standalone "Reason" -> "Mentium" (Arabic
"الاستدلال"-as-name -> "مينتيوم") across the runner hero, sidebar, admin hub +
landing + compare cards (EN+AR), cohort/vouchers/retention/redeem pages, voucher
hub, delegate emails, psychometric report, evidence catalogue, timer label, and
i18n values. Applied via a word-boundary regex so the "reasoning" construct
descriptors (taglines, subtest names, "numerical/verbal/inductive/deductive
reasoning") are untouched; the 5 Arabic name-sites done surgically so the
generic الاستدلال (reasoning) descriptors stay.

Verified: tsc + JSON clean; 0 standalone "Reason" left; runner + sidebar show
"Mentium"; "reasoning" descriptors preserved. Internal routes (/ac/cognitive),
tables, and identifiers unchanged.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Rename the Cognitive instrument to "Reason" across all user-facing surfaces
entries.plain: Renamed the cognitive assessment to Reason across all user-facing pages, navigation, emails, and reports.
entries.explanation:
Branding: the cognitive-ability instrument is now "Reason" (Arabic: الاستدلال)
everywhere a user sees it - sidebar nav, the runner hero, landing card (EN+AR),
portal comparison, evidence page, voucher hub + voucher/cohort/retention/redeem
sub-pages, delegate emails, admin cohorts, the psychometric report PDF, settings
timer label, and the instrument display constant.

Deliberately left as-is: the /ac/cognitive route + DB kind='cognitive', internal
identifiers (CognitiveItem, COGNITIVE_SUBTESTS, functions, types), Bloom's
CognitiveLevel, the THINKING-domain "Cognitive & strategic" caption, the quiz
"Cognitive Challenge" badge, and academic citations (Carroll, Field) - none are
the instrument's display name.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: XP-13 (Cognitive): hide results from the taker; staff-only report
entries.plain: Test-takers no longer see their cognitive assessment scores; only staff can view and download detailed results.
entries.explanation:
Same pattern as Fluent. The score route returns isStaff and only hands result_id
to staff; the runner shows the full score breakdown + Download only to staff, and
a delegate/anonymous taker now sees a "submitted" thank-you. The report PDF is
removed from the public middleware list and self-gated with requireRole; admins
download/send from the cohort view.

tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: SDAIA demo: fix Reflect UUID bug, cognitive subtest picker, sidebar relabel
entries.plain: Fixed three issues: Reflect feedback now accepts unselected organizations, cognitive tests let users pick which reasoning skills to assess, and sidebar labels updated.
entries.explanation:
SD-5: Reflect engagement create no longer rejects an unselected client org
with the raw "Invalid UUID" token - schema coerces ""->null + friendly
messages, wizard passes organization_id || null, action backstops the message.

SD-4: cognitive runner can choose any 1-4 of numerical/verbal/inductive/
deductive subtests. framework.sanitizeSubtests + COGNITIVE_SUBTEST_KEYS;
generatePsyTest/aiCognitive/staticCognitive/assembleFromBank are subset-aware
(default all four, back-compat); start route sanitizes server-side; intro
picker (bilingual, >=1 required, optional admin lock). Scoring/result/PDF were
already scale-agnostic.

SD-8: sidebar instrumentGroup first leaf relabelled "Overview" -> "Take
assessment" (svcRunner key + PlayCircle) - fixes the stray Cognitive/Persona/
Fluent runner-as-Overview mislabel. Two-column IA already shipped.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Cognitive route: keep org linkage when 00137 is pending (review fix)
entries.plain: Cognitive assessment results now correctly link to organizations even when database updates are pending.
entries.explanation:
The result-link SELECT referenced project_label, so on a pre-00137 DB
the read errored, nulled the redemption, and skipped the whole org-link
block (dropping organization_id + voucher_redemption_id + result_id).
Revert the SELECT to org-only columns and read project_label in a
separate best-effort query, mirroring the Persona path.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add registered mark to the Cognitive/psychometric report title
entries.plain: The cognitive assessment's registered trademark symbol now appears in the assessment report title.
entries.explanation:
The instrument name (e.g. "Cognitive Ability") in the psychometric report
hero now carries the registered mark, completing the report-branding pass
for the Cognitive service (the shared framework constant stays unmarked so
the on-screen runner is unaffected).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: docs: correct stale psychometrics route refs in CLAUDE.md
entries.plain: Updated documentation to reflect the correct paths where the cognitive assessment actually runs.
entries.explanation:
The live cognitive runner is /ac/cognitive + /api/ac/cognitive; the
/ac/psychometrics page + /api/ac/psychometrics API documented here never
existed at those paths (the OCEAN personality runner was retired in favour
of Persona). Corrected so the docs match the running app.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Persona/Cognitive: post-review + live-verification hardening
entries.plain: Fixed critical bugs where personality and cognitive assessments were freezing or losing responses during forced-choice questions.
entries.explanation:
Fixes surfaced by a live browser walkthrough + an adversarial multi-agent
review of the session's changes:

- Persona runner (CRITICAL): chooseIps called the autosave side effect inside
  the setIpsChoices updater, firing startTransition during render ("Cannot call
  startTransition while rendering") and silently dropping the state commit, so
  forced-choice blocks never registered and Submit hung. Moved the side effect
  into the event handler.
- Persona autosave: replaced one-server-action-per-answer with a debounced,
  batched flush (buffer keyed by itemKey, ~700ms debounce, immediate flush on
  page-advance + submit). The old pattern fired 160+ server actions per test
  and a router-refresh cascade that buried the submit; now it is a handful of
  calls. Verified end-to-end on the live DB: 205 responses persisted
  (164 normative + 41 ipsative with answer_data), hiring fit = 82% Strong fit.
- Cognitive (HIGH): the inductive odd-one-out "3,5,7,9,11" had no defensible
  answer (all odd). Replaced with a perfect-squares odd-one-out (4,9,16,20,25).
  Gave each subtest a genuine easy->hard spread in the fallback deck.
- Cognitive: cognitiveNarrative now reads s.raw (matches the report route;
  raw == normalized for cognitive, so behaviour is unchanged).
- item-drafter: dropped the dead "abstract" fallback string (retired construct).
- persona-format: buildIpsativeBlocks skips a competency with no forward item
  rather than falling back to a reverse item (which would be mis-keyed).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Migration 00111: backfill cognitive inductive/deductive links by id
entries.plain: Restored missing skill linkages for inductive and deductive reasoning components in the cognitive assessment database.
entries.explanation:
00109 seeded the inductive/deductive construct_competency_links predicts-rows
via a JOIN on competencies.name, but the behavioural 38 were renamed to the
current scheme after 00066 (id ...004 is now "Critical Analysis", not
"Analytical Reasoning"), so the name-join matched zero rows - confirmed against
the live DB (abstract rows deleted, inductive/deductive rows absent). This
backfill inserts the four links by stable competency UUID (rename-proof),
aligned with framework.ts COGNITIVE_SUBTESTS. Idempotent; user applies.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Cognitive: split abstract into inductive + deductive subtests
entries.plain: Cognitive assessment now separately measures inductive reasoning (pattern recognition) and deductive reasoning (logical application) instead of combining them.
entries.explanation:
Replace the single "abstract reasoning" subtest with two scientifically
distinct CHC-grounded subtests: inductive (infer the rule from patterns -
fluid intelligence) and deductive (apply rules/premises to a valid
conclusion - logical validity). The cognitive instrument now measures
four subtests: numerical, verbal, inductive, deductive.

- framework.ts: 4 subtests with fuller definitions (definition_en/_ar) +
  cognitiveNarrative() score-band copy (strong/mid/developing, bilingual).
- generate.ts: static fallback deck + AI prompt + valid-scale set cover
  all four; min item count raised to 8.
- item-drafter.ts: SME-draft prompt gains inductive + deductive branches.
- Runner result + PDF report now show each subtest's fuller definition and
  a per-scale narrative.
- Swept "abstract" -> "inductive/deductive" across all cognitive UI copy
  (runner, redeem, cohort, landing, timer settings) and report methodology.
- Migration 00109 (write-only; user applies): retire the abstract
  construct_competency_links predicts rows, seed inductive + deductive
  rows; tolerant remap of any abstract psy_scales/psy_items/psy_norms.

IPIP Big-Five "abstract ideas" personality items deliberately untouched.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Cognitive to ARC bar: admin-set timer + cohort + retention
entries.plain: Cognitive assessment gains a timer that administrators can customize, plus cohort performance reports and data retention controls.
entries.explanation:
- Finish /ac/psychometrics -> /ac/cognitive repoints (landing, sidebar,
  admin readiness/psychometrics, guided start, resolver, report header).
- Admin-configurable timer (assessment_timers "cognitive") with countdown
  + auto-submit on the runner; "Cognitive ability" row in /admin/settings.
- Org-scoped cohort report at /ac/cognitive/cohort (g + per-subtest
  averages, band distribution, per-run report links, client filter).
- Retention admin at /ac/cognitive/retention (24-month purge of
  psy_results, typed confirmation, admin-gated).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Cognitive: standalone voucher model
entries.plain: Cognitive assessment now has its own independent voucher and seat-pool system, letting organizations manage access separately from other assessments.
entries.explanation:
Give the Cognitive Ability service its own independent voucher system
(mirrors Fluent), separate from any psychometrics umbrella:
- cognitive_vouchers + redemptions + claim RPC (migration 00105); psy_results
  gains organization_id + voucher_redemption_id
- admin console /ac/cognitive/vouchers: generate seat-pool batches tagged to a
  client (registered first-class via the shared registry), copy, disable
- public redeem /ac/cognitive/redeem -> token runner /ac/cognitive/take/[token];
  completion stamps the result with the client org
- middleware bypass for the delegate paths. Tolerant; inert until 00105 applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Make Cognitive its own service: /ac/psychometrics -> /ac/cognitive
entries.plain: Cognitive ability tests now have their own dedicated section in the platform instead of being grouped with other assessments, making it easier to find and use.
entries.explanation:
Per "everything is psychometric, so list them independently": the
Cognitive runner is no longer bundled under a "Psychometrics" umbrella.
- move /ac/psychometrics -> /ac/cognitive and /api/ac/psychometrics ->
  /api/ac/cognitive (runner + result-report PDF)
- retitle to "Cognitive Ability"; drop the embedded Persona card so the
  page is purely cognitive (Persona is its own service at /ac/persona)
- repoint landing, sidebar, guided-start, readiness, item-bank link, and
  the persona back-link; persona card now links straight to /ac/persona

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Landing + sidebar: dual-pillar service taxonomy
entries.plain: The main navigation now clearly separates talent acquisition tools (for hiring) from talent management tools (for development), with the same assessments listed in both places depending on how you want to use them.
entries.explanation:
Mirror the selection/development model across the landing and the portal
sidebar:
- Assessment Center, AI Readiness, Technical, Cognitive, Persona are
  dual-purpose: listed under both Talent Acquisition (For Selection ->
  fit-score) and Talent Management (For Development -> VIFM Academy),
  with the AC console shown as "Development Center" on the management side
- Dissolve the Psychometrics grouping; Cognitive/Persona are standalone
- Pillar-colored icons: blue = Acquisition, emerald = Management
- Subgrid the pillar headers so both tile columns align regardless of
  sub-heading wrap
- Sidebar lists every service under each pillar (item bank moved to Platform)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: close framework-approval bypass + gamified submit loss + pagination
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now blocks raters from entering responses if the framework hasn't been officially approved, closing a major data integrity gap.
entries.explanation:
3rd-pass review fixes (6 verified defects + 2 diff-review nits):

Approval-gate + integrity (major):
- Rater write gate now requires status='live', not draft. A draft engagement's
  framework may be unapproved (00182) and still editable; its per-rater copy-link
  URLs were handed out pre-launch, so responses could land against an un-reviewed
  AI framework. 'live' is reachable only via launch, which enforces approval.
  Gate both requireRater + loadRaterByToken.writable; disable the copy-link/resend
  UI until live; distinct "not yet open" respond-page copy for a draft.
- Gamified rater form now uses the standard form's failedRef gate: retry failed
  saves on submit and REFUSE to mark complete while any remain unsaved. It was
  completing unconditionally, silently dropping a rater's answers on a save error.

1000-row cap (major/minor):
- Paginate the reminder-cron rater sweep, the cohort participants read, and the
  client-portal shell-invitation sweep (deterministic unique order each).
- Surface per-engagement reminder failures in the cron summary + audit metadata.

Anonymity (minor):
- Tenure-breakdown now suppresses a sub-anonymity-threshold sensitive group's
  tenure (a quasi-identifier), mirroring the verbatim/group-mean floor.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360 Batch 2: purge PII, credential gate, wizard gate, closed-form + minors
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now deletes rater email records during data purges and improved credential security and pagination for large feedback engagements.
entries.explanation:
Fixes the remaining confirmed findings from the Reflect 360 review:

Data integrity + privacy:
- Retention/sandbox purge now deletes reflect_email_log rows (FK is SET NULL,
  not CASCADE - rater email PII survived the purge forever, readable by every
  consultant). Both purges capture ids paginated + delete chunked so a >1000
  purge deletes everything and reports the true count (the select-ids-first
  refactor must not cap where the old direct delete didn't)
- Reflect 360 credential only issues once the engagement is complete/archived
  AND >=1 rater has submitted - was minting a verifiable "Completed" credential
  on ANY participant-PDF download, including a live/zero-response cycle
- New-engagement wizard page self-gates (consultant/admin) - it used the
  service-role client to load the full ara_organizations registry with no role
  check, so any logged-in user could read the client list

Correctness:
- Closed/expired engagement now shows a read-only "window closed" state
  (rater-access computes `writable`) instead of a fully interactive form whose
  every save is rejected server-side
- Reassessment/clone carry gamified_mode + ac_competency_id (a dropped
  gamified flag reverted the rerun to the standard form with no re-enable path;
  a dropped AC link reverted year-on-year reports to fuzzy name-matching);
  reassessment audit row now stamps performed_by
- Admin template-edit actions scoped to library-template frameworks (could
  rewrite a live engagement's behaviours under recorded responses)

Minors:
- Sandbox email fails closed (mock) when no redirect configured; reminder cron
  only nags invited raters + absolute-URL fallback; needs-scheduling.csv 500s on
  query error instead of serving a header-only 200; cohort PDF @page landscape;
  participant report back-nav; cohort participants rollup others-only (no
  self-mean fallback that leaked rater turnout)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360 Batch 1: scoring pagination, invite guard, anonymity, submit + PDF integrity
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now correctly handles engagements with many raters and questions, anonymity settings, and PDF generation without data loss or timeout.
entries.explanation:
Fixes the confirmed criticals + majors from the Reflect 360 code review:

Pagination (1000-row PostgREST cap - worse here than ARC: the 38-competency
framework serves 152 observer behaviours, so ONE participant with 8 raters is
1216 response rows):
- scoring.ts reflect_responses read + cohort reflect_raters completion counts
  now page via fetchAllPages/chunkIds; engagement-detail rater grid paginated
  (raterCount = actual rows, not a stat card that diverged from the list);
  invitation sweep paginated

Auth + anonymity:
- sendInvitationsForEngagement un-exported (its "use server" export was an
  unguarded endpoint emailing live rater tokens for ANY engagement) + a
  status must be 'live' guard; resend surfaces WHY it no-ops on draft
- per-cell group means gate anonymity on raters who contributed to THAT
  competency/behaviour (per-item N/A could leave a single sensitive rater's
  score published); tenure chip on verbatims only for self/manager (a peer's
  tenure bucket is a quasi-identifier the participant knows)

Rater submit integrity:
- Submit retries failed saves (behaviour/open/tenure/critical + the five
  open-questions via a retry handle) and REFUSES completion while any remain
  (bilingual banner) - was marking complete over silently-dropped saves
- comment debounce re-reads latest answer at fire time (a score click during
  the 700ms window was overwritten by the stale row); open-questions block
  checks res.ok===false (was showing green "Saved" on lifecycle rejections)
  and tracks all failures in a Set so every failed answer keeps its retry

client_manager PDF (the ARC blocker, unfixed for Reflect + now hardened
everywhere via one shared helper gotoInternalReportPage):
- middleware internal-render allow-list extended to the 3 Reflect report pages
- all 4 PDF routes (3 Reflect + the ARC one) attach cookie + x-ara-internal to
  EXACT-same-origin requests only (prefix match leaked to look-alike hosts) and
  assert the render landed on the report path (a 302 to /portal or /login
  resolves to 200, so a status-only check shipped the wrong page as the PDF)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: inline-edit template competency names + behaviour wording
entries.plain: Reflect 360 templates now allow you to edit competency names and behaviour descriptions directly without leaving the design view.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Item banks: Reflect 360 "Manage bank" link to the template console
entries.plain: The Reflect 360 item card now links to the template management console so you can edit questions and competencies.
entries.explanation:
Reflect 360's card had console:undefined, so no "Manage bank" link
rendered. But Reflect does have a management surface - the library-
template curation console at /reflect/admin/templates, where the seeded
41-competency VIFM framework (and other templates) are edited. Wire it
up + clarify the note. (Reflect isn't in the reopen set: its gate is
per-engagement framework approval, not a flat item-status bank.)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: seed the full 41-competency VIFM vetted template
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now includes a complete library of 41 vetted competencies with detailed behavioral examples in English and Arabic, ready to use as a template.
entries.explanation:
Author the complete VIFM behaviour set for the Reflect 360 vetted
library template - the content half of the vetted-framework feature.

- 41 competencies x 4 observable, frequency-rateable behaviours = 164,
  bilingual EN/AR, authored by a fan-out author->adversarial-review
  workflow (one agent pair per competency, 82 agents, 0 errors)
- committed as src/lib/reflect/vifm-framework-seed.ts
- scripts/seed-reflect-vifm-framework.ts seeds it as a library template
  ("VIFM Competency Framework (Full)", is_template, approved) - data
  only, no migration; inserts into reflect_frameworks/competencies/
  behaviors. Idempotent by name. Seeded on prod (41 comps / 164 beh).

With the source-based approval shipped in 150257e, a consultant who
clones this VIFM framework gets vetted content, auto-approved, no
provisional flag; pasting a client's own values still AI-decomposes
and stays provisional until approved. Closes the Reflect 360 build.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: source-based framework approval
entries.plain: Assessments based on VIFM's vetted competency template can launch immediately without waiting for consultant approval, speeding up feedback deployment.
entries.explanation:
Wire the "vetted framework vs own values" rule into the launch gate:
cloning a vetted library template (e.g. the VIFM framework) is approved
by construction - no AI-decomposed content to review - so it needs no
consultant sign-off before launch. AI + manual frameworks stay
un-approved (provisional) until the consultant approves via the gate.

This is the structural half of the Reflect vetted-template feature; the
content half (authoring the full 41-competency VIFM behaviour set into
an expanded library template) is the next piece.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: approve framework before raters are invited
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now requires a formal approval step before raters receive feedback invitations, ensuring quality control of assessment frameworks.
entries.explanation:
Per-engagement Reflect frameworks are AI-decomposed (Claude turns the
client's values into rater behaviours) and previously reached raters
with only informal review. Add a formal human approval gate.

- migration 00182: framework_approved_at/by on reflect_engagements;
  grandfather every non-draft engagement (already-in-use frameworks)
  so the gate only affects new launches
- launchReflectEngagement refuses to go live until the framework is
  approved (tolerant of an un-applied migration)
- approve/revoke server actions (owner-gated, audit-logged; revoke
  only while draft)
- seat/client-portal shells auto-approve at flip (they clone a
  pre-reviewed library template, never AI-decomposed) so self-serve
  is never blocked
- consultant UI: Approve framework / Framework approved+Revoke control
  on the engagement detail; Launch button shows "Approve framework to
  launch" until approved
- readiness: Reflect 360 now hasReviewGate=true

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360 audit fixes: anonymity floor (2 critical) + IDOR, lifecycle, a11y
entries.plain: 360 feedback reports now hide feedback summaries when too few people respond, protecting respondent anonymity.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial audit of the 360 feedback module (12 findings). All app-layer, no
migration (the archived enum + archived_at column already exist).

Critical - anonymity de-anonymisation in the deliverable
- The pooled "Others" mean (overall + per-competency + per-behaviour) had no
  distinct-contributor floor, so a lone peer's exact average was published as
  "Others' view" while the per-group table dutifully hid it. Now withheld (and
  the combined overall too, to block inversion from self + counts) whenever it
  is carried by 1..min_n-1 distinct SENSITIVE (non-self, non-manager) raters.
- Per-behaviour verbatim comments were gated on the SCORER count, not the
  COMMENTER count, so a single peer comment among 3 scoring peers leaked. Now
  gated on distinct commenters per role.

Major
- loadReflectFrameworkForEngagement server action had no owner gate - a
  consultant could pull another's full framework by id. Now requireEngagementOwner.
- Strength/blind-spot rankings gated on a hardcoded >= 2 raters; now >= min_n.
- Rater field window never closed: requireRater now rejects writes past
  field_window_end, so a stale link can't overwrite reported aggregates.
- Reassessment guard checked "completed" but the enum value is "complete", so
  the primary year-on-year case was always blocked. Fixed the string.

Minor
- Participant PDF route now authorises before computing scoring, and the guard
  returns a uniform 403 for missing-vs-unauthorised (no existence oracle).
- Added an Archive action + button so the retention purge (which only matches
  archived rows) is reachable - it was a permanent no-op.
- Rater form now states the anonymity/aggregation promise before rating.
- Open-question saves register with the submit flush (no lost answers) and
  surface a retry on failure instead of failing silently.
- Gamified rating buttons are now a real radiogroup (role/aria-checked).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add DARE + EQ lens to Reflect report and AC engagement detail
entries.plain: Reflect 360 reports now include DARE and EQ lens analysis in both assessment center engagement summaries and full feedback reports.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: instant rater selection + hide guided-demo pill on reports
entries.plain: Rater selection in Reflect 360 now highlights immediately when you click, and the guided-demo prompt no longer appears on reports or when printing.
entries.explanation:
- Rater form: the selection highlight now paints immediately on click. The
  save was being fired INSIDE the setAnswers updater, which entangled the
  visual commit with the server round-trip (a multi-second lag). State now
  updates purely and the save runs after, via an answersRef. Applies to both
  the standard and gamified forms.
- Guided demo: never render the launcher pill (or rail) on report routes - it
  was overlaying reports on screen and leaking into the printed PDF.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: match cohort + individual reports to client slides
entries.plain: Reflect 360 reports for teams and individuals now match the client presentation slides exactly, including an executive summary and detailed contents page.
entries.explanation:
- Cohort report: add an "Executive summary" page mirroring the Insights
  slide one-to-one - left "At a glance" (top strengths, top dev areas,
  heatmap, % below/within/above, year-on-year delta with live headlines)
  and a dark "How the CHRO uses it - Three conversations" panel (CEO /
  L&D budget owner / line manager) with live data hooks; CHRO-briefing
  branding.
- Individual report: add a "What's in this report" 12-section contents
  page mirroring the per-leader slide (12 sections, bilingual,
  confidential to the leader and their VIFM coach).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360 audit: rater token integrity + scoring + a11y/back nav
entries.plain: Reflect 360 has been audited for rater token security, scoring accuracy, and navigation accessibility to ensure data integrity and user experience.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Deep-review fixes: HIGH RPC lockdown + MEDIUM email-delivered gating + LOW hardening
entries.plain: Critical security fixes prevent unauthorized users from tampering with seat allocations across different organizations and strengthen email verification controls.
entries.explanation:
HIGH (security) - migration 00152 (already applied live + verified): the
allocation seat RPCs (claim/release_allocation_seats) were SECURITY DEFINER,
trusted a caller-supplied p_org, and were PUBLIC-executable - a logged-in
client_manager could call them from the browser with another org's id and
tamper with that org's seat ledger. REVOKE EXECUTE FROM public/authenticated +
GRANT to service_role only; add the missing non-negative-count guard to release.
Verified: claim/release now auth=false, service_role=true.

MEDIUM - email mock-mode misreport: sendAraEmail/sendReflectEmail now return a
 flag (true only on a real send; console-mock returns ok:true but
delivered:false). ARC seat, Reflect seat, and Reflect resend now count emails
+ stamp invited_at only on , so 'sent N' is honest and a mock no
longer makes the resend sweep skip raters.

LOW: ARC orphan-respondent delete now checked (keeps seat charged if delete
fails) + server logging on swallowed errors; ARC pool voucher guards an empty
batch (no '?code=undefined' link); Reflect inviteReflect catch is created-aware
(no seat claw-back after participants commit); seat-actions admin orgParam
UUID-validated; portal service page pinned LTR (was RTL+English mixed).
Deferred: the /api default-deny middleware hardening (no current leak; risky to
bundle).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: resend invitation email always uses an absolute link
entries.plain: Fixed invitation emails in Reflect 360 so they now contain working clickable links that raters can use from their inbox.
entries.explanation:
The resend email built its link from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL only; if that env
is unset baseUrl was "" and the emailed /reflect/respond/<token> link was
relative (broken in an inbox). Fall back through NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the
production domain so the invitation always carries a clickable absolute URL.
(The in-app Copy-link already used window.location.origin and was correct.)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix Puppeteer PDF 500 on Render (ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR)
entries.plain: Fixed Reflect 360 and ARC PDF reports that were crashing on production servers - they now generate successfully.
entries.explanation:
Reflect/ARA PDF routes render by navigating Puppeteer to their own SSR
report page via new URL(req.url).origin. On Render the edge terminates TLS
and the app speaks HTTP on $PORT, so that origin comes back as
https://localhost:10000 - Puppeteer hits an HTTP port over HTTPS and every
report 500s with net::ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR.

Add selfOrigin(reqUrl) in pdf-browser.ts: downgrade the scheme to http for
loopback hosts only (public domains + local-dev http://localhost:3000 are
untouched). Wire it into all four page.goto report routes (Reflect
participant + cohort + framework, ARA report).

Diagnosed live: GET /api/reflect/reports/<pid>/pdf -> 500
{"error":"net::ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR at https://localhost:10000/..."}.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: per-rater invitation links + resend on engagement detail
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now shows each rater's personal invitation link on the engagement detail page so consultants can share links directly if email delivery is delayed.
entries.explanation:
Diagnosed a real engagement (Live, 2 raters): invitations were SENT via
Graph (email_log status=sent) but didn't reach the inbox - a deliverability
problem, with no in-app fallback to recover. Add a 'Rater invitations'
section listing each rater with a Copy-link button (built from
window.location.origin so it's always absolute) + a 'Resend pending'
control, so a consultant can hand a rater their private rating link
directly when email is delayed/spam-filed. Read-only consultant-owned data.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: add a Launch button to the engagement detail page
entries.plain: Added a Launch button to Reflect 360 engagement detail pages so draft engagements can now go live without navigating back to the wizard.
entries.explanation:
Launch previously existed only in the wizard's final step, so a draft you
navigated away from could never go live (no invitations sent) - a likely reason
an engagement "does nothing". The detail page now shows a "Launch engagement"
button for draft engagements (confirm -> runs the existing launchReflectEngagement,
which guards >=1 participant + rater and invites all raters incl. the auto-
created self). Verified end-to-end: launched a draft from the detail page ->
status went live and the self-rater's invited_at was set.

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: auto-create the self-rater so every participant rates themselves
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now automatically creates a self-rating slot for each participant so every person rates themselves as required.
entries.explanation:
A 360 must include the participant's self-assessment, but adding a participant
never created a self-rater - "self" was a manual rater row the consultant had
to add by hand (and the default rater rows are manager/peer/direct-report), so
in the normal flow no self-rating ever existed and no self-invite was sent.

Fix:
- ensureSelfRatersForParticipants(): idempotent helper that creates a
  rater_role="self" row (email/name = the participant's) for any participant
  lacking one.
- Called when participants are added (bulkUpsertReflectParticipants) so the
  self-assessment exists immediately, and again at launch as a backfill for
  participants added before this change.
- bulkUpsertReflectRaters dedupes explicit "self" rows against the auto-created
  one so the self view is never double-counted.
- People-step tip updated: self is now automatic.

The existing invitation loop already emails self-raters, so the participant now
receives their self-assessment link on launch like any other rater.
tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: fix gamified rater unable to submit despite "All cards done"
entries.plain: Fixed a bug in gamified Reflect 360 ratings where fast raters could not submit their assessment despite completing all cards.
entries.explanation:
Root cause: a double-advance race. Rating a card schedules an auto-advance
(220ms); if the rater also taps Next or rates quickly (mobile-first), `index`
jumps twice and skips the next card. That card stays unrated, but the rater
still reaches the end - where the "All cards done" badge is gated on
`index >= total`, not on `allRated` - so the badge shows while submit stays
disabled with "Rate every card."

Two fixes:
- Guard the auto-advance: only advance if still on the just-answered card
  (capture `from = index`; the timer no-ops if Next already moved past it), so
  no card is skipped.
- Recovery at the final step: when not all cards are rated, replace the "All
  cards done" badge with "N cards still need a rating" + a button that jumps to
  the first unrated card - the rater can never be stranded on a done-looking
  screen that won't submit.

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Docs: note migrations continue through 00144
entries.plain: Updated documentation to note that system migrations have been completed through version 144.
entries.explanation:
The migration list in CLAUDE.md was illustrative to 00057; add a note that the
authoritative set continues through 00144 (Reflect 360, AP framework,
psychometrics, prehire/technical vouchers, ARC talent-lens) and that all are
applied on prod, with newer-column reads written migration-tolerant.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Assessment Center: three setup/run guards from the audit
entries.plain: Assessment Center now prevents engagements from launching with zero competencies or ratings, ensuring every assessment measures something meaningful.
entries.explanation:
Mirrors the Reflect "launch with nobody" hardening - stop an AC engagement
progressing through empty/meaningless states:

- OAR requires consensus: saveOarAction now refuses to save an overall rating
  until at least one consensus rating exists for the candidate (the OAR is the
  synthesis of the per-competency consensus, meaningless with none - also blocks
  the zero-competency -> zero-consensus -> OAR-anyway path).
- Activation requires content: updateEngagementStatusAction now refuses status
  -> 'active' unless the engagement has at least one competency AND one exercise,
  so an engagement edited/created down to empty can't go live and hand candidates
  a blank schedule with nothing to score.
- Wash-up needs observations: the wash-up page shows a clear "No observations
  recorded yet" state (with a link to assessor assignments) when competencies
  exist but no integration worksheet has been submitted, instead of a blank
  consensus grid that invites a baseless OAR.

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: guard empty launches + add-a-person form + no-raters banner
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now prevents launches with no participants or raters and adds an in-app form to add people without uploading a spreadsheet.
entries.explanation:
Audit found launched engagements with 0 participants/raters: the raters answer
the questions, so an engagement with none goes live but shows no assessment /
no questions. Three fixes:
- launchReflectEngagement now refuses to go live when participants=0 or
  raters=0, with a clear actionable message (was: silently flipped to live).
- Wizard step 4 gains an "Add a person" form (participant + their raters) so
  people can be added without crafting a CSV; reuses the proven
  bulkUpsertReflectParticipants/Raters actions. CSV import stays for bulk.
- Engagement detail shows a prominent "No raters yet - nobody can respond"
  banner when raterCount=0, pointing to the People step.

The rater respond form itself was verified working (renders all 20 question
cards with the frequency scale). tsc + ESLint clean; banner verified live.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Platform: portal comparison sheet (Talent Acquisition vs Talent Development)
entries.plain: Added a new comparison page showing how each VIFM portal works for talent selection versus development, helping you choose the right tool.
entries.explanation:
New /compare page under the platform: a bilingual on-page matrix of every portal
with its selection (Talent Acquisition) and development (Talent Management) lens
side by side - what it measures, how it runs, who takes it + scale, the reporting
& output (highlighted column), and any credential. Single-purpose portals
(Pre-Hire = selection only; Reflect 360 / Succession Readiness / Academy =
development only) flag the missing lens as not applicable. Lens badges reuse the
landing brand pair (light blue #5391D5 = acquisition, dark blue #111232 =
development). EN/AR with RTL + a back-to-platform link; reached from the landing
header and footer ("Compare portals").

Verified in-browser: table renders, N/A rows correct, RTL Arabic, lint + tsc clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix Puppeteer PDF 500s on Render (use @sparticuz/chromium in prod)
entries.plain: Fixed PDF generation failures for all VIFM assessments on production servers including Reflect 360, Pre-Hire, and ARC reports.
entries.explanation:
Every Puppeteer-rendered PDF (ARA reports, Reflect 360, Pre-Hire candidate
report + client email, technical programme/cohort) 500s in production with
"Could not find Chrome (ver. 147.x) ... /opt/render/.cache/puppeteer".

Root cause: `puppeteer.launch()` relies on the Chromium that the puppeteer
package downloads into the HOME cache at install time. Render persists
node_modules between build and runtime but NOT the home cache, so Chromium is
absent at runtime and the launch throws. (Confirmed live: the Pre-Hire report
endpoint returns HTTP 500 with that error; "Send to client" therefore never
emails - the PDF build fails before email is attempted, which is the real
cause of the "didn't receive the report" report.)

Fix: a shared launchPdfBrowser() (src/lib/reports/pdf-browser.ts) launches
bundled puppeteer Chromium in dev and @sparticuz/chromium@147 (already a
dependency, version-matched to the wanted Chrome 147) in production. Its
Chromium binary lives inside node_modules, so it survives the build->runtime
hand-off with no install step, env var, or Render dashboard change. Selected
when RENDER / NODE_ENV=production / USE_SPARTICUZ_CHROMIUM=1.

All 10 runtime launch sites now route through the helper. Arabic shaping is
unaffected - the Arabic PDFs load the Noto Naskh webfont and await fonts.ready,
so HarfBuzz shapes from the loaded font, not the Chromium build's system fonts.

Verified the dev (bundled) path returns a valid 162KB PDF through the helper;
tsc clean. Production verification to follow after Render auto-deploys.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: QA fixes: AC report release + Reflect IDOR + admin/CBI access control
entries.plain: Fixed three critical issues: Assessment Center candidate reports are now viewable, Reflect 360 access controls are enforced, and admin permissions work correctly.
entries.explanation:
Addresses the defects found in the end-to-end QA pass (verified against the
live code paths; routes re-checked live for no regression).

Critical 1 - AC candidate reports were never viewable in-app. The candidate
report viewer gates on a candidate_reports row with status='released', but
nothing ever wrote that table (the Share / Auto-Share buttons only toasted).
- Add admin-gated releaseReportAction + releaseAllReportsAction (update-or-
  insert candidate_reports -> released; best-effort candidate notification).
- Wire both Share buttons to call them. Candidates now see their report once
  released; clients likewise (RLS already allowed released-only reads).

Critical 2 - Reflect 360 IDOR. Every /reflect/consultant/* page fetched via
the service-role client using only the URL id, with no role/ownership check
and no layout guard, so any logged-in user could read any participant's
confidential 360 report / cohort / engagement / IDP.
- Add canAccessReflectEngagement / canAccessReflectParticipant guards
  (admin, or the owning consultant) and gate all six pages (report,
  cohort-report, engagement detail, framework-preview, preview-rater, idp).
- The Puppeteer PDF routes (already gated at the route level) now forward the
  requester's session cookies to Chromium so the now-gated SSR pages still
  render under the verified owner.

High 3 - admin surface has no role gate (chrome-only layout; middleware
enforces auth not role). Service-role admin pages leaked data.
- Gate /admin/courses/quotes (+ [id]) with an admin check (sales-lead PII).
- Add requireAdmin to the previously-ungated engagement mutation actions
  (createAssignment, addDemoAssessor [service-role!], removeCandidate,
  deleteAssignment, updateEngagementStatus) - the service-role one was a real
  hole; the rest are defense-in-depth atop RLS.

High 4 - CBI actions used service-role with no role/ownership gate, and
cbi_sessions RLS let any assessor touch any session.
- Add role gate (assessor/admin) + assignment-ownership check to
  persist/approve/discard actions; scope the assignment loader + gate the page.
- Migration 00112 (write-only; user applies): tighten cbi_sessions RLS to the
  owning assignment.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect 360: verifiable completion credential (to ARC bar)
entries.plain: Reflect 360 participants now receive a verifiable completion credential they can share, matching the credential feature in ARC.
entries.explanation:
Closes Reflect's only gap vs the ARC standalone bar - it now issues a
verifiable Reflect 360 completion credential to the participant when their
report is generated:
- issueReflect360Credential() (best-effort, idempotent per participant)
- wired into the participant-report PDF route after the report is persisted
- ai-readiness-style: reflect_360 added to the credential type, verify page,
  and certificate PDF labels (EN/AR)
- migration 00107 widens the credential_type CHECK. Inert until applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Reflect: register clients first-class via the shared registry
entries.plain: Reflect 360 client organizations now register in the shared registry so they can be reused across all VIFM services.
entries.explanation:
Inline org creation in the engagement wizard now dual-writes through
createClientOrganization (organizations + ara_organizations, createdBy
stamped) instead of writing ara_organizations only - so a Reflect-
registered client is reusable across every VIFM service, matching the ARC
standalone pattern.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add five open-ended questions to Reflect 360
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now includes five open-ended questions capturing strengths, development areas, and advice alongside the standard rating scales.
entries.explanation:
A shared OpenQuestionsBlock collects five qualitative questions (strengths,
development, a leadership/collaboration example, one piece of advice, anything
else), bilingual with self/other phrasing, autosaving on blur. Wired into both
the standard and gamified rater forms alongside Start/Stop/Continue. Migration
00101 adds the columns; the save action, loader, scoring aggregation and the
participant report's verbatim page all extend to the five. Anonymity threshold
applies identically. Verified end to end (rater form renders the five; report
renders the five sections + verbatims). Tolerant of 00101 not being applied.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add Customer & Stakeholder Focus as the 9th competency cluster
entries.plain: Reflect 360 now includes Customer Focus as a new competency area, so behavioral assessments and 360 feedback measure the same nine skill categories.
entries.explanation:
Extends the canonical framework (now 9 clusters / 41 competencies) with
Customer Orientation, Stakeholder Management and Value Creation under the
RESULTS domain, so self (Persona), others (Reflect 360) and role profiles
can all evaluate them on one framework. Migration 00100 (cluster + 3
competencies + dev tips, deterministic UUIDs) plus the matching Persona
bank items (12 bilingual items). Migration applied + verified.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: stage banners, CBI elaboration, showcase radar
entries.plain: Pre-Hire screening reports now feature clearer section layouts with visual banners, detailed English skill breakdowns, and enhanced AI-interview sections for easier candidate review.
entries.explanation:
Client review round on the report layout:
- Each stage's DETAIL section now opens with a prominent full-width navy
  banner ("Stage detail" eyebrow + very large stage name + subtitle):
  Competency Quiz, English (Fluent), AI Interview (CBI). The By-stage
  summary stays compact cards.
- AI Interview (CBI) elaborated to match the other stages: BARS 1-5 scale
  visual, band-aware "What this means" read, strengths / development areas
  as lists, plus the transcript.
- CEFR radar upgraded to the centrepiece of the English section: double
  size, centred in its own card, gradient fill, band-coloured dots, CEFR
  pills per skill, all six rings labelled, dashed B2 working-threshold
  ring with caption.
- Competency section explains the score (2/3 = correct out of asked) and
  Rank (strongest to weakest); sample data now scores all competencies
  (3 items each), matching live behaviour.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: add inline-SVG diagrams
entries.plain: Pre-Hire reports now include built-in charts and diagrams that visualize competency performance, English proficiency levels, and overall scores in both languages.
entries.explanation:
