Three self-contained SVG visuals (render natively in the Puppeteer PDF):
- Composite donut gauge (0-100, ringed in the advisory-band colour).
- "Competency performance at a glance" - a ranked, band-coloured horizontal
  bar chart above the detailed competency cards.
- CEFR radar chart of the four English skills, beside the overall level.
All bilingual EN/AR; each renders only when its data exists.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: English section, band narratives, By-stage on page 1
entries.plain: Pre-Hire reports reorganized with quick summary at the top, dedicated English language proficiency section, and personalized guidance based on candidate performance band.
entries.explanation:
Round of report enhancements from client review:
- Move the "By stage" summary table up to the first page (right under the
  result summary), so it reads as a summary up top.
- Add a dedicated English (Fluent) language profile - overall CEFR with a
  plain-language descriptor, plus one card per skill (reading/listening with
  correct/total, writing/speaking with the AI narrative) and a CEFR-band
  insight under each skill rather than lumped at the end.
- Add a candidate-specific, band-aware "What this means" narrative to each
  assessed competency that changes with the Strong/Moderate/Developing band.
All bilingual EN/AR; renders only from real stored data.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire quiz: measure every selected competency (3 items each)
entries.plain: The competency quiz now assesses every skill selected for a role instead of just the top ones, giving a more complete picture of candidate capabilities.
entries.explanation:
The quiz previously drew from only the top 4 competencies by weight (12 items
across 4), leaving the rest reading "not assessed" on the report. Deck size is
now dynamic: every selected competency in scope gets a fixed 3 items each
(capped at 10 competencies -> 30 items), so each one earns a real per-competency
score. Legacy requisitions with no competency set keep a short 12-item generic
screen. Removed the now-unused allocate() splitter.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: fix per-competency scores showing "not assessed"
entries.plain: Fixed an issue where pre-hire reports incorrectly showed competencies as "not assessed" even though candidates had answered questions about them.
entries.explanation:
Two root causes, both fixed:
- The report listed the role profile's competencies while the quiz drew from
  the requisition's explicit competency_ids - a different set - so exam results
  never matched the displayed competencies. The report now resolves its
  competency list the same way the quiz does (competency_ids first, role profile
  as fallback), so the assessed competencies line up.
- Deck items from a fallback path (generic synthetic / deterministic) carried no
  competency tag. Every stored question is now attributed to a competency:
  precisely from the per-competency generation, and round-robin across the
  resolved competencies as a safety net, so a sitting always yields per-
  competency results. Banked early-return now tags too.

Note: sittings completed before this ships have untagged questions and will
still read "not assessed" - only new sittings carry the per-competency result.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire quiz: 12 questions + integrity monitoring
entries.plain: The competency quiz expanded from 7 to 12 questions with cheating detection (monitoring for tab-switching and copying), mirroring safeguards already in place for language tests.
entries.explanation:
Competency quiz raised from 7 to 12 items (client feedback: 7 felt too
short); 12 across up to 4 competencies is ~3 each, which also firms up the
per-competency result on the report. Adds advisory, PDPL-safe integrity
monitoring to the quiz stage (tab-away + copy + paste), mirroring the Fluent
stage - the copy signal (a candidate copying a question out to look it up) is
the key MCQ-cheat trace. Surfaces on the SME review page like Fluent's, and is
sanitized server-side (counts/durations/lengths only, never the text).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: competency definitions + exam-driven ranking
entries.plain: Pre-Hire reports now show each competency's definition, sub-skills, and the candidate's actual score with a color-coded strength level based on their quiz answers.
entries.explanation:
Report "Competency analysis" section now shows, per selected competency:
a plain-language definition, its behavioural indicators (sub-competencies),
and the candidate's actual per-competency exam result as a Rank + a
Strong/Moderate/Developing chip with score and bar. The quiz now tags each
question with its source competency so the per-competency result is
reconstructed from real answers; an honesty note flags the short-quiz read
as indicative. Requisition wizard surfaces the same sub-competencies under
each selected competency.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Scientific Models: add Pre-Hire sample screening report card
entries.plain: Staff can now view a sample Pre-Hire screening report on the Scientific Models page to understand how candidate assessments are presented.
entries.explanation:
Adds a Pre-Hire card to /admin/models with "Download model PDF" (the existing
methodology brief) and "View sample report" - a fully-populated demo screening
report (fictional candidate, three stages, role competencies, AI-interview
transcript + assessment, result summary) rendered via Puppeteer, matching the
real Pre-Hire report. Staff-gated; bilingual (?lang=en|ar).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: Completed column + stacked actions + competencies on summary
entries.plain: Pre-Hire shortlists now display completion dates in their own column and reorganize action buttons vertically to save space and clarify next steps.
entries.explanation:
- Shortlist: move the completion date into its own "Completed" column; stack
  the action buttons (Summary/Report together, Review/Invite-link together, and
  Email on its own) to free up horizontal space. InviteLink gains an `only`
  prop so the link and email controls can be placed separately.
- Report: the competencies-assessed section now renders on the 1-page summary
  sheet as well as the full report, not just one.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: add competencies assessed + result summary sections
entries.plain: Pre-Hire reports now include a summary showing which competencies were assessed and a results overview with performance bands and stage outcomes.
entries.explanation:
Makes the screening report more extensive, all data-grounded:
- "Competencies assessed": the role's selected competencies (from the
  requisition's role profile), priority-tagged, bilingual EN/AR. Best-effort
  fetch so a requisition without a role profile just omits the section.
- "Result summary": composite band, stages passed, strongest/lowest stage,
  any required stage below cut-score, plus the advisory guardrail - built only
  from real per-stage results.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire shortlist: show assessment completion date + order by it
entries.plain: Pre-Hire shortlists now show when each candidate completed their assessment and sort newest-completed candidates to the top for quick review.
entries.explanation:
Uses the candidate completed_at timestamp (the true "assessment completed"
time) to order the shortlist newest-completed-first and to display a
"Completed: <date>" line under each candidate (falling back to a "Not
completed" marker). Read best-effort so a missing column can't empty the list.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire shortlist: order candidates newest-first + show date
entries.plain: Pre-Hire shortlists now display assessment dates and sort by most recent activity, making it easy to spot newly completed candidates at the top of the list.
entries.explanation:
Orders the requisition detail shortlist by most-recent activity (updated_at,
falling back to created_at) so a just-completed report sits at the top instead
of having to hunt by name/email, and surfaces the date under each candidate.
Dates come from separate best-effort reads so a missing column can't empty the
shortlist. Replaces the composite-ranked default order.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Positioning: advisory-integrity + screening-not-development lines (EN/AR)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire screening now clearly states it flags candidates for human review, never auto-fails them, and measures job fit rather than development potential.
entries.explanation:
Two client-facing positioning clauses, wording only:

- Integrity monitoring is advisory, not invigilation: new bullet in the
  proposal's Methodology & quality standards section (EN + AR renders) -
  signals prompt human review of a flagged administration and never
  auto-fail a participant.
- Pre-Hire is a screening signal for selection, not a development
  diagnostic: added to the proposal's Pre-Hire service description, the
  evidence catalogue, and the per-candidate screening report's guardrail
  disclaimer (EN + AR).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: server-side TTS serve cap + integrity signals on SME review
entries.plain: Pre-Hire audio playback is now limited to 4 total plays per question across all devices, preventing candidates from bypassing this limit through browser tricks.
entries.explanation:
The two follow-ups from the trial batch:

- The listening replay cap is no longer client-only. The TTS route now
  counts audio DELIVERIES per candidate+item in the stage detail and
  refuses after 4 (the promised 2 plays + a device-switch/retry margin) -
  cycling incognito windows no longer yields unlimited replays. Mid-file
  Range continuations of a single play don't burn the budget, and the
  Pre-Hire player switched to preload="none" so a page refresh (now
  common, since answers persist) doesn't consume a serve without a play.
  Verified live: 4x200 then 403; six Range requests never counted.
  Honest limit: plays of already-delivered cached audio can't be counted
  server-side - the cap bounds fresh deliveries, which is what the bypass
  needed. The standalone Fluent runner keeps its client cap (placement,
  lower stakes).

- The SME review page now shows an "Integrity signals (advisory)" panel
  per stage: tier + 0-100 composite, tab-away count/duration, paste
  count/length, the CBI per-answer thinking times (with a fast-answer
  note under a 20s median), the typed-speaking flag, and the AI-likeness
  estimate. Framed as prompts for a human glance - never an automatic
  action. Verified against a real trial candidate's stored flags.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: id/name on stage textareas + EEO selects (Asaad a11y minor)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire text boxes and dropdown menus now have proper labels for accessibility, helping candidates with screen readers use the assessment.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: trial-feedback fixes (resume, honesty, i18n, integrity, audit FK)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire now saves candidate answers as they work, so refreshing the page or navigating back no longer erases their progress.
entries.explanation:
Fixes from the 16 Jul Pre-Hire trial (6 reviewers - Ammar, Asaad, Jomaa,
Moayad, Omar, Yassin). Asaad's QA report called this "the most complete and
polished of the four trials"; what remained was flow-integrity and polish.

Flow integrity
- In-progress answers now survive back/refresh: the quiz and English stages
  persist answers to sessionStorage and restore them when the (already
  idempotent) start route re-serves the same stored deck (Yassin: "I tried
  to go back, but it took me out and started over"). A beforeunload guard
  warns before leaving mid-stage.
- A repeat submit after a lost response advances instead of dead-ending:
  all three stages treat the server's 409 "Already submitted" as completion
  (Omar: "I had to submit the page twice / it did not allow me to submit").
- Slow AI starts and scoring now say so: "Preparing your test - this can
  take up to a minute" / "Scoring your test..." instead of a frozen button
  (Omar's stuck "Starting..."/"Submitting..." screenshots).
- The disabled English-stage submit explains itself: a live "To submit: N
  questions unanswered - writing needs at least 20 words - ..." hint
  replaces the silently-dead button.
- The competency quiz gained a two-step submit confirmation; each stage is
  final (Asaad).

Honesty + anti-cheat
- The Azure-TTS listening path rendered a native audio element: unlimited
  replays and a download menu despite the "up to twice" promise (Yassin
  caught both). The replay-capped, download-free player from the Fluent
  runner is now a shared component (CappedAudio) used by both, and the
  review hardened it further: the play count persists per token+item so a
  refresh or second tab no longer resets it (the new answer-persistence
  had made that bypass free).
- The writing task promised "min 70" but silently accepted 5 words (Yassin
  submitted 67). The gate and the label now agree: target 70-90, an
  enforced minimum of 20 - a real floor without hard-blocking the
  low-level candidates whose short answer IS the evidence.
- The behavioural interview no longer re-asks what the transcript already
  answered (Asaad: it asked the managers-reaction question twice) - the
  interviewer prompt now requires each follow-up to target uncovered
  ground.
- The interview stage now captures advisory integrity signals - tab-away
  duration, paste count/length, per-answer thinking time - into the stage
  flags alongside the AI-likeness estimate (Yassin: "restrict using AI
  agent as I did"). Advisory only; a recruiter reads it, nothing auto-fails.
- Server-side email validation on redemption (the client gate shipped with
  the shared form; Moayad pushed "Moayad@" through on other services).

Bilingual + consent
- The stage labels, the equal-opportunity step, and the English-stage
  chrome now follow the Arabic toggle with RTL (Omar, Asaad); test content
  stays English by design.
- The consent bullet no longer leads a Saudi campaign with UAE law (Jomaa,
  KAFD): it names "the data-protection law that applies where the role is
  based", Saudi PDPL first.

Voucher expiry (Moayad's rejection, root-caused)
- His 20 Jul attempt hit a voucher whose expiry was stored as bare
  midnight UTC - created before the end-of-day normalisation shipped, so
  it died the night before the day the issuer picked. Backfilled all 41
  midnight-stamped expiries across the seven voucher tables to end-of-day
  and extended the trial voucher to 27 Jul so he can complete the trial.
- Migration 00195 (applied): the prehire_audit_log requisition/candidate
  FKs are dropped - 00162's SET NULL rename matched constraints by name
  and silently skipped on prod (CASCADE survived), and SET NULL could
  never work anyway because the FK-driven nulling is an UPDATE the 00051
  immutability trigger blocks. Any candidate with audit rows was
  undeletable - which would also have broken the nightly retention purge
  for Pre-Hire. The log keeps its pseudonymous uuids and stays immutable.

Verified live end-to-end with a temp voucher (client email gate, consent
wording, Arabic EEO + stepper, quiz resume-with-same-deck + confirm step,
patience copy, capped TTS player, writing floor + gap hints); all temp
data removed.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: refuse fabricated AI scores in the hiring composite
entries.plain: Pre-Hire stops hiring decisions when English or AI-readiness scores fail to calculate, preventing fake scores from reaching your shortlist.
entries.explanation:
A CBI or Fluent scoring error used to return a plausible placeholder
(BARS 3, CEFR B1/all-3s) indistinguishable from the legitimate no-key
dev/demo placeholder, silently feeding a real hiring composite,
shortlist, and 4/5ths adverse-impact math with a non-score.

- Add a scoring_failed flag set ONLY in the AI error catch (never on the
  no-key path); the Pre-Hire CBI + Fluent submit routes 503 (retryable,
  stage left uncompleted) instead of completing on it.
- Fail closed in production: a missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the hiring
  routes now 503s rather than completing on the no-key placeholder. The
  standalone /ac/* prototypes keep the dev-friendly placeholder.
- Fluent ensemble aggregates only the runs that scored (drops failed
  runs, propagates failure only when every run fails) so a 1-of-N blip
  no longer discards valid scores.
- Certify gate: refuse until the candidate has a composite (scored).
- editStages rescore loop is fault-isolated per candidate and now
  surfaces partial rescore failures instead of a blanket success toast.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire review batch 1: adverse-impact + ATS record integrity, certifier audit
entries.plain: Pre-Hire adverse-impact analysis now checks all candidates fairly instead of randomly truncating large requisitions, ensuring compliance reporting is accurate.
entries.explanation:
First batch of the Pre-Hire adversarial review (app-layer, no migration).

- CRITICAL (compliance): the adverse-impact (4/5ths) cohort read was unpaginated
  - on a >1000-candidate requisition it silently computed disparate-impact on an
  arbitrary (no ORDER BY) truncated slice and could mask real adverse impact with
  no visible failure. It also read the persisted `recommendation` column that
  every other surface treats as stale. Now paginate the full cohort and RECOMPUTE
  each recommendation from stage results (the shortlist/export single source of
  truth) before the 4/5ths math.
- ATS export truncated at 1000 (incomplete authoritative record delivered to the
  client + a falsified audited candidate_count, and the custom_fields side-read
  desynced). Paginate both reads.
- Retention purge capped at 1000, leaving expired applicant + redeemer PII past
  the window. Paginate the id-gather + chunk both deletes.
- Certification bound its immutable audit event to a self-asserted free-text name
  only. Capture the authenticated admin and record actor_id on the trail.
- Admin shortlist + "send all reports" reads paginated (were truncating/desyncing
  the ranked list + under-delivering reports past 1000).
- Honest audit-trail label ("latest 100 of N" via a new uncapped count) instead
  of presenting the 100-row display cap as the total.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Licensed preview: brand Pre-Hire with registered mark
entries.plain: Pre-Hire is now branded with its official registered trademark in client materials.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire quiz bank: complete the seed to all 41 competencies (410 items)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire question bank now contains 410 scenario-based questions covering all 41 job competencies, ready for assessments once approved by your experts.
entries.explanation:
The resumed authoring finished the remaining 34 competencies. The bank is now
410 bilingual SJT items (41 competencies x 10, ~7 multiple-choice + ~3 true/
false each), grounded in each competency's behavioural indicators and
adversarially reviewed. Seeded in_review; each competency activates in the
Pre-Hire screen once an SME approves its pool via /admin/quiz-bank.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire quiz bank: partial seed (7/41 competencies, 70 SJT items)
entries.plain: Pre-Hire has seeded 70 scenario-based questions for 7 job competencies while authoring work continues on the remaining 34.
entries.explanation:
The 41-competency authoring run hit a weekly usage limit after completing +
reviewing 7 competencies (70 bilingual SJT/MCQ items, grounded in each
competency's behavioural indicators, adversarially reviewed). Captures those so
the work isn't lost; the seeder is per-competency idempotent, so the remaining
34 competencies can be authored + appended after the limit resets (Jul 10).

Items seed as status='in_review' pending human SME approval (defensible for a
hiring screen). Bank activates per competency once approved; until then the
Pre-Hire quiz still mints live-AI.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix readiness tsc error + Pre-Hire quiz-bank machinery
entries.plain: A technical error blocking deployment is now fixed, and Pre-Hire question management is ready for use.
entries.explanation:
The Techno-batch commit (62df6f1) had a tsc error in readiness.ts
(Set<TechDomainKey>.has(string)) that lint did not catch, so `next build`
failed and that deploy never landed. Fix: type the taxonomy set as Set<string>.

Also lands the Pre-Hire competency-quiz-bank machinery (additive + tolerant of
migration 00180 not being applied - falls back to live-AI):
- migration 00180: competency_quiz_items (per-competency vetted quiz items +
  draft->approved review lifecycle + exposure counter)
- src/lib/quiz-bank/assemble.ts: drawCompetencyQuizItems (approved, least-
  administered-first, exposure bump) + approvedCountByCompetency
- Pre-Hire quiz/start: prefer approved bank items, fall back to live-AI for the
  shortfall (no behaviour change until items are approved)
- readiness dashboard: Pre-Hire now reflects the bank (approved vs in_review)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire audit fixes: required-stage completeness gate + retention, close guard, i18n/a11y
entries.plain: Pre-hire screening now correctly requires all mandatory stages to be completed before candidates can advance, even if those stages have no point value.
entries.explanation:
Adversarial audit of the pre-employment screening module (6 findings, 0
critical - the guardrails and token boundary held). All app-layer, no migration.

Major
- A required stage with weight 0 could be skipped entirely yet the candidate
  still scored "advance": the completeness gate only inspected weighted stages,
  and a not-taken stage read as passed=null (not a failure). Now any required
  stage that is unscored forces "incomplete" and nulls the composite - a
  required hurdle can no longer be silently skipped.

Minor
- Retention purge now deletes voucher-redemption PII (name/email/IP) for purged
  candidates - the FK is ON DELETE SET NULL, so it survived the candidate delete.
- quiz/fluent/cbi submit routes now reject a closed/archived requisition, for
  parity with the start routes (a stage begun while open could still be scored
  after close).
- Candidate apply flow is now bilingual EN/AR with a language toggle + RTL: the
  quiz (fully) and Fluent task instructions render the Arabic the backend
  already ships; consent/CBI chrome localised.
- Quiz answer options are now a real radiogroup (role=radio + aria-checked +
  aria-labelledby) so screen-reader users can perceive selection and grouping.
- Voluntary demographics card states explicitly it cannot influence the result
  (it is shown before the assessment for administrative reasons).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Wrap Pre-Hire voucher issuance in the 3-step wizard
entries.plain: Pre-Hire assessment codes can now be created and distributed in three simple steps, whether sending to clients or directly to job applicants.
entries.explanation: Role+label, deliver-to-client vs to-applicants, generate batch then email/copy to client, or upload/paste applicant emails and email each a link. Action now returns the codes for the client-batch email.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire audit Batch 2: apply-flow + admin UX/UI polish
entries.plain: Pre-Hire interface and workflows have been refined for a cleaner, more intuitive admin experience.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire audit B1.5: close client RLS leak + harden demo/fluent/cbi
entries.plain: Removed unused security rules that could have exposed candidate data - Pre-Hire screening is now more secure.
entries.explanation:
Migration 00163:
- D-5/D-6/D-7/D-1: drop the unused 'client' SELECT policies on
  prehire_requisitions/candidates/stage_results. RLS is row-level only
  and cannot hide demographic / decision / report_sent_to / detail
  columns; a codebase sweep confirmed every read goes through the
  service-role client + app-layer org checks, so these policies were
  pure latent attack surface. Fail-closed (zero rows for a client JWT).
- I-8: add prehire_requisitions.is_demo flag + backfill existing demos
  by title; candidate self-view of results/report now gates on the
  explicit flag, not a brittle title match.

Code:
- I-8: findCandidateByToken resolves is_demo tolerantly (flag wins,
  legacy title fallback only pre-migration); result/report/apply gate
  on it; startPrehireDemoAction stamps is_demo=true (best-effort).
- S-6: sanitize the client-supplied Fluent pronunciation score - gate
  on isAzureSpeechConfigured() (else discard) + clamp every sub-score
  to [0,100] so it can't inflate the speaking band.
- I-9: hard server-side cap on the CBI transcript - refuse answers
  beyond MAX_CANDIDATE_ANSWERS (no extra model call / DB write) and
  clamp each answer to 4000 chars.
- V-5: per-IP rate limit (10 / 15 min) on the public voucher-redeem
  action via a new reusable src/lib/security/rate-limit.ts.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire audit Batch 1: security + integrity hardening (migrations 00161-00162)
entries.plain: Fixed two security vulnerabilities: voucher codes are now locked down, and completed screening stages cannot be edited.
entries.explanation:
Voucher RPCs (00161): prehire_voucher_claim/release recreated with
SET search_path = public and EXECUTE locked to service_role only -
closes the search_path injection and privilege-escalation vectors
found in the audit (same pattern as 00157/00158/00159/00160).

Stage immutability (00162): BEFORE UPDATE trigger on
prehire_stage_results refuses writes once status='completed',
closing the TOCTOU double-submit race (mirrors candidate_quiz_attempts
in 00019). Adds normalized_score range CHECK [0,100], audit-log
DELETE guard (BEFORE DELETE trigger + FK ON DELETE SET NULL so
cascade can't silently erase the defensibility record), and an
explicit client_manager policy on prehire_audit_log.

Demographics isolation (00162): the client-portal RLS policy on
prehire_candidates previously granted SELECT on ALL columns,
including the voluntary demographic fields added in 00051. Replaced
with a scoped policy that excludes gender/age_band/nationality_group/
decision_reason/report_sent_to. Matching restriction on
prehire_stage_results to keep raw detail JSONB (transcripts, quiz
answer keys) out of client-role reads.

Consent enforcement: all six stage routes (quiz/start, quiz/submit,
fluent/start, fluent/submit, cbi/turn, cbi/submit) now gate on
ctx.candidate.consent_at != null and return HTTP 403 if missing -
server-side enforcement of the UAE PDPL / GDPR consent requirement
previously only enforced in the UI layer. Consent route made
idempotent (re-submission preserves the original timestamp).

Requisition status gate: findCandidateByToken now reads
requisition.status; all three start routes (quiz, fluent, cbi)
return HTTP 403 when status != 'open', preventing candidates from
submitting against closed/archived requisitions.

Answer-key hygiene: quiz/submit no longer stores correct_index in
the review object or in detail.questions after completion - only
{id, picked, isCorrect} is stored. The full keyed deck is available
server-side if a human review ever needs it but never lands in the
completed row.

CBI score bounds: bars_rating is clamped to [1,5] before normalization
and persistence, guarding against AI hallucination or prompt injection
returning an out-of-range value.

DEMO_REQ_TITLE: local duplicate constant in admin/prehire/actions.ts
removed; import from the canonical export in candidate-access.ts.

rescoreCandidate: update error is now checked and thrown rather than
silently discarded, so submit routes can surface a DB write failure.

PII prefill: redeem page no longer accepts name/email from URL params
(phishing vector fix from pre-audit scouting).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire CBI: cap interactive turn wait so a slow API never freezes the screen
entries.plain: The AI interview no longer freezes on slow API responses - it moves to the next question after 20 seconds.
entries.explanation:
Live verification of ca217a6 confirmed turns no longer hiccup-loop (they return
real, contextual questions), but during a sustained Anthropic 529 overload the
SDK retries pushed single turns to 30-45s+ - a frozen-looking spinner that reads
as "not working" to a candidate. Add a 20s wall-clock cap on the interactive
interviewer turn: if the LLM (incl. retries) exceeds it, abandon the in-flight
call and instantly serve the next scripted STAR question so the interview keeps
moving. Scoring is a one-shot end step and keeps the full retry budget (no cap).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: edit a built requisition's stage plan
entries.plain: You can now edit which screening stages (quiz, English, AI interview) run after a requisition is created.
entries.explanation:
Adds an 'Edit stages' editor on the requisition detail page so a built
requisition's screening stages can be added/removed after creation
(Competency Quiz / English Fluent / AI Interview), with per-stage weight,
cut-score, and Fluent sub-skills - mirroring the create wizard. New
updateRequisitionStagesAction reuses the same stageEntrySchema +
receptive-skill rule, sets english_required from the Fluent stage, and
re-scores every candidate from the new plan (removed stage drops from the
composite; added stage shows incomplete until taken; collected results
kept). Non-editable stage kinds (e.g. assessment_center) are preserved.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: quiz never dead-ends; speaking type-fallback word counter
entries.plain: Demo screening no longer fails - it now provides backup questions if the AI is unavailable, and speaking fallback counts words correctly.
entries.explanation:
Issue 1 - demo quiz stuck on 'Couldn't generate the assessment': the quiz
depended entirely on a live Claude call (generateQuizQuestions returns null
on no-key/quota/overload/timeout) and 503'd when it failed. Add
buildFallbackQuizDeck() - a deterministic deck grounded in the role's real
behavioural indicators (positive=>True, negative=>False) padded with
role-agnostic professional items - and serve it instead of the 503 so the
screening always proceeds.

Issue 3 - speaking type-fallback: when transcription fails the candidate is
told to type, but the same min-5-words gate applied with no visible counter,
so a short blob left Submit disabled with no explanation. Add a live word
counter ('N words / min 5 to submit') mirroring the Writing box.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire demo: show results on-screen + report download on completion
entries.plain: Demo candidates now see their results and can download a PDF report immediately after finishing.
entries.explanation:
Match the Techno demo: when a candidate finishes the self-serve DEMO
screening, the completion screen now shows the composite signal, the
advisory recommendation, per-stage scores, and a Download report (PDF)
button - instead of just 'thank you, go back elsewhere'.

- new token endpoints /api/prehire/[token]/result (JSON) + /report (PDF),
  both DEMO-ONLY (requisition title = 'Demo Screening (self-serve)'); a real
  screening returns 403 so the 'results go to the hiring team, not the
  candidate' guardrail holds
- apply-flow renders the result card (demo only); real flow unchanged
- scripts/seed-demo.ts: CLI runner for the demo seeder (reuses seedDemoData)

Verified on preview: composite 75/100 + stages render; report -> 200 PDF.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Techno + Pre-Hire: self-serve "start assessment" on the landing (demo)
entries.plain: Start buttons for Techno and Pre-Hire demo assessments are now front-and-centre on the landing page - no voucher needed.
entries.explanation:
Match the front-and-centre self-serve entry the other instruments (Persona,
Fluent, Logica, ARC) already have - no link or voucher needed.

- Techno: a "Start an assessment now" CTA on /admin/tech-sandbox links straight
  to the runner /ac/tech-assessment, which already supports anonymous sittings.
- Pre-Hire: a "Start demo screening" button on /admin/prehire calls a new
  startPrehireDemoAction that reuses the shared demo org, find-or-creates a
  "Demo Screening (self-serve)" requisition, mints a fresh anonymous candidate,
  and drops straight into the real apply flow (consent -> quiz -> Fluent -> CBI).
  Everything lands under the demo org, so the Demo-data purge removes it.

Verified on preview: Techno CTA -> runner; Pre-Hire button -> auto-provisions
-> apply flow with the consent gate. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: SME review -> Certify workflow (#3 of 3)
entries.plain: A VIFM assessor can now review and certify each candidate's AI-scored results before they are finalized.
entries.explanation:
The defensible tier above the raw AI report: a VIFM assessor reviews the
candidate's AI-scored responses and certifies the result.

- Migration 00145: prehire_candidates.certified_at / certified_by /
  certification_notes (tolerant; reads no-op pre-migration).
- Reviewer page /admin/prehire/[id]/candidate/[candidateId]/review: shows the
  per-stage AI scores, the CBI transcript + AI assessment, any Fluent
  writing/speaking, and a certify form (reviewer name + notes).
- certifyPrehireCandidateAction (admin-gated, audited as candidate_certified).
- getPrehireCertification() tolerant read; the per-candidate report (full +
  summary) now carries a green "Certified - SME-reviewed by <name> on <date>"
  banner once certified.
- Requisition shortlist: a "Review" action per candidate + a "Certified" badge.

Completes the three Pre-Hire outputs: summary sheet (d18eff2), AI detailed
report (145ebeb), SME-reviewed certified report (this). tsc + ESLint clean.
NOTE: migration 00145 still needs applying to the DB.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: add a one-page summary-sheet output (#1 of 3)
entries.plain: Reports now include a one-page summary sheet for quick review, alongside the detailed report.
entries.explanation:
Adds a condensed at-a-glance sheet alongside the existing detailed report:
header, the composite + advisory band, a compact per-stage table, and the
guardrail line - no methodology / transcript / band table.

- renderPrehireSummaryHtml() in prehire-candidate-html.ts (self-contained,
  reuses the same labels/tones, EN + AR).
- buildPrehireCandidatePdf gains a mode: "full" | "summary" (default full);
  the report route honours ?view=summary; summary PDFs get a -summary- filename.
- A "Summary" trigger sits next to "Report" on each candidate row.

#2 (AI detailed report) already shipped (145ebeb). #3 (SME review + certify)
next. tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: show AI-interview transcript + drop false "assessor" claim
entries.plain: Reports now show the full AI-interview conversation and correctly state that results are AI-scored (not human-reviewed in this step).
entries.explanation:
The client report described the behavioural interview as "AI-led and reviewed by
a qualified assessor" - but in the Pre-Hire funnel the CBI is purely AI-scored
(cbi/submit just runs scoreCbiInterview; no human reviews it), and the client
had nothing to review since the transcript was never shown.

Fix (client reviews the responses - matches the "a person always decides"
guardrail):
- Corrected the stage definition to "An AI-led structured behavioural (STAR)
  interview, AI-scored. The full transcript and the AI's assessment are included
  below for your review." (EN + AR).
- The report now renders an "AI Interview - transcript & assessment" section:
  the full Q&A exchange, the AI rating + rationale + strengths/development areas,
  and an explicit "AI-generated; a human reviewer should validate it" note. The
  data (history + score) was already stored on prehire_stage_results.detail.

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: center the Candidate column in the shortlist
entries.plain: Candidate names in the shortlist are now center-aligned for a cleaner, more consistent look.
entries.explanation:
Match the now-centered AI signal / Composite columns: center the Candidate
TableHead + TableCell, and justify-center the inner name+badge row so the
"Not invited" chip sits with the name. Verified centered in preview.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: center the AI signal column in the shortlist
entries.plain: AI signal scores in the shortlist are now center-aligned to match the other columns.
entries.explanation:
The AI signal header + recommendation-badge cells were left-aligned while the
Composite column beside them is centered. Add text-center to the AI signal
TableHead and TableCell so the column reads consistently. Verified in preview.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: generate only the kept items + raise gen cap so the deck completes
entries.plain: Quiz generation now creates only the questions needed and doesn't time out - the full deck completes reliably.
entries.explanation:
Follow-up to the parallelization fix. Dev-preview timing showed the quiz still
returned a partial deck (1-3 questions) or 503: each per-competency call was
generating the generator's default 7 questions while the route keeps only ~2,
and the 35s cap then truncated the slow calls.

- quiz-generator: new optional `count` (default 7, so candidate-quiz + academy
  are unchanged); the prompt now asks for exactly `count` items and drops the
  rigid 7-item mix for small counts.
- Pre-Hire quiz/start: request `count: wanted` per competency (only what it
  keeps) and raise the per-call cap 35s -> 60s so the parallel calls finish.

Verified on the dev preview: full 7-question deck, HTTP 200, ~40s warm
(previously a 503 at ~74s). tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: parallelize quiz generation so Start doesn't hang on "Preparing"
entries.plain: Quiz questions now generate in parallel instead of one-by-one, cutting wait time from 60-120 seconds to roughly 20-30 seconds.
entries.explanation:
The quiz-start route generated the deck by calling generateQuizQuestions once
per competency SEQUENTIALLY (up to 4 serial Claude round-trips). On production
(API key set) that is easily 60-120s, which the candidate sees as a Start button
stuck on "Preparing" - the assessment never appears to begin.

- Generate every competency's deck in parallel (Promise.all) - total time drops
  to roughly one round-trip instead of the sum of four.
- Timeout-guard each generation (35s via Promise.race); the Anthropic SDK's own
  default timeout is minutes, so a single stalled call could otherwise hang the
  whole request. A timed-out competency just contributes no items, and the
  synthetic fallback is bounded the same way - so the route always responds
  (deck or a clean 503) rather than spinning forever.

tsc + ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire vouchers: client-distributable codes tied to a requisition
entries.plain: Pre-Hire now supports shareable voucher codes - you can distribute them to candidates just like other assessments.
entries.explanation:
Adds Pre-Hire to the voucher model that ARC/Techno/Fluent/Mentium/Persona
already use, and into the shared /admin/vouchers hub (the fifth... now sixth tile).

- Migration 00144 (applied): prehire_vouchers + prehire_voucher_redemptions
  tables, atomic prehire_voucher_claim / prehire_voucher_release RPCs, admin-only
  RLS. A voucher references a requisition (ON DELETE CASCADE).
- Lib src/lib/prehire/vouchers.ts: generate batch (anonymous seat-pool or named
  delegates), redeem (atomic claim -> provision a prehire_candidate on the
  requisition with invited_at stamped -> audit redemption -> return the
  candidate access_token; releases the seat on failure), + hub list helpers.
- Public no-account redeem flow at /prehire/redeem (page + server action + form),
  middleware-bypassed (isPreHireRedeemRoute); forwards to /prehire/apply/[token].
- Admin hub: Pre-Hire tile (UserSearch icon) + create form (pick requisition,
  codes x seats, label, expiry) + voucher list with copy-link + disable.

Verified end-to-end on the live DB: created a voucher via the hub (org derived
from the requisition), redeemed it no-account, seat claimed (0->1), candidate
provisioned on the requisition, redemption audited, applicant landed in the
consent->quiz->fluent->cbi->demographics flow. Test artifacts removed. tsc +
ESLint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix "Invalid requisition" - Zod 4 strict .uuid() rejects seed UUIDs
entries.plain: Fixed a bug where Pre-Hire requisitions were incorrectly rejected with an 'Invalid requisition' error - the system now correctly accepts the platform's internal identifier format.
entries.explanation:
Root cause: the seed competencies (a0000001-...), role profiles
(00000001-aaaa-...), domains + clusters all carry SYNTHETIC UUIDs whose
version/variant nibbles are 0. Zod 4's z.string().uuid() validates those
nibbles per RFC, so it rejected every one - silently failing any payload that
carried a seed id. The prehire requisition action only surfaced top-level
formErrors, so a field-level uuid failure showed the useless "Invalid
requisition" fallback.

This was systemic, not just prehire: engagement creation (competency/exercise
ids), wash-up consensus, and assessor observation/rating all validate seed ids
the same way and were equally broken.

- Add lib/validations/ids.ts: shared `uuidish` (permissive UUID-shape regex).
- prehire actions: organization_id / role_profile_id / competency_ids ->
  uuidish; surface field errors (zodMessage) instead of the bare fallback.
- engagement.ts / washup.ts / assessor.ts: strict .uuid() -> uuidish for the
  seed-id fields (assessor.ts already had a local uuidShape for roleProfileId;
  completed it for competencyId/exerciseId).

Verified: creating a requisition with a seed role profile + 8 synthetic
competencies now succeeds (was "Invalid requisition" every time).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Sidebar: collapse instrument/screening portals to single links
entries.plain: Simplified the sidebar by collapsing Cognitive, Persona, Pre-Hire, and Fluent into single links per section, moving their sub-items to each portal's own top navigation.
entries.explanation:
- Cognitive, Persona, Pre-Hire and Fluent are now single sidebar links
  (per pillar) instead of nested sub-item groups; each portal's section
  links live on its own top bar
- Add Retention to the Pre-Hire portal layout's top nav (its only sub-item
  not already surfaced there)
- Remove the now-unused instrumentGroup helper + PlayCircle import

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire report: define Composite + each stage, rename "Aptitude" to Competency Quiz, drop em dashes
entries.plain: Updated Pre-Hire reports to define what the overall score means, explain what each stage measures, and renamed 'Aptitude' to 'Competency Quiz' for clarity.
entries.explanation:
Per client review of the Pre-Hire screening report:
- Composite now carries a one-line definition directly under the number
  (weighted average 0-100 of the stage scores; a screening signal, not a hiring
  decision).
- Each stage row gets a one-line definition of what it measures (quiz / fluent /
  cbi / assessment_center), bilingual EN + AR.
- The quiz stage is relabelled "Competency Quiz" (was "Aptitude & Knowledge"),
  matching the wizard / canonical labels - answers "why did you say aptitude".
- Removed em dashes and en-dash ranges from the report strings (EN + AR),
  the null placeholders, the methodology copy, the prehire i18n strings (EN+AR),
  the fairness page placeholders, and the adverse-impact age labels + comments.

Note: the composite shows 11.6 = 0.4*29 + 0.3*0 + 0.3*0 because English + CBI
were recorded as 0 (taken/abandoned), not left untaken; an untaken stage stays
null and reads "In progress" - the scoring logic is correct.

Verified: report renders EN+AR with definitions, no "Aptitude", zero em/en
dashes. tsc clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire quiz: competency-driven deck from a role-profile-prefilled set (CAL-PRE-502)
entries.plain: The Pre-Hire quiz now draws from job-specific competencies pre-filled from the role profile instead of a generic template, and hiring teams can customize which competencies to assess.
entries.explanation:
The quiz drew from one synthetic '{title} core competency' with no
behavioural grounding. Now a requisition carries an explicit competency
set (prehire_requisitions.competency_ids, 00138) pre-filled from the
role profile's competencies and editable (add/remove from the 38,
grouped by domain, with reset-to-default) in the wizard. The quiz route
resolves competency_ids -> role_profile_competencies -> synthetic
fallback, grounds each chosen competency with its behavioural indicators
+ dev tips + target (the G3 pattern), ranks by weight/priority, and
builds a ~7-item deck via top-4 weighted sampling (<=4 generator calls,
hard-capped at 7 - never 7xN). Answer-key strip + in-progress resume +
re-id'd unique question ids preserved (adversarial review: clean).
Tolerant of 00138 unapplied (create strips+retries; quiz falls back).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire Fluent: per-requisition CEFR sub-skill selection (CAL-PRE-503)
entries.plain: Hiring teams can now select which English language skills (reading, listening, writing, speaking) the Fluent stage assesses per job opening instead of always testing all four.
entries.explanation:
A requisition's Fluent stage can now run a subset of reading / listening
/ writing / speaking instead of always all four. stage_config.skills
(jsonb, no migration); omitted/empty = all four via resolveFluentSkills
(airtight back-compat). The start route filters the test to the selected
skills BEFORE the answer-key strip (key never leaks; full keyed test
stays server-side); resume reuses the stored test+skills so a mid-flight
requisition edit can't change the deck. Submit scores only selected
skills and excludes un-administered ones from the CEFR blend (WRITING_
NOT_ASSESSED sentinel, mirroring speaking). Wizard adds the sub-skill
picker; a receptive skill (reading|listening) is required - enforced
client-side AND server-side via a stageEntrySchema refine (review fix).
Report labels a reduced run 'partial placement'. The shared standalone
AC Fluent runner uses its own types and is unaffected (verified).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire: landing-page Add Client + advisory-signal legend & English clarifier (CAL-PRE-501, 510)
entries.plain: Added ability to create a new client organization directly from Pre-Hire, plus clearer in-product guidance on scoring bands and how the English requirement works.
entries.explanation:
CAL-PRE-501: reuse the shared CreateClientDialog on the Pre-Hire landing
hero + empty state so an org can be created without leaving the flow
(dual-writes via the registry; admin-gated; region/sector captured for
SDAIA saudi/government orgs).

CAL-PRE-510: add an in-product legend for the advisory-signal bands on
the shortlist (reusing the reco tones) + a header tooltip, and a wizard
clarifier that the English-required flag only toggles the Fluent stage
and carries no separate scoring weight. New EN/AR i18n keys (Arabic
placeholder, pending review). Column relabel (AI signal -> Advisory
signal) deferred to the naming decision. Also clears pre-existing em
dashes in both pages + the signalNote string (SOP).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Pre-Hire wizard: editable weights, English drives Fluent, inline client (CAL-PH-503/504/505)
entries.plain: Simplified Pre-Hire setup by letting teams adjust stage weights and scores in the wizard, tying the English requirement directly to the Fluent assessment, and creating clients inline.
entries.explanation:
CAL-PH-503: the English-required toggle now drives the Fluent stage -
one control includes the English assessment AND flags english_required,
replacing the redundant standalone English checkbox (matches the
guided-start flow's english_required = stages.fluent binding).
CAL-PH-505: per-stage weight + cut-score are editable in the wizard
(clamped on submit; weights still normalized at scoring time).
CAL-PH-504: inline '+ New client' creates the org via the shared
dual-write registry and selects it immediately - no pre-existing org
required. Also clears 4 pre-existing em dashes in actions.ts (SOP).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Landing: rename catalogue CTA button to Virginia Academy (EN + AR)
entries.plain: The button linking to our course catalogue is now labeled 'Virginia Academy' in English and Arabic.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Add role/ownership guards to Reflect, Academy, credential routes
entries.plain: Fixed a security gap where any logged-in user could view other people's feedback reports and credentials by guessing a link - now only authorized assessors and course instructors can access those documents.
entries.explanation:
Audit found 11 routes gated only by middleware session-presence:
- Reflect participant/cohort/framework PDFs + needs-scheduling CSV were
  open to any authenticated user by UUID (cross-org PII leak). Now admin
  or owning consultant via guardReflectEngagementAccess.
- Academy enroll/lesson-start/save/complete used service-role writes that
  trusted any client-supplied id (IDOR + credential issuance). Now admin
  or owning candidate via guardAcademyCandidate, gated before AI cost.
- Credential PDF: now admin or owning candidate.
- Role-profiles export: now requireRole(["admin"]).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC personal + proposals: recommender fallback, lens/language PDFs, new offerings
entries.plain: AI-readiness recommendations now appear for candidates close to your target profile, and proposal materials now include lens-specific and language PDFs.
entries.explanation:
Three client-review items from the Al Rajhi deep-dive walkthrough plus two
proposal-builder requests:

1. Course recommendations no longer vanish for near-target profiles. The
   personal recommender only surfaced factors with a >= 0.5 gap; a real
   client profile (3.6 / 3.9 / 4.1 / 4.4 vs target 4) had two factors
   below target yet showed "no targeted recommendations" - wrong posture
   for a training company. When no factor clears the meaningful-gap bar,
   it now falls back to ANY below-target factor. Verified: that exact
   profile now returns 8 relevant programmes led by its weakest factor.

2. The TD/TA presentation toggle now reaches the downloaded PDF. The
   toggle re-rendered the PAGE but the Download link never carried the
   override, so both lenses downloaded the same stored-lens report
   ("switching between TD and TA still generates the same report"). The
   PDF route now honours ?present=, and the results page offers BOTH
   language downloads - PDF (Arabic) and PDF (English) - regardless of
   the language the sitting was completed in, via a ?language= override.

3. Proposals: a "Custom reports / assessments (one-time)" fee under
   Licence parameters, flowing into the one-time total, Year-1 and 3-year
   TCO as its own labelled row in the commercial build-up (EN + AR).
   Unit-verified: 25,000 fee -> one-time 135,000, Year-1 138,000.

4. Proposals: Bespoke Services and Succession Planning join the sellable
   services catalogue (scope grid, licence volumes, blurbs, deliverables,
   pricing basis: per assessment / per candidate; benchmark anchors 150 /
   200) alongside the seven platform services. Proposal-only offerings -
   no portal tile or voucher machinery.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Fix 'Invalid competency list' on role-profile create/update
entries.plain: Fixed a bug that prevented recruiters from creating or updating role profiles with competency lists - the validation now accepts the correct format for pre-loaded skill IDs.
entries.explanation: Zod 4's strict .uuid() enforces RFC 4122 version/variant nibbles, so it rejects the 41 seeded competency ids (a0000001-..., version nibble 0) and the seeded role-profile org ids. Every role-profile create/update with competencies failed at validation with the generic fallback error. Switched competency_id + organization_id to the shared uuidish() shape check (same fix already applied in engagement/washup/assessor/prehire validators). Also fixed the identical latent bug in setCourseCompetencyTagsAction (course-to-AC-competency mapping editor).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: ARC PDFs: two different reports for acquisition vs development (EN + AR)
entries.plain: AI Readiness reports now show two different versions - one for hiring decisions and one for development planning - so each use case gets the right information.
entries.explanation:
Threads the new development analysis through the PDF route and both renderers so
the downloaded report matches the on-screen split:

- Acquisition PDF (EN React-PDF + AR Puppeteer): leads with the Advance/Review/
  Hold advisory band + guardrail, adds AI risk flags + a freshness stamp around
  the existing verdict / calibration / interview probes.
- Development PDF: a "Your development plan" section - non-uses framing,
  strengths-first, constructive calibration, sequenced priorities (why-now +
  70-20-10 first step + AC competencies), reflect-&-commit, manager GROW guide,
  cadence - plus the course recommender. No verdict/risk/hire language.

Verified end-to-end: all four combinations (EN/AR x acquisition/development)
return a valid PDF (200, %PDF) via the live route.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Technical: seed 2.6 Learning & Development function (HR domain)
entries.plain: Learning and Development training analysis is now available in the platform, so you can assess skills gaps and plan training programs.
entries.explanation:
Stands up the L&D node in the sandbox portal (mirrors FP&A 1.7): refreshes
skills_en/_ar (drives the MCQ knowledge generator), descriptor + JD keywords;
seeds 3 pillars + 4 logic_input blocks (course-build estimation, TNA gap math,
training ROI/Phillips, LMS completion) with self-consistent hand-computed
arithmetic; flips node_status='active'. Delivery = high mcq_pct voucher for the
instructional-design judgment + the 4 blocks for quantitative competence.
Arithmetic + content need SME (Ahmad) sign-off before the delegate run.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke Services: edit, clone, and a design sheet for every composed bundle
entries.plain: Custom bundles can now be edited and copied, and you can view a design sheet showing exactly which assessments and competencies each bundle includes.
entries.explanation:
Client instruction (2026-09-02): a composed bundle could only be archived.
Three things were missing - editing one already composed, replicating one
to start another, and a way to see later exactly how a bundle was designed.

- Design sheet at /admin/bespoke/[id]: identity, client, status, usage,
  who composed it and when; every service in sitting order with its FULL
  scope spelled out (each Logica element and each of the 41 competencies
  shown as included or struck through, grouped by cluster), what the scope
  produces in reports, the candidates invited and vouchers issued, and the
  stored row itself so nothing can drift from what the composer wrote.
  Linked from each card in the composer list.
- Edit: the composer opens pre-filled ("Editing: X") and saves in place via
  updateBundleAction. The DESIGN (service mix + scope) locks once anyone
  has been invited or a voucher issued - those people were promised the
  sitting as designed - so only name, description and client can change
  on a used bundle; the server enforces it, the UI disables the toggles
  and offers "Clone instead". Design derivation is shared with compose.
- Clone: pre-fills the composer from any bundle as "X (copy)" ("New bundle
  based on: X"); saving creates a new row and leaves the original alone.
- Cards now show invited / completed / vouchers / seats and a lock marker;
  ?edit= and ?clone= open the composer from the design sheet.

Verified in the preview against live rows: sheet renders the SDC bundle
(3 of 4 Logica elements, 16 of 41 competencies, 4 candidates, 2 vouchers);
edit persisted a description; clone saved a new row, archived after.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Proposals: bespoke bundle licensing (one price, all services)
entries.plain: Proposals can now price custom service bundles at one flat rate where each seat unlocks all included assessments in a single session.
entries.explanation:
Adds a "Bespoke service bundles" editor to the licence-pricing builder: a
named bundle prices a shared licence pool at one flat price where one seat
lets a participant complete every service in the bundle in a single sitting.
Each bundle carries a licence (seat) count, a price, and a multi-select of
services.

The proposal now auto-details each bundle: for every included service it
lists what the assessment measures and the reports it produces, derived from
the proposal catalogue so the maker never re-types assessment detail.
Bilingual EN + AR (new AR service labels, blurbs, and deliverables for all 9
services; AR licence table gains bundle rows it previously lacked).

Storage rides the existing licensing_model jsonb (new bundles[].licenses
field) - no migration.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: HiPo Engagement: expand manager survey to 20 statements
entries.plain: The high-potential engagement manager survey now includes 20 questions instead of fewer, capturing richer feedback.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke bundles: multi-seat voucher (shared redeem link)
entries.plain: Custom bundles now support multi-seat voucher codes so multiple candidates can redeem access with a single shared link.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke Reports: Invite manager from the admin side too
entries.plain: Managers can now be invited to view custom reports directly from the admin side, making it easier to share assessments with leadership.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bundle composer: explain how the HiPo Engagement pillar is added
entries.plain: The bundle builder now explains how the high-potential engagement section is included, so you understand what you are getting.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bundle composer: live report-coverage badges for the Persona scope
entries.plain: The bundle builder now shows live indicators of which Persona assessments are covered in your report bundle as you build it.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Scientific Models hub + bundle reports panel + residency cost wording
entries.plain: The scientific models information hub, bundle reports section, and cost wording have been updated for clarity.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Client portal: exact funnel counts, unbiased cohort mean, seat + PII fixes
entries.plain: Funnel counts, cohort averages, and seat data are now accurate across all assessments, fixing errors that previously understated completion numbers.
entries.explanation:
Client Portal review (0 IDOR - org-scoping is sound; all data-integrity):

Majors:
- Funnel "Completed" count was rows.length off a 100-row list, so a large
  org undercounted on the funnel + insights donut. Now fluent/logica/techno
  return a true head/exact count (persona already did).
- Persona intelligence cohort mean was computed over only the 200 newest
  sittings (biased mean + a denominator that contradicted the funnel). Now
  pages the full submitted-session set (chunked responses).
- ARC portal redeem link leaked the delegate email in the URL query string
  (dead weight - /ara/redeem never reads it). Now only the opaque code travels.

Minors:
- Pre-Hire invite released the whole draw on a thrown mid-loop error, freeing
  seats already consumed (phantom quota). Now releases only the uncommitted
  seats (createdIds hoisted so the catch can see it).
- Paginate the arc/reflect/prehire seat monitors + the insights/bundle/bespoke
  candidate rosters (1000-row cap truncated counts); reflect completed count +
  prehire rows now exact over the full set, display sliced to 100 newest-first.
- Bespoke page read the org name from ara_organizations by the AC org id
  (blank name); reads from organizations now.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bundle composer: Persona competency scope + remove standalone-voucher footgun
entries.plain: The bundle builder no longer offers a confusing standalone Logica option and now lets you pick specific Persona competencies to include.
entries.explanation: (1) The composed-bundle card no longer offers 'Issue Logica vouchers for this scope' - a standalone Logica voucher runs ONLY Logica, which read as 'the bundle ends without Persona' in testing. The one-sitting invite is now the card's primary button ('Invite candidate - one sitting, all sections'). (2) Selecting Persona in the composer now opens a competency picker (41 chips grouped by cluster with select-all/clear + per-cluster toggles, full instrument default) - mirroring the Logica elements picker. A real subset persists as service_config.persona.competencyIds; the bundle sitting serves only those competencies and pins the scope on the behavioral session (00123) so the standard Persona report renders it as a scoped sitting; the portal bundle page shows the scoped competency chips. Verified E2E: a 6-competency + inductive bundle served 24 Persona statements (not 164), chained into 10 inductive questions, completed, with the scope pinned and exactly 6 competencies recorded.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Client portal: bundles can now invite candidates (seat-metered)
entries.plain: Client managers can now invite candidates directly to custom bundles from the portal instead of having to request admin invitations.
entries.explanation: Role Readiness programmes could already issue invites from the portal, but composed bundles were admin-invite only. New 'Invite a candidate (one sitting)' panel on /portal/bundle/[id]: client_manager (own org; admin preview via ?org) creates the chained-sitting link directly. Commercially metered: each invite atomically draws ONE seat from EVERY bundled runnable service's allocation (a Persona + Logica bundle costs 1 Persona + 1 Logica seat), all-or-nothing with release on any failure; the panel states the cost inline and disables with a top-up hint when any bundled service has no seats left. Verified live as the Najm client manager: invite created the org-bound candidate and drew exactly one seat from each service (released in test cleanup).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Intelligence sheet: executive visual redesign
entries.plain: The insights dashboard now has a modern visual design with better charts, summaries, and status indicators for easier data reading.
entries.explanation:
Dark branded hero (dotted texture, org + generated date) with overlapping headline stat cards (icons + big numerals); per-service panels get an accent-tinted header with a distribution-model chip, server-rendered SVG donuts for seat utilisation + completion, proportional funnel bars, accent-toned result-mix chips, and initials-avatar completion rosters with PDF buttons. Persona cohort card gains a 1-5 gauge and interpretation-band-toned chips (band key threaded through portal-intel). Bundles render as cards with a completion donut + combined-report buttons. BackLink gains an optional className for dark surfaces. Zero client JS - all server-rendered.

Verified live as the Najm client manager: hero, 4 headline cards, all 7 service panels with donuts/funnels, Persona cohort 3.34/5 with band chips, Techno result mix, bundle section.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Client portal: voucher ledger + Intelligence sheet
entries.plain: Clients can now see a complete record of all vouchers issued and who used them, plus an insights dashboard showing usage and completion rates.
entries.explanation:
Completes client self-service visibility. (1) Voucher ledger on every voucher-service page: each issued code with who it was assigned to, who redeemed it (name/email/date), uses, status, and issue date - collapsed by default under the existing funnel + completed-results table. Tolerant peel for assigned_email (00130) and the Techno name-bridge. (2) /portal/insights - the intelligence sheet: headline cards (active services, seats granted/used, assessments completed), a panel per subscribed service with seat-utilisation bar, issued/redeemed/completed (or invited/started/completed) funnel, completion rate, result mix (CEFR levels / bands), Persona cohort self-rating + interpretation-band mix (range-paginated org-scoped scoring), recent completions with report PDFs, and the bundles section with combined-report links. 'Intelligence' link in the portal chrome preserves admin-preview ?org context; admin without an org gets the client picker. ARC stays cohort-level by design (consultant controls delivery).

Verified live as the Najm client manager: all 7 service panels, cohort card, result mix, recent completions, bundle combined-report link, and the Persona ledger (2 issued codes with statuses).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke bundles: one-sitting candidate flow (Persona + Logica chained)
entries.plain: Candidates can now complete custom bundles in one sitting - answering behavioral questions and then cognitive tests back-to-back without stopping.
entries.explanation:
A composed bundle previously had no combined delivery - a Logica voucher ended after Logica even when Persona was in the package. New token-gated flow at /bundle/apply/[token] chains the bundle's runnable services in composed order: consent -> Persona (full instrument via the behavioural engine, org-tagged session -> full Persona reports) -> Logica (bundle's subtest scope enforced server-side, keyed test in psy_sessions, single-use atomic scoring, org-tagged psy_results) -> done. bundle_candidates (migration 00172, applied) is the thin chain; stage completion derives from the native records. Admin invites from the composer ('Invite candidate' per bundle -> copyable link); the client portal bundle page gains a candidates roster with status. Middleware bypasses /bundle/apply/ + /api/bundle/ (token flow, mirrors Role Readiness). Takers never receive score data.

Verified E2E in-browser as an anonymous candidate: consent -> 164 Persona statements -> 10 inductive-only timed questions -> done; all records org-tagged and linked; artifacts cleaned.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke bundles: persist + surface as client-portal tiles
entries.plain: Custom bundles built by admins now save to the database and appear on client portals so teams can invite candidates to tailored programs.
entries.explanation:
The composer now saves for real: composeBundleAction resolves the client through the shared registry and persists a bespoke_services kind='bundle' row (service_keys + per-service options in service_config, migration 00171 - e.g. a Logica subtest scope). The composed list loads from the DB and the trash button archives (removing the portal tile). Client portal: bundles surface under 'Your tailored programmes' next to Role Readiness; a new org-isolated /portal/bundle/[id] page renders the package's services as allocation-aware cards (seats left / not-allocated hint, Open links into each service portal) with a 'Scoped elements' callout for a scoped Logica. Admin landing lists bundles too. All reads tolerant of 00171 not applied.

Verified end-to-end in the live preview: composed via the real UI form (row landed with the right org id + inductive-only config), tile + bundle page rendered on Najm's portal, archive removed it. Test artifacts archived.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Client portal: collapse the Candidates roster by default on bespoke programme
entries.plain: The candidate list on program pages now starts collapsed to reduce clutter and can be expanded when needed.
entries.explanation: The programme detail page listed every candidate expanded. Extracted the roster into a collapsible client component (CandidatesCollapsible) that starts closed, showing 'Candidates (N | M completed)' with a chevron; expands on click.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Give every voucher wizard ARC's client dropdown + add-client
entries.plain: All assessment portals now start by asking you to pick a client, with an option to add a new one - making the process consistent across the platform.
entries.explanation: Step 1 is now identical across all 7 portals: a 'Which client?' registry dropdown with an inline '+ Add a new client', following ARC's exact lead. Shared VoucherDetailsFields embeds the dropdown + add-client (one admin-gated server action). Trio/Pre-Hire/Techno/RR load platform clients and pass them through; the client-facing portal shows the org read-only (no registry leak).

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke Services: move Reports to its own page behind a top button
entries.plain: Reports for completed assessments now have their own dedicated page instead of cluttering the main Bespoke Services setup screen.
entries.explanation:
Replace the inline Reports panel on the Bespoke landing with a "Reports" button
in the page header that opens a dedicated /admin/bespoke/reports page. The page
hosts the same searchable list of every completed candidate report (role,
client, verdict, date, Report PDF). Keeps the landing focused on building +
configuring; reuses the AllReportsPanel component.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke Services: central searchable Reports panel at the top
entries.plain: You can now search through all completed candidate reports in one central location, with their pass/fail verdict and completion date.
entries.explanation:
Houses every completed candidate report in one place. Adds a "Reports" panel at
the top of /admin/bespoke listing all completed Role Readiness candidates across
every role + client (resolved org name), newest first, with the ready/not-ready
verdict, completed date, and a Report (PDF) link - and a search box to retrieve
a specific candidate. Reuses the single loadPlatformClients() call for the
client-name map; tolerant of an un-applied 00153 (empty state). ('bundle'
bespoke kind is unbuilt scaffolding and produces no per-candidate report.)

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Role Readiness: results/reports panel on the admin role editor
entries.plain: Admins can now see candidate results and verdicts directly in the Role Readiness editor instead of having to check elsewhere.
entries.explanation:
The admin issues trial links from the role editor but had no way to see the
results there - the only candidate+report tracking list lived in the client
portal, which filters by client org, so an unassigned sample (e.g. the HR-GM
seed) never appeared anywhere admin-side.

Add a "Results / candidates" panel atop /admin/bespoke/roles/[id]: every
candidate for the role across all clients + direct/sample links, with status,
the ready/not-ready verdict, and a Report (PDF) link (or apply link if not yet
finished). Tolerant of an un-applied 00153.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: RR vouchers: drop XLSX, atomic shared-seat claim, honest emailed status
entries.plain: Role Readiness voucher uploads now accept plain text instead of Excel files, and concurrent voucher redemptions are now protected against over-booking.
entries.explanation:
Addresses the adversarial-review findings on the voucher diff:
- Drop the read-excel-file dependency + .xlsx path (per request). Delegate upload
  is now CSV/text only, with a proper quoted-CSV parser (handles "Last, First")
  and the name taken from the first non-email cell (not the longest).
- Shared (pool) vouchers: redeem now claims a seat via an atomic DB function
  (migration 00156 rr_claim_voucher_seat: SET uses = uses + 1 WHERE uses <
  max_uses) so concurrent redeems can't over-redeem; provisioning failure releases
  via rr_release_voucher_seat. EXECUTE locked to service_role.
- "Emailed" status is gated on isEmailConfigured() so a console-mock (unconfigured)
  send no longer shows a false delivered tick.
- Competency grid sorts by clusterOrder explicitly (robust if the source is
  regenerated). CollapsibleCard drops the unused `right` slot (no nested-button risk).
migration 00156 applied live. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: RR editor: section-labelled grid, collapsible sections, delegate-upload vouchers
entries.plain: The Role Readiness editor now organizes all competencies into labeled groups, collapses sections to reduce clutter, and lets you upload a list of delegates to generate assessment links for each.
entries.explanation:
Four editor/voucher enhancements:
- Behavioural competency grid is now grouped + labelled by cluster (9 "building
  block" section headers), all 41 on one screen.
- New CollapsibleCard wraps every editor section (Pass thresholds, Behavioural
  competencies, Technical areas) + the voucher panel, so each expands/collapses.
- Individual vouchers: upload a delegate list (.xlsx via read-excel-file, or
  CSV/text) with name + email -> one complete-link voucher per delegate, with an
  "Email each delegate their link" option (role_readiness_invitation template,
  batched 8-at-a-time). recipient_name (migration 00155) is stored + prefilled on
  the redeem page (&name=). Result table shows Name + Emailed status; copy-link
  fallback always available.
- "Issue vouchers" panel is collapsible (default closed).

migration 00155 (rr_vouchers.recipient_name) applied live. tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Role Readiness: voucher model (individual links + shared multi-seat link)
entries.plain: Role Readiness now supports both individual assessment links (one per person) and shared group links (multiple people from a pool), matching other assessment types.
entries.explanation:
Replaces the simple "create invite link" with the same voucher model as the
other portals, in both the admin role editor and the client portal product page.

- migration 00154: rr_vouchers (code, max_uses, uses, recipient_email, org) +
  RLS (admin all; client_manager reads own org). Applied + verified live.
- src/lib/role-readiness/vouchers.ts: issue individual (one single-use voucher
  per email) or one pool voucher (N seats); redeem = atomic seat claim ->
  provision rr_candidate -> return apply token (hands the seat back if it fails).
- /role-readiness/redeem?code=...[&email=...] public page + action (middleware
  auth-bypassed) -> name/email form -> forwards to the apply flow.
- Shared RrVoucherPanel (Individual links / One shared link) with complete redeem
  URLs + copy, used by the admin editor (issueRoleVouchersAction, targets the
  assigned client) and the client portal (clientIssueRoleVouchersAction, org
  resolved server-side, programme must be assigned).
tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Role editor: one-screen competency grid + AI technical-question generator
entries.plain: The Role editor now fits all competencies on one screen and can generate technical exam questions automatically using AI for your review.
entries.explanation:
- Behavioural competencies now render as a compact 2-3 column grid (smaller font,
  no scroll) so all 41 fit on one screen.
- "AI generate" button per technical area: Claude drafts 4 MCQs for the area
  (src/lib/role-readiness/tech-generator.ts + generateTechnicalItemsAction); the
  admin reviews/edits/removes them like any authored item.
- Clarified the green answer text as an admin-only answer key (candidate never
  sees it) via a hover title.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Role editor: target-scale hover help + JD-to-competency matching
entries.plain: Competency targets now display helpful explanations on hover, and you can paste or upload a job description to auto-match relevant competencies.
entries.explanation:
- Per-competency Target dropdown now explains itself on hover (native title +
  an info-icon tooltip on the heading) - the VIFM BARS 1-5 scale and what "meets
  target" means.
- New "Match from a job description" box in the behavioural competencies section:
  paste text or upload a PDF/text JD, and the existing P0.1 extractor identifies
  the important competencies across the VIFM framework (building blocks + the 41)
  and pre-selects them with priority-based targets + reasoning. Reuses
  extractCompetenciesFromJobDescription / ...FromJdPdf via matchCompetenciesFromJdAction.
- Heading shows live "N selected across X/Y building blocks".
tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Bespoke band: render configured products INSIDE the dark box
entries.plain: Bespoke Services products now display as cards inside the dark Bespoke box instead of floating below it, creating a cleaner layout.
entries.explanation:
The published Role Readiness products were rendering as light cards below the
'Bespoke Services' box (the box was one big link, so they couldn't nest). Make
the box a container div with the CTA + each product card as sibling links inside
it, dark-on-dark styled. No nested anchors.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Role Readiness: per-client tile in the client portal
entries.plain: Clients now see only the Role Readiness programs assigned to them, and can invite candidates and track their results from a dedicated page.
entries.explanation:

tsc + lint clean.

entries.author: AimanSadeq
entries.title: Role Readiness: admin role editor + landing surfacing + HR GM seed
entries.plain: Admins can now build Role Readiness programs by choosing competencies, authoring technical questions, setting pass scores, and creating candidate invitations.
entries.explanation:
- /admin/bespoke/roles: job families + roles list; per-role editor to pick

- platform-landing: the Bespoke Services band now renders published role_readiness

- /admin/bespoke links to the roles editor.
- HR GM sample seeded on the live DB (is_sample): job family + role profile with
